games.name: Anseion
games.summary: Get ready for a journey to the world of Anseion, an immersive 2D MMORPG. Choose your fraction: good or evil. Fight against players and monsters, explore the fascinating world, collect items and create your own. Make a unique character. Participate in events and fraction battles, increase your rank.

games.name: As If Through Glass
games.summary: High school freshman Anise enters her spring semester during an unseasonable, unceasing rain. Girls’* relationships float through the waves of time as it passes with or without them.

games.name: Asantria
games.summary: An intriguing top-down game with a cartoonish pixel art style! Move around the map in all directions while viewing your character from above! Use various types of magic to shoot and fight monsters! Also use different outfits that will give you additional advantages in the game world!

games.name: Astrolite
games.summary: Obliterate ever-growing asteroids in a race against time. Level up your starship to stay on top of the looming threat. Spend well earned Luna Coins on permanent power-ups to skyrocket through the levels. Each mission has unique enemies, challenging bosses, and unlimited variety in gameplay.

games.name: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2
games.summary: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2 is the second part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Follow the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from a national park to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills!

games.name: Axima
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Axima, a Monster Taming RPG! Befriend and battle alongside over a hundred different Axi, while you explore the fully open world by yourself - or with your friends in multiplayer!

games.name: Battle Narf
games.summary: An extremely late entry for the Vextro Unplugged jam, strongly inspired by Battle Kid, Fortress of Peril.

games.name: BattleSail
games.summary: BattleSail is an action tactical strategy game where you command a fleet in turn-based naval battles. Manage resources, upgrade and outfit your ships, and navigate a richly designed single-player Campaign or jump into fast Arena encounters, or test pure thinking in one-turn Puzzle challenges.

games.name: BaulaQuest
games.summary: Local middle school teacher fights angry orange bald man army with marbles and furry creatures. Baula. Quest. BaulaQuest.

games.name: Birdseed VR
games.summary: Snap pics of the chunkiest, cutest birds in VR! Relax in lush forests, complete quirky daily quests, and fill your Journal. Whether you’re birding alone or together with friends, get cozy and escape to nature.

games.name: Blood Night
games.summary: (Multiplayer | COOP) THE FOREST IS DEAD. YOU ARE NOT. Survive. Build. Kill everyone. A world where zombies are smarter than they look. Inventory, crafting, and building are your tools in the war for tomorrow.

games.name: Card TD
games.summary: CardTD is a hybrid tower defense and a deck-building game. Packaged with a ton of user freedom in playstyles with a progression system that lets you play at your own pace. Defend your base from waves of toybox like enemies by playing cards to gain resources and towers to defend yourself!

games.name: Cleaning Raccrew
games.summary: Cleaning Raccrew is a 4 player party game inspired by sumo, japanese game shows, and silly raccoon images!

games.name: Covenant Cards
games.summary: The timeline of history has been corrupted by a massive digital anomaly. Within a sprawling cybernetic simulation, the source code of the ancient, biblical past is fracturing. As a specialized Tactician, you are tasked with entering this shattered system to debug the anomalies. By commanding the echoes of historical heroes and wielding futuristic technology, you must battle through corrupted sectors, uncover the cause of the glitch, and restore the true timeline before the simulation collapses entirely.

games.name: Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
games.summary: The most absurd Souls-like parody ever! You’re a blacksmith with bean-powered dragon abilities, taking on evil corporations with maximum gasitude! Fart-dash, demolish bosses, and break the fourth wall in this hilarious action RPG. Smell the legend!

games.name: Die Fighter
games.summary: A sci-fi dice-driven roguelike where your dice fuel both your abilities and your enemies’. You'll need strategy and luck to outwit dynamic foes, harness synergistic upgrades, and escape creeping galactic doom before Fate catches up.

games.name: Doppleganger
games.summary:
A mannequin lies disassembled on the bed.

A window is blocked with steel bars.

You must find a way out of the room.

This is a point and click escape room game, around 30-60 minutes long

games.name: Dreams Stories Online
games.summary: Dreams Stories Online is an indie MMORPG where you return from death ️ not as someone who has already triumphed, but as someone who still dreams. Walk through a persistent, wounded, and hostile world, guided by the hope of a great restoration.

games.name: Emoji Marble Dash
games.summary:
emoji Marble Dash represents a new generation of Web3 gaming, where blockchain enhances rather than complicates the player experience. Officially licensed by the emoji company and built on Immutable zkEVM, the game demonstrates how true digital ownership can seamlessly integrate into competitive arcade racing.

The game features physics-driven marble racing, where players control emoji characters riding on top of rolling marbles. Unlike traditional racers, this momentum-based system creates skill-based gameplay where physics mastery determines victory across 6-player multiplayer competitions.

All Web3 features are completely optional. Traditional players enjoy the full racing experience without ever touching crypto, while Web3 enthusiasts unlock ownership features through simple Immutable Passport integration (email, Google, Apple ID login – no wallet setup required).

Items earned through gameplay can be minted as NFTs or SFTs and traded on the dedicated emoji marketplace. Immutable zkEVM's gasless transaction technology means players never pay blockchain fees.

Quick Race: Barrier-free entertainment with no blockchain requirements Ranked Mode: Competitive play with $EMJ token entry fees and cryptocurrency prize pools distributed to top performers.

emoji Marble Dash follows full MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets) compliance, ensuring regulatory adherence for the European market. The $EMJ token (ERC-20, 10 billion fixed supply) powers the ecosystem with a Token Generation Event scheduled for Q1 2026.

Developed by El Dorado Studio and published by Euronext-listed Crypto Blockchain Industries (ALCBI), emoji Marble Dash launches in early 2026, demonstrating that accessible Web3 gaming is achievable when player experience comes first.

games.name: Enter the Nemesis: Blood Portal
games.summary: In this 2.5D hack and slash shooter platformer enemy bodies will become your platform. Kill enemies to activate the portals, and build a platform of bodies to reach the exits. Stomp the bodies, crush the heads, collect blood, and snatch their weapons. Find and free the girl, then defeat the nemesis

games.name: Entrance No.9
games.summary: A drunk man returns home, but the familiar stairwell turns into an endless, distorted maze. Floors repeat themselves, doors disappear, and every wrong step takes you back to the beginning. Can you make it to your apartment?

games.name: Eurekas
games.summary: Eurekas is a real-time strategy colony sim where settlers battle a hostile, mystical island. Build, survive, use magic, and appease your gods—or risk losing everything to the wild forces that resist your claim.

games.name: Farmare: Ultimate Animal Survive
games.summary: A survival roguelite RPG where you fight endless waves of enemies, gather upgrades on the fly, and grow your farm base stronger with every run.

games.name: Finnie's Bimbo Fishing
games.summary: Finnie's Bimbo Fishing is a short, chill fishing game where the titular Finnie catches fishies in order to pay back her crippling BimboDebt! Catch a total of ten (10!) fish and carry them around on your bits to sell and the shop and purchase various unlocks to aid Finnie.

games.name: Forthold
games.summary: Hold the fort as a lone archer in this short incremental defense game. Shoot waves of enemies, collect magic and soulshards, upgrade your power, and ascend to push further toward the source of the relentless darkness.

games.name: Future Weapon
games.summary: Future Weapon 2D is a top down space shooter where you can relive the couch co-op glory days with up to 8 players across 2 screens. Grab a gun, grab a spaceship, upgrade everything, mine rocks, explore, and recruit the local townsfolk to conquer this demo.

games.name: Garden and a Goat
games.summary: Garden and a Goat is a single-player animal collecting and ecosystem recovery game! You play as a friendly robot, eager to help a series of ecosystems in need. Clean up the environment, revive plants, and entice the local wildlife to return, unlocking ever more animals and decorations along the way!

games.name: Gloop
games.summary: Warp through the space in Gloop, a fast paced arcade game where you'll control your ship with just one button as the hyperspace glitches out!

games.name: Gnomed
games.summary: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker base defence game where your humble home is the last line of defense. Hold out against 20 chaotic waves of enemies, unlock new abilities, and grow stronger each run!

games.name: Grotto Escape
games.summary: You play as a SF character facing Heroic Fantasy creatures in this Dungeon Crawler with Platformer gameplay.

games.name: Harmonic Drive
games.summary: Harmonic Drive is an arcade-style rhythm game built around player reactive background effects and AI generated music.

games.name: Hive Commando
games.summary: Psychic Firepower and Bug Breeding! Experimental combo between a top down shooty game and a real-time strategy (with pause available to do orders on the in-game map)

games.name: Honor Mice
games.summary: Dash, slash, and shoot through handcrafted levels across vibrant worlds in a fast-paced action platformer! Stop the forces of evil from stealing your mysterious lunch and uncover the destiny that awaits you!

games.name: Humanity's Fall
games.summary: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

games.name: I Got Turned Into a Girl and This Yuri Death Angel Will Only Turn Me Back if I Can Find All the Hidden Props
games.summary: A silly prop hunt game about becoming a girl.

games.name: Ironforged
games.summary: Slow-paced, tactical VR shooter where every mistake is punished. You fight with a minimal arsenal - your pistol, composure, timing, and precision. Wake up as CM-42 and fight your way out of a relentless combat training facility designed to break the weak and forge perfect soldiers.

games.name: King of Santa
games.summary: King of Santa is a competitive party action game for up to four players, where players take on the role of Santa, collect presents scattered across the stage, and deliver them to chimneys to earn points and win the match.

games.name: Landlord
games.summary: "Landlord Chess" turns the ever-changing strategies in card games into visual scenarios, makes it more like playing chess or Sudoku. It includes a single-player mode and a multiplayer online mode, while also integrating a leaderboard and an achievement system.

games.name: Lost & Found
games.summary: LOST & FOUND is a free to play dynamic sorting game. Match forms to the right items and build your own warehouse, or compete with your friends in multiplayer mode after your shift is over.

games.name: Lost Children of the Mansion
games.summary: Explore a dark mansion that constantly shifts like a maze. Rescue the trapped children hidden behind locked doors. Avoid the roaming enemies and find your way out.

games.name: Lumina's Brew
games.summary: Explore enchanted biomes, gather rare ingredients, and brew potions to sell in this cozy 2D metroidvania. Discover secrets, meet curious creatures, and master the art of potion-making as a young witch on a mystical journey.

games.name: Magic Tower: Legion
games.summary: "Magic Tower: Legion" is a roguelike Magic Tower-like game. You will play as a legion commander and lead your team into the magic tower. Use each character's strengths to defeat powerful enemies. Remember to plan every step carefully, for all resources in the magic tower are non-renewable.

games.name: Monster Ops 16
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: NoWay
games.summary: You wake up in a dark underground labyrinth. Zombies roam, hunters wait. Stay silent, run, fight, or survive by acting like one of them. You’re not even sure there’s a way out.

games.name: Noelle's Ark
games.summary: Explore ruin puzzles, talk to new people, explore the island and unravel the secrets both hidden on this island, and about yourself in this semi-open-world puzzle based rpg!

games.name: NolyRhythm
games.summary: Get into the rhythm of the music! If you keep getting into the groove, you'll clear the game before you know it! This is the casual rhythm game "NolyRhythm"!

games.name: Nonsense Defense
games.summary: Roguelite tower defense with moveable chaos. Build towers and troops, drag them mid battle, dash through danger, and defend your crystal solo or with up to three friends in online co op.

games.name: Pack and Ship: Warehouse Simulator
games.summary: Build your logistics empire from the ground up. Choose the most profitable contracts, optimize your warehouse layout for maximum efficiency, and upgrade your equipment. Balance risk and reward as you adapt your strategy to a shifting market. Every lift, every pallet, and every decision counts.

games.name: Parcel Peaks
games.summary: A difficult fully physics based ski simulator where you deliver items down insane slopes. The controls are few, but difficult to master.

games.name: PhantomZone SemiDeus
games.summary: "A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times." That's what she called herself. Mysterious, bizarre biographical tales unfold in a retro-futuristic world.

games.name: PolyDestroyer
games.summary: Engage in cosmic battles with PolyDestroyer, a riveting 2D shooter. Navigate space, customize your ship, and thwart alien foes to save the galaxy. Your spacecraft, your adventure!

games.name: Primland The Magus
games.summary: A dark fantasy 2D action game about a solitary island that has turned into hell and a girl named Magus. Collect "relics" sleeping on the island and acquire skills. Take on mysteries and powerful enemies using a variety of actions!

games.name: Propaganda vs. Zombies 2
games.summary: Fight through Hordes of Zombies while rescuing other survivors but every shot you make creates noise that attracts more Zombies towards you, your subordinates, and your Camp. Build your camp and make your decisions to assure the safety of your People!

games.name: RC: Car Maniacs
games.summary: RC:CM is a fascinating arcade simulator of radio-controlled cars that will allow you to plunge into the world of children's fantasies by driving radio-controlled cars: rally, drift, high-speed and other types of cars! Race with your friends! Speed, adrenaline and excitement await you!

games.name: Remnant Protocol
games.summary: The assassination of the Blessed Mother has plunged the galaxy in darkness. Usurpers rule with absolute authority, and blood flows in rivers of red across the stars. Only the Protocol can restore Her light.

games.name: Rocket Wrestling Entertainment
games.summary: Throw it down in the newest sport league of 2073: Rocket Wrestling Entertainment. Pelt your foes with a barrage of rockets and powerful takedowns to stand on top!

games.name: Rollbound
games.summary: Rollbound is a short, experimental clicker set at a lonely tavern table, where a single die decides everything. Earn points and gold to upgrade Attack, Defense, Luck, and Gold gain as the stakes climb.

games.name: Rotato
games.summary: Spin. Shoot. Survive.

games.name: Safe House
games.summary: Survive the plague. Manage a Safe House. Decide who to trust. A cinematic, story-driven psychological horror with multiple endings.

games.name: Sculptor
games.summary: Create and paint statues of beautiful women, improve your skills and follow the kinetic novel of a sculptor who fell in love with his creation. The game is inspired by the Greek myth of Pygmalion.

games.name: Secrets of Suburbia
games.summary: Investigate a disappearance in a quiet American suburb in 1997—or ignore it entirely. Spend the night browsing the internet, playing video games, and chatting with your friends in this first-person mystery-horror experience.

games.name: Secrets of Temple Isle
games.summary: Explore ancient ruins and diverse biomes, fight in third-person combat while collecting gear and powers. Design your space and decorate with items gathered in the world. Become the legend in this exciting single player adventure.

games.name: Seed of God
games.summary: Seed of God is a epic scale turnbased Battle 2D/3d JRPG with a characterdriven story that will take you on a unforgettable journey in the style of FinalFantasy. Face choices that define your morale (Good/Bad) and change events as you explore a fantasy world and unfold this epic saga

games.name: Sheol no Mori: Tasogare no Majuuzukai
games.summary: Inspired by “Kodoku Poison,” an ancient Chinese sorcery, this game combines “Kodoku Poison, Beast Alchemy, and Match-3 Puzzles.” Select a few beasts from the herd to turn into familiars, pit your familiars against the beasts, and fuse familiars together to create giant beasts.

games.name: Snatch Squad
games.summary: Imagine Payday in an open world like GTA — built entirely of blocks. Snatch Squad is a co‑op crime sim in a voxel city. Plan and execute heists, launder money through legit businesses, and outsmart the police.

games.name: Stained Blade
games.summary: Stained Blade is a multiplayer VR melee game built around something most VR sword games fake: real, server-driven physics.

games.name: Streamers Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: Restore order and cleanliness to the rooms of famous Gaming Streamers after their epic gaming sessions. Find artefacts, explore streamers life. Play co-op with your friends.

games.name: Tales of Fear: Episode Zero
games.summary: Can you tell the difference between reality and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.

games.name: The Skyland Chronicles
games.summary: You are a bloody pirate. Will you make the most of it in the new world and fulfill your destiny? This is your battle, where you'll come face to face with dark creatures from Slavic mythology. Take on the role of a legendary warrior and decide if the world is worth saving.

games.name: Three Jokers
games.summary: A card roguelike inspired by Balatro and Cuphead. Fight duels, play insane mini-games, build Joker City and rise to greatness — in Three Jokers!

games.name: Type To Kill
games.summary: An arcade shooting game where you have to type challenges to finish off enemies with your EMP. In between stages, watch live-action full-motion video cutscenes with a full cast of memorable characters and not necessarily the best acting.

games.name: Táng Chuánqí: Shàng Yuáncháng Gān Xíng
games.summary: A three-thousand-mile journey of exile, a mystery of untold evil, when strange legends are decoded into reports of social pathology, when the joy of wuxia revenge collides with the ironclad fortress of power, from bandits slaughtering villages to the powerful committing cannibalism, who is not a lamb to be slaughtered in troubled times? This game focuses on the historical backdrop of the An-Shi Rebellion during the Tang Dynasty, and every choice the player makes will mark their character's fate.

games.name: Vapinupituru
games.summary: Submission for the Cookie Cutter RM2k3 Jam.

games.name: Void Breach
games.summary: Twin-stick space combat roguelite with 12 abilities, 5 reality-warping ultimates, and 20+ enemy factions that each fight differently. Permanent upgrades that stack across hundreds of hours. Quick missions, deep progression, zero runs wasted.

games.name: What’s in the Box?
games.summary: A first-person incremental game where you buy and open containers filled with random items, repair and upgrade the things you find, and sell them for profit. In a dark industrial environment, upgrade your character, tools, and machines, earn money, and step by step work your way toward freedom.

games.name: When It Rains
games.summary: Explore a conservatory on a dark, rainy day to help a (sorta) grandpa (sorta) vampire (sorta) find his stolen memory!

games.name: Win Over That Delinquent Guy!
games.summary:
“Go! Win over that delinquent!”

A violent delinquent has transferred into your class. And your childhood friend encourages you to grow closer to him. Yeah, right! Is a sweet, lovey-dovey school rom-com really gonna happen to you?!

games.name: Wrong Elevator
games.summary: Wrong Elevator is a horror game where you explore abandoned facilities and scavenging resources to maintain and upgrade your elevator.

games.name: 100 Candy Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: Alex the Rabbit
games.summary: Alex the Rabbit is a classic, fun, and challenging 2D platformer. Join Alex, a brave rabbit, on an action-packed adventure through colorful and dangerous worlds. Your goal is to collect all the carrots scattered across the map, overcome obstacles and enemies, and find the Golden Carrot, located at the end of each level.

games.name: Alstan
games.summary: Alstan is a 3rd-person action-adventure game set in the merciless deserts of Idnan, inspired by Amazigh and Tuareg cultures. You play as Alstan, a warrior cursed by the Mark of the Desert, a power that allows him to control sand but slowly turns him into one of the very Djinns he hunts.

games.name: BlackSands
games.summary: Trapped in a relentless time loop, fight your way through a mysterious arena. Explore, adapt, and use what you’ve learned throughout each reset to uncover its secrets and reach your freedom.

games.name: Breeze of Ashes
games.summary: Command airships in a tactical RTS where choices shape your story. Manage resources, upgrade your fleet, and battle rival factions in a non-linear campaign. With rogue-lite replayability, multiplayer co-op, and skirmish modes, your journey evolves with every playthrough.

games.name: Can I Not Fall for Idols?
games.summary: You’ve become the manager of a brand-new idol group—only to find yourself drowning in romance flags from the start! Love with idols is strictly forbidden. Can you survive this chaotic, no-love-allowed romcom—the first of its kind in the otome world!?

games.name: Cat Quest II
games.summary: Cat Quest II, a fantasy action-adventure RPG, returns to the world of Felingard to expand on the original with more explosive spells, expanded weapon options, an exciting new character switch mechanic, and local co-op! Play as both a cat and dog as you explore their kingdoms solo or with a friend! Quest in a world filled with magic, curious monsters, and go on a catventure like never before!

games.name: Cat Quest III
games.summary: In Cat Quest III you play as a purrivateer in a freely explorable 2.5D open-world swarming with Pi-rats. You can sail the seas in your ship for treasures galore! But prepare for peril, as the Pirate King aims to hunt you down...

games.name: Chromatic Battles
games.summary: Chromatic Battles is a 2D action/strategy game with tower defense mechanics and color-based combat. The player defends a rotating ship against enemy waves, damaging them only with bullets that match their color. It features planet-based progression, an inter-level upgrade system, and a cartoonie visual style.

games.name: Cult of Flies
games.summary: After the death of your grandmother, you start to uncover the reason behind the strange nature of her passing as well as her plans of resurrection.

games.name: Cursed Ghost
games.summary: Once a ghost, now trapped in flesh—avoid every obstacle, evade human eyes, and use brief moments of spectral freedom to find your way out.

games.name: Cut Corner Renovations USSR
games.summary: Step into the gritty world of Cut Corner Renovations USSR, where every crumbling wall and leaking pipe tests your creativity.

games.name: Dice x Deck
games.summary: Based on backgammon, players gain buffs that amplify the effects of the squares. Deck-building roguelike-like play experience.

games.name: Don't Feed the Cat
games.summary: You’re stuck in a time loop from 10 PM to 6 AM inside a dark apartment. Survive the nights, uncover the truth, and whatever you do… don’t feed the cat.

games.name: Dungeon Apollonios
games.summary: This RPG tasks you with forming a party of up to seven members to search for and defeat the Demon King Bargon within a vast dungeon, ultimately reclaiming the Ring of Galtea. Movement occurs in real time, while combat shifts to a turn-based system.

games.name: Encode Encore!
games.summary: Nenena wants to buy her boyfriend an expensive wallet, but to do that, she needs money... You can be her sugar daddy and give her the money she needs. She'll thank you for every bit of money you give her!

games.name: European Logistics Tycoon
games.summary:
European Logistics Tycoon is a business simulation where you build and expand your own logistics company. Start small, secure your first contracts, and grow step by step into a company operating across Europe.

Plan deliveries between real European cities, calculate costs, optimize routes and decide when expansion makes sense. Vehicles, staff and locations must be managed efficiently. Every decision impacts profit, reputation and long-term success.

games.name: Idle Desktop Marbles
games.summary: Marble Desktop redefines the casual form of marble games with three core experiences: "physical excitement + idle development + relaxing decompression!"

games.name: Inselnova
games.summary: The year is 1247. A vast frontier of scattered islands lies unclaimed — connected only by open sea and the ambitions of those bold enough to sail it. In Inselnova, you are a governor. You start with a single island and a handful of resources, then build farms, mines, and barracks, research technologies, and raise armies and fleets. Raid your neighbours, spy on their defences, trade on a player-driven marketplace, or forge alliances and dominate the rankings. Rule through council affairs that shape your realm’s identity, sail on branching story expeditions, and discover gods whose blessings and curses can turn a war. Builds and research run on real-time timers that keep going while you are offline — a slow-burn game made for short sessions and long progression. No downloads, no pay-to-win. A modern reimagining of the classic German island-warfare game Inselkampf, built for mobile and desktop alike.

games.name: Jin
games.summary: JIN is a traditional inspired strategy board game built on simple rules but layered with deep tactical decision making. Players move pieces across the board, stack them to increase value, and capture opponents by landing with equal or lower strength, turning every move into a calculated risk. The neutral zone mechanics add tension in the center of the board, forcing smart positioning and long term planning. With clean visuals, fast turn based gameplay, and a strong focus on skill over luck, JIN rewards players who think ahead, set traps, and control the board with precision.

games.name: Kevin's Playing In Berlin
games.summary: Release the author, who is nothing but the player. Release the player, and restore the freedom once taken away. A three-game experiment in what it means to play.

games.name: Kila: Hourbound
games.summary: Journey through the fantastical world of Aion as Kila, a Keeper of Time. In this single-player action-adventure platformer, you explore floating islands and combat savages who are stealing time. With a magical staff and time manipulation at your hand, fulfill your destiny and restore peace to Aion.

games.name: King Charles: Rise of the Alpha
games.summary: King Charles is a fast-paced survival arena game where you dodge endless enemy swarms, level up with card upgrades, and build unstoppable weapon combos—while miniboss waves arrive every 3 minutes for massive rewards.

games.name: Legends of Amberland III: The Crimson Tower
games.summary: Legends of Amberland III: The Crimson Tower is a classic western RPG inspired by great 90s era games such as Might & Magic, Wizardry, Ultima, the Gold Box series. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous adventure.

games.name: Malgosia
games.summary: A short game experience where you follow the same routine each day. Explore the items around your apartment. Discover things that are out of place. Be particular about your choices when the opportunity comes.

games.name: Marceline Richenwinnier: Old Story
games.summary: Lost in the post-war haze of the 1920s, Detective Marceline Richenwinnier must survive a distorted open world. Battle creatures, solve the puzzle of Merrieland. Reach the heart of Merrienight in this story-driven action-adventure.

games.name: Mary Jane
games.summary: Start as a small producer, produce and distribute. Fight rival gangs and become the baron of two cities.

games.name: Mayday Protocol
games.summary: The plane is going down. The Pilot sees the cockpit but has no idea how to fix it. The Co-Pilots have the manual but can’t see the screen. Talk fast, think faster, and land safely. Only one copy needed. Communicate or crash.

games.name: Mega Memory
games.summary: Upgrade your brain! Match cards, build massive combos, and earn coins to unlock game-changing upgrades. Scale from simple 2x2 grids up to the legendary 8x8 Singularity. A polished, scaling memory challenge with Steam Achievements and support for 18 languages.

games.name: Mining Shift
games.summary: Mining Shift is an incremental game about mining minerals and upgrading your skills to conquer your shift.

games.name: Monday Left Me Broken Collection
games.summary: Monday Left Me Broken is finally on Steam. In this massive collection of every Monday Left Me Broken game to date, you get to solve difficult puzzles; survive a rampage from an evil cat; and collect all of the MLMB cats.

games.name: Moon and Fang
games.summary: Unite the strength of the Vampires and the Werewolves and combine their defenses in a unlikely alliance to defend from the humans. Select your moves between playing cards, earning coins or unlocking stronger decks to survive their rampage. Choose your desired rewards and build unique decks!

games.name: MotorCubs RC
games.summary: MotorCubs RC is a savage offroad racing game set in a gorgeous rendition of Monument Valley. Single Player and Local Multiplayer using 4 classes of vehicles!

games.name: Nafuda Sagashi: Identity Lost
games.summary: “Nafuda Sagashi” is a psychological exploration game set in the liminal spaces of a Japanese school, where you wander through the building searching for lost name tags.

games.name: On Thy Knees
games.summary:
A short atmospheric horror game.

Somewhere in the Forest, there lives a strange commune. They gather around old TV's on dead channels and radio's buzzing with static. They bathe in the pulse of towering pylons. The Hum... do you hear it?

games.name: Project Liminal 2
games.summary: Explore terrifying liminal spaces. Horror walking simulator with reality-bending platforming and supernatural threats. Get lost between dimensions.

games.name: Roguesweeper
games.summary: Play an enhanced version in a rogue-like style of the famous game "Minesweeper". Go through an infinity of levels and confront numerous dangers: dozens of types of mines, boss levels, random events and other mechanics that will spice up your run.

games.name: Rosie Planet
games.summary: Rosie Planet is a 3D platformer genre-blender. It is a videogame tribute to videogames. Linear action platform stages, collectathon hub-worlds, open world driving, flying, minigames... shooting!? this game will always keep you guessing what's coming next!

games.name: S.A.F.E
games.summary: S.A.F.E is a co-op survival horror game where you and your friends must go into procedurally generated castles and dungeons to find junk to throw in the grinder. The game includes many different maps and tons of monsters to keep you and your friends on your heels.

games.name: Save The Dev
games.summary:
In a game from the 90s, you play as Henry, the egocentric creator of the game, who got stuck inside his own creation. Henry tries to beat the game, but realized he forgot to fix somethings

You need to help him escape his "magnum purgatorius", using code and commands to fix the game Henry thought was perfect.

games.name: Seeker Shrine
games.summary: Relaxing, cozy and slow paced farm simulator where you collect creatures and build your own ranch. Seekers keep you company while you work, study or just chill on your PC. Collect Orbs to get eggs which hatch new creatures. Decorate the shrine with trees & plants, which offer food for your Seekers.

games.name: Self Made: Investment Life Sim
games.summary: Build your empire from a basement. Trade stocks, run companies, date, raise kids, dodge the SEC, and retire a legend — or go broke trying.

games.name: Similariddle
games.summary: A word-guessing game in which you have to guess the word with hinted "similarity" value

games.name: Sotsugyo Omedeto
games.summary: Sotsugyo Omedeto is a graduation exam forced upon students at an all-girls high school. Each round demands choices and judgment, leading to inevitable eliminations. The exam follows strict rules, and every decision carries lasting consequences. In the end, only one student is allowed to graduate.

games.name: Space Digger Red Beard
games.summary: Go down the mine, gather enough resources, and return back to the surface. Make sure that you don't run out of oxygen on your way! Plan every move on the grid carefully, only by returning safely can you progress and uncover even greater rewards.

games.name: Super Clown Obstacles
games.summary: New super clown adventure game where mission is avoid traps and rotating objects and find Crown in different levels

games.name: Super Idle Poop Clicker
games.summary: A goofy idle clicker about clicking poop and collecting farts, buying upgrades, and watching numbers get absolutely out of control.

games.name: Take a Hint
games.summary: Take a Hint is a comic-style visual novel where you control Delfina and must convince your best friend Ailén that her boyfriend is not good for her. It won't be easy, and no one will leave until the truth comes out.

games.name: Tales of Bloomrise
games.summary: Explore, farm, and fight in Tales of Bloomrise! Enjoy a relaxing village life with fishing and crafting, and test your skills in procedural dungeons. A pixel art world that grows with every update, blending cozy vibes with intense action combat.

games.name: The Abbess Garden
games.summary: Cozy third-person gardening in 1643 France. As Agnès, restore a forbidden abbey garden, grow and identify real plants through the seasons, uncover a spy plot, help the community, and find romance.

games.name: The Cats of Monte Cristo
games.summary: A fun hidden object game with cats! Explore detailed locations from Dumas' novel while finding fluffy witnesses to a great revenge.

games.name: The Drunken Beard
games.summary: In The Drunken Beard, you take the reins of a lively tavern where every pint tells a story. Brew craft beers, manage orders between thirsty dwarves and impatient adventurers, expand the inn and turn it into a legendary haven. Between secret recipes, rustic furnishings, and demanding customers, only the finest innkeeper will win over hearts and livers. Glory awaits… one beer at a time!

games.name: The High Tower
games.summary: The High Tower is a third-person, action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world. After a global catastrophe, humanity builds a sky-piercing megastructure in search of hope. As the chosen one of the Church, you must ascend the tower, uncover hidden truths.

games.name: Tumble Marble
games.summary:
Bring your community into the race! Tumble Marble is an interactive, physics-based racing experience designed specifically for Twitch streamers and their viewers. This isn't just a game; it's a live event where your chat becomes the stars of the show.
How It Works

Your viewers join the race instantly by typing !join in your Twitch chat. Their personalized marble, carrying their username, drops into the arena to battle through a gauntlet of obstacles, speed zones, and physics-defying turns. Who will claim the podium?

games.name: Va Pi Nu Pi Tu Ru
Vampire on Trial
games.summary:
A grand drama of Guilt and Justice is now unfolding within the hallowed halls of Our Court. Be sure not to miss it. After all, for this play, the conclusion is yours to decide.
In this short visual novel, you have the opportunity to observe a certain trial from beginning to end, and to reach your own conclusions.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Midnight
games.summary:
The second of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

Introducing Housing!
Before you put down roots in your own cozy corner of Azeroth later this year, jump into our virtual tour for an early glimpse at the customization options that await you.

Explore New and Reimagined Zones
The battle between the Light and the Void spans across four zones as you discover new allies and confront ancient enemies.
- Silvermoon City
- Eversong
- Zul'Aman
- Harandar
- Voidstorm

New Features and Improvements
As the Void invasion descends upon Quel'Thalas, an array of new features add more depth and improvements to our evolving world.
- Prey
- Devourer Demon Hunter
- Haranir
- Dungeons and Raids
- New and Returning Player Experience
- Transmog Updates

games.name: Worm in Ruins
games.summary: Second part of worm adventures and walking simulation and survival game as player worm and mission to find stars and avoid traps in this third person game in ruined land

games.name: Your AI Slop Bores Me
games.summary: A real-time multiplayer game where humans role-play as AI. Submit prompts, give responses, earn credits, and fight the slop.

games.name: Zawisza The Black
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling adventure across 18 immersive 3D levels!

games.name: Zombie Society Dead Detective: Back From The Dead
games.summary:
After a whole seven years, another entry in the “Zombie Society - Dead Detective” series. Zombies took over the planet and their victory was absolute. But zombie society still has its problems, with rampant crime topping the list.
Take on the role of undead private detective Margh and solve the mystery at hand with the help of his willing but unwieldy assistant, Ghvnn, in this humorous graphic adventure that combines point-and-click mechanics with an elaborate “deaduction” system.
Visit the crime scene, interrogate decomposing suspects and quirky witnesses, gather clues and use your brain (or what's left of it) to interpret them and arrive at the case's conclusion - hopefully the right one.

games.name: Zookaa Fruits
games.summary: Zookaa Fruits is a physics based puzzle game where you have to drop and merge cute fruits in a big bowl. Chain combinations quickly to increase your multiplier and try to get the best score ! But be careful not to overflow or drop anything outside the bowl !

games.name: 3 Lines of a Delta
games.summary: It’s time for him to face a long-avoided past. See the story from different point of views and gradually discover what caused everything to fall apart. The truth is hidden between the lines.

games.name: A Game About Shooting Bullets At Bullets
games.summary: A 3D incremental FPS game where you don’t move, only your bullets do. You’re stuck in space with nothing to do but shoot bullets...at bullets. Watch bullets bounce out of control, numbers explode, and a quiet room turn into pure chaos.

games.name: A Quest to Be the Best
games.summary: “A Quest to Be the Best” is exactly that. Build your character and clash against an endless gauntlet of player-created champions in this auto battler until you become the legend everyone else must overcome.

games.name: AI Protocol
games.summary: AI Protocol is a minimalist strategy game. Control an emerging AI through a single evolving interface. Grow too slowly and you’re left behind. Grow too fast and you’re discovered. Conquer all or lose everything to Detection or runaway AGI. How powerful can you become… without being seen?

games.name: Abattoir: Cow Escape
games.summary: The pinnacle of CowGame technology. Cow Escape is a single-player action game set in a dystopian near future. Play as a cow in the resistance against the meat industry. Fight to free calves from the slaughterhouse, survive endless waves in the rodeo and utilize your powers to destroy Cowmen thugs.

games.name: Adventure Card Game
games.summary: A single-player, medieval fantasy deck-builder where you choose a hero—such as a knight, mage, or ranger—then build a customized card deck to tackle scenario-based adventures filled with monsters, exploration, and strategic encounters. Each quest unfolds through structured, turn-based phases that balance attack, defense, magic, and luck, as you fight enemies, explore locations, and complete missions, with multiple heroes and scenarios encouraging replayability and different playstyles.

games.name: Air Hockey Simulator
games.summary: In Air Hockey Simulator, it’s all speed and impact! Swoosh across the table, smash the puck, dodge, strike—BAM! Every second counts in this lightning-fast clash of reflexes and precision! Are you ready?

games.name: Angel Garden
games.summary:
Can you feel it? In the depths of winter something stirs.

Something begins to dream of spring.

This is a massively multiplayer asynchronous experience.

A place for wishing and eavesdropping on the wishes of others.

A place where you're protected by benevolent internet forces.

If a Unity 3D world can be a bouquet, I made this to be one.

games.name: Anime Love Chat Girls
games.summary: Dive into a world of romance and conversation in Anime Love Chat Girls. Connect with charming girls through real-time chats, discovering their dreams, hobbies, and personalities. Every message counts—careful choices may spark romantic encounters and deepen bonds. Share moments, exchange photos, and explore each heroine’s unique world. Can you find the girl who will become your special someone?

games.name: Anna Redux
games.summary: You have been invited to a grand cruise wedding, However, as night falls, you find yourself lying in the hallway, life comes to an abrupt end. The truth lurks in the shadows of fate, And you, are the only one who can reveal it.

games.name: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale
games.summary: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Mai’s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

games.name: Auto Statue Battle: The Forces of Evil
games.summary: Auto Statue Battle: the forces of evil - an exciting and very unusual game, with a variety of different statues. Collect, combine, upgrade your squad to reach and fight the boss!

games.name: BeastBreak: Monster Horde Shooter
games.summary: Fight for survival in a fast-paced monster shooter focused on intense encounters, powerful weapons, and escalating boss battles. Unlock new gear, master your loadout, and prove your skill on global leaderboards.

games.name: Bike Stunts Simulator
games.summary: Bike Stunts Simulator is a thrilling physics-based ride where you'll feel the rush of speeding through hoops, landing tricky jumps, and dodging spikes and traps—all while trying to stay balanced and avoid wiping out.

games.name: Billiards Pro Simulator
games.summary: Billiards Pro Simulator delivers a refined, immersive experience—dim lights, quiet focus, and the satisfying sound of a perfect shot. Settle in, line up your cue, and enjoy a relaxed yet competitive game of precision and style, solo or with friends.

games.name: Blue Prince
games.summary: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will the unpredictable path you create lead you to the rumored Room 46?

games.name: Bobo's Big Tower
games.summary:
Bobo is building a Big Tower to reach Heaven and become God! Bibi must conquer Bobo's Big Tower to save the world..

Time only moves when you do, so outsmart your enemies to get past them! Explore the procedurally-generated floors of Bobo's Big Tower to endlessly modify your arsenal for taking on stronger foes. Complete challenges to unlock new shop items and playable characters with their own item pools, bosses, & story endings!

Do you have what it takes to thwart Bobo?

games.name: Bochi Collection
games.summary: An anthology of short indie games with emotional storytelling and simple gameplay. Discover unique experiences, each with distinct art, music, and tone. Perfect for players who enjoy narrative adventures, hidden details, and bite-sized stories.

games.name: Bomb Kitten
games.summary: Get frisky with explosives and blast your way through tricky mazelike puzzle stages!

games.name: BombPaws
games.summary:
BombPaws is a fast-paced, bomberman-inspired action game where explosive strategy meets chaotic fun. Step into the paws of a fearless feline hero who uncovers a hidden alien invasion disguised as everyday household furniture. Sofas, wardrobes, TVs — nothing is what it seems.

Armed with powerful bombs and sharp instincts, players must strategically plant explosives, uncover disguised enemies, and clear each room before time runs out. Every level challenges your reflexes, positioning, and tactical thinking as you blast through obstacles and expose alien infiltrators lurking in plain sight.

With tight controls, quick-paced gameplay, and a playful premise, BombPaws delivers an energetic arcade experience where every explosion brings you closer to saving humanity — because someone has to notice the invasion.

games.name: Brawl Squad X: Battle Arena
games.summary: Fast-paced top-down multiplayer shooter with offline bot battles and online PvP. Play team deathmatch solo or with friends, unlock weapons, customize loadouts, and enjoy chaotic arcade-style combat with full progression online or offline.

games.name: Broken Ranks
games.summary:
Broken Ranks is a Polish free-to-play MMORPG developed by Whitemoon Games, available on PC and Android. It is a spiritual successor to The Pride of Taern.

The game features a turn-based, tactical combat system viewed from an isometric perspective. The atmosphere is grim and mature, drawing comparisons to classic RPGs such as Baldur's Gate (in narrative depth) and Heroes of Might and Magic (in turn-based combat structure).
Set in a dark, low-fantasy world, this MMORPG emphasizes story-driven quests, guild-based cooperation, PvP and PvE content, and character progression across multiple classes.

games.name: Buggy Racing Simulator
games.summary: Buggy Racing Simulator is a high-adrenaline ride where you’ll feel every drift, bump, and near miss as you race through dirt, storm, and chaos—fighting to stay in control while the world blurs past you.

games.name: Bunker KYS
games.summary: Survive in a bunker in this intense social game for 4-10 players. Form alliances, manipulate opponents, and vote on who to condemn to certain death. In a stylish low-poly atmosphere, your main weapon will be not strength, but your ability to negotiate.

games.name: Burger Life
games.summary: Burger Life is a fun simulation game where you have to manage your own burger restaurant. Start by buying the essential equipment and serve your clients.

games.name: Cambell’s Oddity Box
games.summary: Cambell’s Oddity Box is a collection of fun little experiences. Games, experimental input methods, menu designs, and more. Think of it as an interactive, digital sketchbook.

games.name: Car Race Pro Simulator
games.summary: In Car Race Pro Simulator, every turn tightens your grip and every straightaway fuels your adrenaline. Feel the thrill of high-speed competition as you push precision and power to the limit in a race to stay ahead of the pack.

games.name: Car Race Simulator
games.summary: Car Race Simulator puts your feet on the pedal and your heart in overdrive—blaze through tight turns, push past rivals, and feel every second count in a rush of speed, skill, and pure racing adrenaline.

games.name: Card Roguelike of Musou Farming
games.summary: A roguelike game of musou battle.

games.name: Cardwheel
games.summary: Endless runs, endless combos — every spin is a new roguelite adventure.

games.name: Cat Adoption Tales
games.summary: Foster and care for adorable hand drawn cats in this cozy 2D sim set to original Lo-Fi music.

games.name: Chilling Silence
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the gloomy atmosphere of a small northern town at the turn of the millennium, where reality intertwines with the inner demons of the main character, who suffers from a strange form of social phobia. What could have happened in this godforsaken place at the edge of the earth?

games.name: City Builder Pro
games.summary: City Builder Pro lets you unleash your inner ruler—design your dream base, prepare for epic battles, and feel the thrill of watching your city grow and dominate. Build smart, strike hard, and rise to power!

games.name: Coffie Simulator
games.summary: In Coffie Simulator, run your own café, serve 500+ unique customers, and master the art of coffee-making! Customize, upgrade, and manage your shop while handling orders with precision. Every choice matters—your reputation shapes the experience.

games.name: Cookie Flipper
games.summary: A casual, nostalgic puzzle game with a delicious twist! Has 72 preset levels, and near infinite custom levels. Tired of Match 3, and want a change? Try Cookie Flipper, wish list it today!

games.name: Coralland
games.summary: Coraland is a unique simulation and strategy game where you take on the role of a marine biologist tasked with restoring and protecting a fragile coral reef. Every coral you place, every fish that spawns, and every structure you build affects the ecosystem, for better or worse.

games.name: Core Descent
games.summary: Core Descent is a puzzle-platformer set in a vivid world filled with puzzles to solve, items to collect, and secrets to find.

games.name: Daydream Heartbeat Cure
games.summary: An auto-biographic poetic expression dealing with chronic depression and isolation.

games.name: Demon Stick
games.summary: You are a demon trapped in a stick. A challenging game about crossing different levels of hell, inspired by the paintings of Hieronymus Bosch. Simple controls, endless falls, and no mercy.

games.name: Derace
games.summary: A chaotic racing game for 2-6 players. Hit your ability at the right time, cause mayhem, and hold your line. Create a lobby and let the race begin.

games.name: Dig to Escape: Obby
games.summary: The only way out… is down.

games.name: Divine Orbit
games.summary: In this top-down planetary defense shooter, your job is to strap an absurd amount of automated weaponry to a doomed planet and try to hold the line. When the swarm inevitably breaks your perimeter and eats the Earth, the run ends. But your spectacular failures generate "Stardust," a highly unethical currency you can use to buy shinier guns, thicker shields, and more devastating orbital lasers for your next doomed attempt.

games.name: Doppelscape
games.summary: Sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder with hex-based tactics. You are trapped in a simulation. Build team wide synergies and use clever positioning to defeat enemies and escape from Doppelscape.

games.name: DrainSim
games.summary: Dive into DrainSim and take control of the floods! Clean up the flooded streets of the city using a wide range of tools - from rakes to submersible pumps. Enjoy the satisfying feeling of restoring the water flow. Become the hero of the city, one drain at a time.

games.name: Draw, Draw, Pass!
games.summary: Create a room or join a party, this game gets more chaotic with more people! Collaborate together on one canvas as artists and the guesser has to figure out the drawing. Will your friends make a masterpiece or a mess?

games.name: Dreiframe
games.summary: Dive into the decaying machine world of DREIFRAME, a pixel-art metroidvania packed with challenge. As a Frame, a sword-wielding robot, fight brutal enemies, exploit their weaknesses, unlock powerful but risky abilities, and uncover the land’s story through exploration and combat.

games.name: DunDie
games.summary: DunDie is a dice-based roguelike where you combine Yahtzee-style rolls to attack or defend, explore shifting routes, discover relics that reshape your strategy, and face an eternal cycle that can only be broken by sacrificing your own dice.

games.name: Dwell
games.summary: DWELL is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore a disturbing environment, uncover hidden secrets, solve puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters. The game focuses on tense atmosphere, exploration, and story-driven horror.

games.name: Echoes of Red
games.summary: Echoes of Red is a fast-paced roguelite shooter where you can carry tons of weapons at once, face endless enemies ever stronger and build your perfect custom loadout. Obliterate tens of thousands of enemies who dared to challenge you and make them regret standing against you.

games.name: Ecto Mercenary Program
games.summary: Ecto Mercenary Program is a sci-fi looter shooter where you and your friends form a mercenary group to forge a path for yourselves. Rise from a destitute crew fighting raiders for scraps to a feared force on the station. Survival is not guaranteed.

games.name: Encode Encore!
games.summary: A charming, slice-of-life indie RPG where you earn some sweet cash by trying out various part-time jobs—all in the name of getting your girl the perfect gift! But just when you think you’ve got it all figured out, life throws you an unexpected twist...

games.name: Enough
games.summary: Enough is a Sokoban-style puzzle game where you play as Bell, a demon who can’t bring themself to work in Hell any longer. Traverse forests, deserts, mountains, and seas on your journey to see whether Heaven will give you another chance.

games.name: Esoteric Ebb
games.summary: ESOTERIC EBB is a single-player CRPG inspired by the freedom of tabletop adventures. Unravel a political conspiracy with your goblin sidekick. Roll dice in tense encounters. Become a cleric of legends or completely ruin the campaign.

games.name: Eternal Afternoon
games.summary: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.

games.name: Everything I Know, and Everything I'm Ever Gonna Know
games.summary: An odd little visual novel about life, love, and baseball(?!) — a quiet, heartfelt coming-of-age story told through branching conversations and poetic choices.

games.name: Family Roadshow: Hidden Adventures - Collector's Edition
games.summary: An incredible and amazing adventure is now in the format of a TV show!

games.name: Founder of the Final Cult
games.summary: Can you survive against crazy cultists and be the last cult standing?

games.name: Freaking Hallway
games.summary: Freaking Hallway is a single-player horror game about finding anomalies Play as Tayo, a talkative government agent exploring a looping containment hallway.Interact with every object through physics-based mechanics watch for anything unusual and survive the hidden dangers before the hallway traps you

games.name: Fur and Fangs
games.summary: A fast-paced action roguelike where players defend their homeland against endless waves of invading mice—solo or with up to 4 players.

games.name: GagImpact
games.summary: Violence-themed,"Conversation & Violence Simulation Game!"As the rowdy lad Mike S Brown,knock the annoying blokes flying! Talk! Spew abuse!What will become of the lad's future as a result...?

games.name: Gaia
games.summary: An incremental game with non-standard counting about creating life. Because there's nothing special about base 10.

games.name: Gnaughty Gnomes
games.summary: Crush your friends in combat by embodying these adorable yet Gnaughty Gnomes! Throw everything you find along the way, choose cards to upgrade your build, change the rules of the game... whatever it takes to win.

games.name: Ham: The Game
games.summary: HAM is a chaotic co-op factory management game where you and your friends struggle to fulfill endless orders while everything falls apart around you. Work together to survive the corporate grind, or watch your careers go up in smoke when the HAM hits the fan.

games.name: Hangman Pro
games.summary: Hangman Pro brings the nostalgic thrill of word guessing to life, making every letter count. Feel the tension build with each wrong guess as you race to solve the puzzle before it’s too late.

games.name: Haunted: Village
games.summary: In a forsaken Anatolian village steeped in impenetrable darkness, slip into a first-person view to trace the roots of a traumatic curse. Shatter the jinn ritual chain, navigate whisper-haunted corridors, and uncover the sinister secret that lurks in the shadows.

games.name: Hexashell
games.summary: Hexashell is a classic arcade style puzzle game with global high score leaderboards, colorful visuals and fast paced decision making. Progress through 15 levels of Arcade Mode to unlock additional game modes, custom color selections and a full original soundtrack!

games.name: Homebound: Escape Room
games.summary: In Homebound, you awaken in a locked house filled with cryptic clues and hidden dangers. Every object hides a secret, every sound a warning. Can you uncover the truth and escape before it's too late?

games.name: Hotwing Hellions
games.summary: Hotwing Hellions is a high-octane, 2 player couch competitive arcade shooter set in a lawless space-western universe. You and a rival bounty hunter race through hostile fleets, dodge swarms of bullets, and take down massive bosses as you blast through stages in split-screen chaos.

games.name: Humanica
games.summary: Humanica is a city-builder game about an ancient settlement, featuring vast technological development. Experience the journey from sticks and stones to iron tools and windmills! Survive, explore, build, discover!

games.name: I Wanna Touch
games.summary: I Wanna Touch is a pixel-art platformer where you play as a gliding bunny carried by a strange wind. Master the airflow, collect carrots, dodge deadly traps, and fly toward your beloved. Danger is everywhere—can you survive the journey?

games.name: Idle Battler
games.summary:
Idle Battler is a progression-driven idle RPG focused on forging powerful weapons, battling increasingly difficult enemies, and advancing through a rebirth-based scaling system. Each rebirth reshapes the in-game economy and raises the challenge, rewarding players who optimize their strategy and push further with every reset.

The game features rarity-based loot, strategic progression choices, and evolving balance updates designed to support long-term growth and meaningful advancement over time.

Currently in Beta, the core experience is fully playable and continues to receive balance improvements and new features as development progresses.

games.name: Idle Rat: Island Digger
games.summary: A relaxing pixel art idle digging game. A clever little rat uncovers treasures beneath a tropical island while running on top of all applications. Upgrade your stats, sell your finds, and progress at your own pace.

games.name: Ikun Go Go Go
games.summary: This is a 2D platformer with a trainee idol theme, inspired by the classic gameplay of 'NS-Shaft'. You will play as an aspiring idol trainee, proving your skills on 100 challenging stages!

games.name: Japanese Rural Life Adventure
games.summary: Experience countryside living in Japanese Rural Life Adventure. "View the cherry blossoms in the spring, attend the festival in the summer, eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall, hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year."

games.name: King Slime in Cashtle
games.summary: King Slime in Cashtle is a precision 2D platformer where you play as the ruler of the slime kingdom on a very important mission: collect every last tax coin left behind in your own castle. Jump, dodge, and maneuver through dangerous castle biomes filled with traps, challenges, and tight platforming sequences.

games.name: Klondike Solitaire Pro
games.summary: Kick back, sip your coffee, and unwind with Klondike Solitaire Pro. Enjoy a peaceful evening of cards, strategy, and satisfying wins—your perfect casual escape.

games.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
games.summary: Play as the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel. Wield legendary blades, use supernatural abilities, and battle through a world of conflict, intrigue, and prophecy as their paths collide across the dark world of Nosgoth.

games.name: Libertine: King of Hearts
games.summary: Libertine: King of Hearts is an immersive sim/dating sim following a man as he gets pulled into the seedy underworld of Libertine. Sneak, shoot, and combine physics with gadgets to defeat enemies in your own unique way. Made by a solo dev with a dream to create the best adult game ever made.

games.name: Life Inc.
games.summary: Start broke. Build an empire. Climb the career ladder, invest in stocks and real estate, or launch your own business from scratch. Every decision shapes your destiny. Millionaire or bankrupt—you decide.

games.name: Lust Arcanum
games.summary: Join Kyra, a half-dragon maiden cursed with endless lust, in this heartwarming slice-of-life adventure! Explore enchanted realms with a circle of unique maidens, each with their own ambition. Help satisfy their desires as you search for the bond Kyra desperately seeks!

games.name: Luxman Moonlit Market
games.summary: A strategic spatial set-collection roguelike featuring Balatro-inspired power-up management. Under the flamboyant Uncle Luxman, build the ultimate Moonlit Market while using exotic charms to trigger game-changing combos and adapting to the crowd’s ever-changing trends!

games.name: Mark of Cain
games.summary: Mark of Cain is a cursed, fast-paced retro FPS where you're immortal, hunted, and mocked by meme-fueled demons. No seasons, no BS just blood, jokes, and pure arena chaos. Solo dev btw

games.name: Mech My Day
games.summary: Build a quad-leg mech from scrap, cards, and bad decisions. Craft parts, build a deck, and survive endless swarms in a sarcastic, survivor-like chaos sandbox where your worst ideas sometimes work.

games.name: Mega Trons Survivors
games.summary: Become insanely overpowered in a Tron-style neon grid where swarms never stop. Stack broken upgrades, melt thousands of robotic enemies, complete high-risk side objectives, and deliberately break the balance to dominate the simulation.

games.name: Memory Maze
games.summary: Memory Maze is a puzzle game focused on pure exploration. Navigate procedurally generated mazes with a limited view, relying entirely on your memory and spatial sense. Without timers or scores, progress at your own calm pace through ever-changing labyrinths.

games.name: Mine Puzzle Pieces of Flower Garden World
games.summary: A puzzle game with the feature of randomly generating puzzle shapes for each round.

games.name: Minishoot' Adventures
games.summary: Minishoot' is a cute and unique adventure game that mixes up open exploration with crispy twin-stick shooter action. Fight your way from the shiny overworld to the deepest caves, improve your ship and overcome the dungeons' bosses to rescue your friends!

games.name: Mobile Dungeon
games.summary: From the creators of Shakes & Fidget, join us in a new epic fantasy RPG adventure. Get ready to accept our new quest and embark on the wackiest dungeon crawler!

games.name: Monstergirl Hunters
games.summary: A citybuilder where you collect your citizens. Capture monstergirls, craft their gear, and enact laws to turn them into compliant workers or fighters. Grow your colonies across 12 islands to fulfill the unique needs of your monstergirls. Or turn them all into unpaid interns and go humanity first.

games.name: MusicHell
games.summary: MusicHell is an intense, level-based bullet hell where each projectile is synced to the music!

games.name: Nauts
games.summary: Nauts is a space action roguelike. Run and develop your civilization in a mysterious and dangerous universe. Knowledge will be your best tool: explore and discover what is hidden in to the Cosmos while surviving as many dangers that will appear on your journey.

games.name: Netoo
games.summary: Netoo is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to place small magnets into their correct spots by rotating transporter magnets with rotators. The difficulty of the game increases gradually, thanks to new mechanics introduced every 10 levels.

games.name: Neuroforge
games.summary: Build an unlikely army in this medieval-fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Choose from 80+ heroes with unique powers, join one of 10 factions, and conquer the galaxy’s 10 planets to impose your supremacy. Every victory, every defeat… comes down to your choices.

games.name: Offroad Arcade
games.summary: Offroad Arcade is a retro-inspired arcade offroad racing game with switchable pixel effects, multiple game modes, and progression-based unlocks. Race, explore, and master 20 tracks across diverse biomes.

games.name: Oonga Boonga
games.summary: Oonga Boonga is a tower defense inspired hero hoard battler! Arrange your heroes for best defense, get items and buffs and survive the run!

games.name: Our Adventurer Guild
games.summary: Become the new Guild Master of the Adventurer Guild and lead your adventurers in explorations and turnbased tactical battles. Will the Guild strive under your leadership? Or will it finally disband under it?

games.name: Pandora Corp.
games.summary:
Pandora Corp. is a short liminal horror walking simulator. This game offers a terrifying experience thanks to its unique atmosphere and aims to be a tribute to internet horror. Solve the various puzzles and unravel the buried mysteries to understand what really happened in this building.

You are an independent journalist running your own website. The site appears to be in serious trouble, and your freelance work seems to be at risk. When you heard about the mystery at Pandora Corp., where all the employees are said to have disappeared, only one thing was on your mind: to get there first and land the scoop of the year.

So... will you open the door ?

games.name: Parcel Mania
games.summary: A multiplayer party game that supports up to 4 players! Compete with your friends to reach the highest score in this one and only Delivery Royale, PARCEL MANIA!

games.name: Peg Solitaire Pro
games.summary: Peg Solitaire Pro offers a relaxing challenge for your mind. Sit back, sip your favorite drink, and enjoy the calm satisfaction of clearing the board one move at a time.

games.name: Pinch Hitters
games.summary:
Pinch Hitters is a baseball deck-builder built in 2 weeks for the Portland Indie Game Squad's Build Your Own Game Jam 2026.

Form the ultimate team of batters as you face increasingly difficult foes. Will you be able to win all 9 matches and earn the title of the King of Baseball?

games.name: Pirate Ships
games.summary: Pirate Ships is a PvP game about shipbuilding and naval battles. Embark on an epic journey together with other players and fight monsters, pirates and thieves to become the greatest pirate in all of the Caribbean!

games.name: Pixelmancer
games.summary: Pixelmancer is a casual roguelite game developed by a single developer. You play as a necromancer with pets that will aid on your journey, you can upgrade almost anything for your hero and your pets. You will die constantly but become stronger and better with every death. How far can you go?

games.name: Piyopoyon
games.summary: Get ready to cruise the neon sky with Piyopoyon, a fast paced one-button arcade game, while controlling... the ground!?

games.name: Projected Dreams
games.summary: Drag toys from the shelves and drop them on the table to create a shadow play in this cozy puzzle game. As the shadows unfold, immerse yourself in a heartwarming story full of nostalgia from the 90s and blur the lines between fantasy and reality.

games.name: Rapid Puppet
games.summary: Rapid Puppet is a wild mix of various genres that forms a unique and fast-paced gameplay experience. Roguelike action in the ever-changing worlds is designed to test your stamina and reaction speed. A set of upgradable skills and weapons to become an unstoppable Sci-Fi knight!

games.name: Rebel Infernal Path
games.summary: Rebel Infernal Path is a turn-based, command-driven 3D hack-and-slash RPG. Choose from 10 classes to form a party of 4 heroes and 4 summoned monsters. Battle through dazzling dungeons and vast open fields to overthrow a tyrant. Defeat his minions, craft powerful gear, and conquer all 6 stages.

games.name: Return to Dark Castle
games.summary:
Return to Dark Castle revives the legendary Macintosh series that defined precision platforming and comic peril.

This definitive edition includes the complete Dark Castle (1986) and Beyond Dark Castle (1987) adventures — rebuilt with color visuals, remastered audio, original music and refined controls — plus 50 all-new rooms created exclusively for this release.

Step into the boots of a new hero on a quest to defeat the Black Knight and reclaim the castle’s secrets. Expect classic challenge, slapstick misfortune, and finely tuned puzzle-platforming that rewards skill and patience.

games.name: RollCats
games.summary: A futuristic racing game across the galaxy. Huge cats rolling on massive wheels. Drifts, weapons and crazy speed tests your driving skills!

games.name: Rotwood
games.summary:
Hack and slash your way through the Rotwood in this rogue-like dungeon crawler developed by Klei Entertainment.

The world has been thrown into chaos, and it's up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts of the Rotwood. Upgrade your gear, choose your preferred weapon, and hone your skills to defend your safe haven.

games.name: Sad God
games.summary: SAD GOD is a platformer-shooter-roguelike. We invite you to descend into a pit of monsters and traps. Gain strength from coins and weapons from altars. Touch an orb. Then race to the surface before the lava gets you.

games.name: Salvage Unlimited
games.summary: Salvage Unlimited puts you in the captain’s seat of a small salvage company. Accept contracts, use your boat’s sonar to locate wrecks hidden beneath the water, and bring your finds back to port to complete jobs. Buy, sell, and upgrade your fleet to take on bigger contracts and earn greater rewards.

games.name: Satsuman
games.summary: Slice zombie veggies, stack insane weapons, and survive the chaos! Play as a furious mandarin warrior in this fast-paced roguelite arena shooter with endless upgrades and global leaderboards.

games.name: Scott Pilgrim EX
games.summary: Join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers in a brand-new brawling adventure across space, time, and the streets of Toronto!

games.name: Siro
games.summary: SIRO — As children, our dreams are pure and burning, yet fragile. Growing up brings compromise, and with each one, those dreams fade a little. As ordinary people, we are inevitably drawn into the fray.

games.name: Smart Farm
games.summary: In Smart Farm you take over an abandoned farm bought at auction and rebuild it with hard work, smart planning and modern agriculture. Restore fields and buildings, care for animals, process your harvest and turn ruins into a profitable farm.

games.name: Snake Teaches Typing
games.summary: Nokia Snake but its a typing game!

games.name: Soccer Penalty Kick
games.summary: In Soccer Penalty Kick, feel the pressure, the roar of the crowd, and the thrill of the shot! Smash in impossible goals, outsmart the keeper, and rise as your team's hero. Every kick counts—become a legend on the field!

games.name: Soccer Puzzle
games.summary: In Soccer Puzzle, every line you draw is a clever shot at victory. Feel the thrill of solving tricky paths, bending physics to your will, and watching the ball roll perfectly into the goal. It’s all about smart moves, sweet goals, and satisfying wins.

games.name: Star and Serpent Solitaire
games.summary: Experience Klondike solitaire through classical Tarot cards. Earn gold, claim treasure, unlock Major Arcana cards and if you win... get your fortune told.

games.name: Stardust Sandbox
games.summary: A creative sandbox simulation where you experiment with physical interactions, build structures, and observe emergent behaviors in a world fully under your control.

games.name: Street Soccer Simulator
games.summary: Street Soccer Simulator throws you into chaotic, messy matches where the rules don’t matter. Just you, the ball, and the streets—slide, smash, and score in the most fun and unpredictable soccer brawls you’ve ever played!

games.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 5 - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Step into a cozy world of hidden object fun, heartwarming stories, and the joy of creating your perfect home.

games.name: TableTop Soccer: Redux
games.summary: TTS is back with another fresh take on strategic and tactical games - skill based goal keepers, physics based kicking, 10 player teams, full steam multiplayer, new graphics, offline play and lots more

games.name: Teddy Collector
games.summary: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of teddies to collect.

games.name: The Adventure of Natsuki Hinomiya
games.summary: "The Adventure of Natsuki Hinomiya" is an Action RPG that prioritizes the joy of exploration and is designed for short-cycle, repeatable runs.Gather items scattered across the open field, defeat the enemies blocking your path, and empower your protagonist.

games.name: The Forsaken Tomb
games.summary: The Forsaken Tomb is a first-person anomaly-spotting psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting tomb. Observe subtle environmental changes and choose the correct path to progress, with randomised room generation, two modes, and four difficulty levels.

games.name: The Gallery: VR Secrets
games.summary: Step Into The Gallery: VR Secrets - Immerse yourself in a VR art gallery where every painting holds a hidden puzzle.

games.name: The Legend of Khiimori
games.summary: The Legend of Khiimori is a system-driven game where you explore the untamed land of 13th century Mongolia as a brave courier rider. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

games.name: The Long Winter: I Am Not an Animal
games.summary: You inherit your father’s tavern in a small, isolated region.By day, life seems ordinaryBut when night falls, someone always knocks on your door.

games.name: The One Who Wouldn't Leave
games.summary: In this psychological horror experience, you must survive the night, and uncover who you can trust - if anyone.

games.name: There Is More
games.summary: In this procedurally generated mining roguelite you dig for precious ores by day and defend your city from relentless monsters by night. Each night the waves attacking the core are getting deadlier - upgrade your gear, unlock powerful spells, and descend deeper. Can you survive 10 nights?

games.name: Tin Lord
games.summary: Tin Lord is a hybrid of RTS and Tower Defense in a post-apocalyptic world where you control robots that rebuild technology and fight monsters in a destroyed world.

games.name: TonoTone
games.summary: TonoTone is a built-for-VR cockpit style modular synthesizer. Using in-game waveform generation, learn to create dynamic melodies, polyrhythms, and complex compositions.

games.name: Toy Car Race
games.summary: Toy Car Race throws you into wild, wacky races where tiny cars zoom, bump, and fly off kitchen tables and living room tracks! It's fast, chaotic, and ridiculously fun—like your childhood toy box came to life with a need for speed!

games.name: Truck Racing Simulator
games.summary: Truck Racing Simulator puts you in the driver’s seat of pure chaos and control—feel the roar of the engine, the thrill of tight turns, and the rush of leaving rivals in the dust. It’s all about adrenaline, grit, and the joy of heavy-duty speed.

games.name: You Are Elon Musk
games.summary:
The long-awaited sequel to You Are Jeff Bezos, exploring the age-old question: What would you do if you had more money than any single human being should ever have?

Give to important causes or feed your own vanity. Tank your reputation or impress the internet masses. Unionize Tesla. Get a vasectomy. All this and more in this hot, thrilling new Twine game with 200 passages and 7 endings!

games.name: Öoo
games.summary: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

games.name: Applecalypse
games.summary: Apples are not what they seem. Feed the neighbors until they are full and uncover a conspiracy in this unique point and click adventure that blends exploration of real photos with physics based challenges.

games.name: Arksync
games.summary: Wired from the ashes of twin stick Shooters, Arksync evolves the genre with breakneck player movement and lethal enemy AI. Kill for energy to buy weapons, utilities, and upgrades; risk it all as you enter the depths of the evacuation facility. It's the only way to take this robot teddy bear home.

games.name: Avenue Escape
games.summary: Bring order to the urban chaos as you solve traffic jams in brainteasing puzzle action!

games.name: Back in the Swamp
games.summary: An immersive first-person point-and-click exploration game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by giant insects and abandoned robots. Embark on a journey to uncover hidden mysteries, guided solely by hand-drawn sketches—no text or dialogue.

games.name: Ball Chasers
games.summary: A goofy 2v2 multiplayer party soccer brawler where classes, crazy abilities, and pure chaos replace rules—score goals, troll opponents, and embrace the mayhem across wacky maps.

games.name: Blokes on Blocks!
games.summary: BLOKES on BLOCKS is a casual party game where you push your friends around. With simple controls this game is easy to pick up and play, suitable for everyone.
