Your actions happen just by moving around. Timing is everything so predict your blokes' next moves and knock them off their blocks!

games.name: Casino Boss Simulator
games.summary: Casino Boss Simulator is a casino management simulation game that turns your dream of building a casino empire from scratch into reality. Manage, expand, and lead your own casino empire in the competitive world of gambling.

games.name: Chick'n Mushroom Soup
games.summary: Chick’n Mushroom Soup is an anime styled Visual Novel which you've been accepted into a culinary academy with sweet girls. Although you were a total asocial in the past, you now have an opportunity to change this.

games.name: Chronominion Idler
games.summary: Manage your party, develop skills, and shape the fate of a living world in this strategy-driven RPG.

games.name: Console Archives: Nobunaga's Ambition
games.summary:
An undying masterpiece—the ultimate long-running legend!

"Nobunaga's Ambition" was released by Koei in 1988 for an 8-bit home console.
In this historical simulation game, you become a Sengoku daimyo with the ultimate goal of unifying all of Japan.
As the tides of war shift from moment to moment, you must determine how to enrich your domain, strengthen your military, and conquer rival nations. Use every ounce of your ingenuity to bring an end to the turbulent Sengoku period!

games.name: Creepy Shift: Uncle Joe’s Motel
games.summary: Unknown actress takes a job at Uncle’s Motel to make ends meet. She’s running from trouble — but peace is the last thing she’ll find here. A surreal blend of simulation, horror, and psychological depth, wrapped in a noir atmosphere.

games.name: Cryptical Path
games.summary: Cryptical Path is a thrilling rogue-lite dungeon crawler that pushes the boundaries of the genre. Play the Architect, build your own path, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth you've been summoned in.

games.name: Don't Click The Flower
games.summary:
Don't Click the Flower is a narrative personality test where every choice matters.
Answer the questions… but remember the only rule: Don’t click the flower.

games.name: Double Date Dilemma
games.summary: In this visual novel with E-mote animated sprites by veteran studio ANIM, after trying and failing to have children, the Kajiuras decided to attend a relationship seminar to fix the problem. There they meet the Sonadas and as the sessions continue, their lives begin to entwine more and more...

games.name: Dr. Alb's Prodigy
games.summary: Dr. Alb's Prodigy is a Roguelike Action RPG which combines turn-based and real-time combat. Play as a bio-mechanical android and help the doctor prevent the apocalypse.

games.name: EBaseball: Pro Spirit
games.summary: Experience authentic baseball with players from around the world. Feel the arc of every hit, the intensity behind each play, and the roar of the crowd surrounding the stadium. With stunning presentation, the game captures the true intensity of real baseball.

games.name: EOS Black
games.summary: "Eos Black" is a dark fantasy MMORPG published by DiGeam in Taiwan. Set in the wake of a cataclysmic war between ancient gods and the King of Giants, the land is slowly being consumed by lingering hatred and malice. Players will step into the shoes of the "Arcana," individuals gifted with the power of purification, to embark on a perilous journey.

games.name: Exelio
games.summary: In "Exelio," you'll face an ever-changing environment and various threats while acquiring the knowledge and skills needed to survive in uncharted lands. Explore a world where beautiful nature and harsh realities collide, and delve into its mysteries as you carve out your own fate.

games.name: Freerunners
games.summary: Become a freerunner. Find a flow and underlying rhythm of movement through your environment. Vault, climb, jump, duck, swing, flip, slide, do what it takes to travel as fast as possible whilst using your environment to outwit the enemy henchmen and save your friend.

games.name: Fruits vs. Veggies
games.summary: Fruits Vs Veggies is a team-based party platformer where you and your friends compete in a series of fast-paced minigames. Put your skills to the test by using a range of items to outperform your foes, or explore the vast campaign to uncover the origins of the carnage.

games.name: Fumpers 2: Dual Realms
games.summary: Fumpers 2 delivers a chaotic platforming experience that tests your reflexes and patience. Stay alert through physics-based gameplay, surprising obstacles, and challenging levels. Don’t fall. Don’t quit.

games.name: Gaia Maker
games.summary: Gaia Maker is a planet-wide simulation game of terraforming, based on real physics and geology. As the planet's overseer, wield advanced technologies to reshape barren planets into life-filled worlds. Foster animal life, cultivate civilizations, or destroy them. Their fate is in your hands.

games.name: Gatherlands
games.summary: Gatherlands is a game of exploration, survival, and crafting on magical islands. Control a wizard who awakens from ice, rescue villagers, solve mysteries, and fight against the darkness!

games.name: Gladiator Command
games.summary: A gladiator management sim inspired by the depth and progression of Football Manager. Train fighters, hire staff, manage finances, build prestige, buy and sell gladiators, develop traits and stat based skills, and let real-time arena battles decide your rise.

games.name: Goose vs. Zombies
games.summary: Wake up, Goose, your village is invaded by zombies. Solve puzzles, open paths for exploration, defeat enemies. Hooonk!

games.name: Grind TD
games.summary: The gate is open, but it doesn't go across — it goes below. And something is coming up. As the ruler of a pixel realm, you will command the clash of strategies, dive deep into attack and defense, and experience the purest form of the tower defense world.

games.name: Hajimeow: Tiny Box Cat
games.summary: Hajimeow: Tiny Box Cat is a cute companion that responds to every keystroke and mouse click by raising signs. With an integrated Pomodoro timer, this little buddy accompanies you through your daily tasks, making work and study sessions more enjoyable and focused.

games.name: Hamstory
games.summary: is a 2D pixel platformer with heartfelt emotion and thrilling challenge. Time your jumps to leap forward—falling is okay. Find your route through the paths ahead. Journey to Haessi Star with warm encouragement from animal townsfolk, experiencing a world that transforms with every season.

games.name: Hatch Dragons
games.summary: Discover Dragons like you’ve never seen before! Collect and care for hundreds of unique Dragons, uncovering their origins as they grow. From playful Cat Dragons to rare Bluebell Dragons, every new Dragon you hatch and raise brings this cozy, peaceful world to life.

games.name: He Followed Me
games.summary: He Followed Me is a psychological horror experience about an ordinary man who begins noticing the same car outside the places he visits. What starts as a minor disagreement slowly turns into something far more unsettling. Sometimes, the scariest things aren’t supernatural… they’re real.

games.name: Hell Forge
games.summary: Hell Forge is a retro roguelite survivor where you battle endless monsters to mine souls for the ultimate gamble. Locate the Hell Forge on the map and risk your resources in a high-stakes lottery system to craft Legendary gear.

games.name: Homura Hime
games.summary: "Homura Hime" is a third person action game, featuring Japanese anime visuals and intense 3D bullet curtain gameplay. Alongside Homurahime, fight against Demon Girls possessed by deviant "emotions", and get closer to discovering the truth of not only the fallen, but also your own veiled legacy.

games.name: Hunt Zombies Together
games.summary: Hunt Zombies Together is a co-op multiplayer FPS survival horror game where you and your friends battle waves of zombies and supernatural enemies inside a cursed mansion. Can be played by 1 to 4 people.

games.name: Idle Quest Simulator
games.summary: No complex operations required! Auto-battle through the Underworld, traverse the Dragon Palace, and retrieve the True Scriptures with full idle gameplay.

games.name: Ju-men: Cursed Masks
games.summary: “JU-MEN: Cursed Masks” is a short horror game about organizing countless masks and noticing subtle anomalies. Masks may change when you’re not looking—their color, shape, gaze, or position. What you notice depends on how carefully you’ve arranged them.

games.name: Kingdom Dice
games.summary: Become a lord in a world of feudal greed in the turn-based economic board game Kingdom Dice. Build an empire, buy lands, collect taxes from friends, trade, and bankrupt everyone around you! (ง •̀_•́)ง

games.name: Kingdom Of Choices
games.summary: Kingdom of Choices is a Rogue-Lite visual novel game with multiple outcomes. Players must make challenging decisions regarding politics, military, economics, health, religion, and the public as their characters evolve. Send them to rule your kingdom!

games.name: KunKunNest
games.summary: You accidentally entered Kun Kun Nest, where there is a terrifying demon Kun Kun who loves to scare its prey. If you feel anything unusual in the room, please escape quickly.

games.name: Land Drifters
games.summary: Land Drifters is an incremental RPG game that can be played idle or active. Explore islands, unlock new skills and combat classes, overcome obstacles, and more! The game is jam-packed with many paths of progression intertwined throughout the game!

games.name: Lantern Push
games.summary: Light the right path in Lantern Push, a charming puzzle game where you control a red panda pushing paper lanterns onto Magical Ember Seals scattered across the ground. When a lantern reaches a seal, magic happens: it lights up, floats gently, and marks another step toward the perfect solution.

games.name: Lines: A Gift for Mom
games.summary: I reprogrammed a classic elimination game as a birthday gift for my mom to thank her for family dedication, and to honor all mothers. When moving balls, 5+ same-colored balls in a line (any direction) will be eliminated.

games.name: Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why
games.summary: "Life sometimes feels like it’s going in circles." Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why is a short pixel art Visual Novel about a girl who tell herself this, forever. Maybe you can try to help her ?

games.name: Lost In Reefs 2
games.summary: Play the sequel of the underwater Match3 game "Lost in Reefs" from Rumbic Studio. While other Match-3 games support only one gameplay mode (Swap or Chain), Lost in Reefs 2 goes a step further by now including 4 game modes.

games.name: Lux Muris
games.summary: The rats, whispering in the shadows, spoke in riddles about the unnatural light. A subtle, almost imperceptible hum fills the air. You can feel it watching you, as if it's always there. Before it consumes your mind, gather what you can.

games.name: Mistpaw Ravine
games.summary: The witches are gone. Only their cats remain. Make a new home for them in this feline city-builder. Keep your cats fed and happy, clean their litter box, and endure the toxic mist of a world ravaged by magic.

games.name: Monster Blast Infinity
games.summary: Shoot waves of monsters

games.name: Moss Moss
games.summary: Play Moss Moss to moss the world and find secrets.

games.name: My Beautiful Misinterpretation of Words
games.summary: "My Beautiful Misinterpretation of Words" is a collection of experimental art games I vomited over the span of a year. The gameplay and visuals dramatically varies every moment. One may say it is less of a "game" but more of an "experience". Now, I welcome you into my mind.

games.name: New Stars
games.summary: Expand your own galactic empire across new stars, research technologies, and challenge great alien powers in this immersive 4X grand strategy game. Build interstellar colonies, and starbases to gather more resources. Explore a unique galaxy full of secrets, great perils, and limitless possibilities.

games.name: Ninja Gaiden 4: The Two Masters
games.summary: After the endless rain, the shadow of the Dark Dragon finally dissipates over Tokyo, bringing clear skies and a moment of peace. But the work of the Hayabusa and Raven ninja clans is never over, and chaos threatens the world once more. A mysterious foe seeks to tear open a doorway to another dimension and transform our world into a living nightmare. With the Divine Dragon Order in shambles and powerless to combat the new flood of fiends, two master ninjas must rise to the challenge. Step into a new chapter of the Ninja Gaiden 4 saga as Yakumo and Ryu Hayabusa join forces to combat new enemies and save humanity once again.

games.name: North Sentinel Island
games.summary: A young man and woman, a rising YouTube couple, travel to the forbidden North Sentinel Island and vanish. Their last upload shows their approach to the island. Five days later, the Indian Coast Guard finds their empty boat drifting offshore. No bodies. No clues. No contact.

games.name: Nuggle
games.summary: Nuggle is a delightfully cosy casual puzzle game with 100 levels at launch. It has a simple mechanic but you can quickly become unstuck trying to make sure there are no missing matches. It is unadulterated pure puzzles.

games.name: Obscure Chronicle of Dynastia
games.summary: The vast Anti-Dong Zhuo's Coalition has now scattered, and the era belonging to the warlords of East of Hangu Pass has just begun. Those heroes of Three Kingdoms Period, Yuan Shao, Cao Cao, Liu Bei, and Lü Bu, are now all fighting to win the stakes in the Central Plain of China.

games.name: One, Two, Death
games.summary: One, Two, Death is a co-op psychological horror where you wake up in a mansion with one other person. Trust your partner to escape together — or betray them to earn your own freedom, while a sadistic creature watches every move.

games.name: Perfect Tritone
games.summary:
In Man Machine combat, firing the first shot secures the upper hand.

Created for Noise Jam 2, made with much love and perishingly little foresight.

games.name: Picto-Cross: 1 Nonogram per Day
games.summary: Picto-Cross is a 2D logic puzzle game with a minimalist style, known as nonograms, featuring a total of 372 puzzles based on historical events or celebrations that occur throughout the year.

games.name: Pirates: Rogue's Fortune
games.summary: A rogue-lite action and adventure game set in the Caribbean! Explore the ocean depths in search of treasures, survive intense naval battles, and upgrade your ship to reclaim your place as the greatest pirate in a world to discover with every attempt.

games.name: Pixel Into the Galaxy
games.summary: Come along on this adventure and help an explorer reach his destination. Run, jump, and dodge obstacles to reach your goal: Earth.

games.name: Radirgy Swag
games.summary: Radirgy Swag is a unique shooter with game mechanics that can be enjoyed by players of all different levels. The planes in Radirgy Swag are not only equipped with guns, but you can also destroy enemies with your sword. This feature allows you to attack your enemies from different angles. Use your shield or fill up your Absonet gauge to give you temporary invincibility against your foes. Master both offensive and defensive techniques to conquer your mission.

games.name: Reciros
games.summary: Reciros is a multiplayer magic FPS where guns are replaced by elemental spells. Combine elements to create unique abilities and adapt your playstyle. Play King of the Hill or objective-based team modes online with Steam friends and prove you're the most powerful wizard.

games.name: RhythmStrike
games.summary: Rhythm game inspired by modern Japanese arcade titles, featuring intense visuals and gameplay, dynamic keyboard and mouse controls, and community integration. Climb the global leaderboards and unlock new content through specialized challenges!

games.name: Roommates, Romance, and Ringing Hearts
games.summary:
Roommates, Romance, and Ringing Hearts is a live action FMV romance simulation game where your choices shape a year of love and relationships with five unique heroines.

Experience cinematic storytelling, heartfelt moments, and branching outcomes as everyday roommate life turns into romance.

Produced by TV Asahi Japan and Aiming Inc..

games.name: Royal Dental
games.summary: Rise from peasant dentist to royal healer in this quirky medieval dental simulation RPG. Treat patients, upgrade tools, improve your clinic, expand your knowledge, and restore Princess Penelope’s legendarily awful smile, all while facing sabotage from a jealous prince.

games.name: Rusted Sea
games.summary: Earth's surface has been dessimated by radiation from The War. The only remaining safe havens are found under the seas. Now you must cook, craft, and survive alone in your submarine, delivering vital supplies to the Starving Survivors - all while battling monsters both real and imagined.

games.name: Scanner Force
games.summary: ​Pulled into a digital world of neon and sound, you must scan and blast your way out. Master iconic classical masterpieces with your high-tech Rhythm Scanner and prove you’re a true "Gosu" by hitting perfect streaks. Create your own rhythmic gauntlets in the Custom Stage Editor!

games.name: Sector War
games.summary: Embark on an epic space strategy adventure!

games.name: Ser Jorryn
games.summary: Ser Jorryn is a retro platformer inspired by the classic arcade games of my childhood, updated with modern responsive controls. A love letter to a time when forced simplicity and pure gameplay came together to create hours of pure magic.

games.name: Shoot The Barrels
games.summary: Addictive incremental game about shooting exploding barrels and upgrading your weapon.

games.name: Shooty McSpaceFace
games.summary: Save your space base by shooting down the enemies!

games.name: Shrink Rooms
games.summary: Run! The rooms are shrinking! A puzzle game Demo about escaping from shrinking rooms. Every step counts if you want to make it out alive! Complete box-pushing puzzles within a limited number of steps or be crushed into a puddle of meat by the pressing walls of the level!

games.name: SolveIt! A Puzzle Solving Simulator
games.summary: SolveIt! invites you into the world of twisty puzzles - from the timeless Rubik’s Cube to unique and challenging shapes. Whether you’re a casual solver or a speedcubing enthusiast, SolveIt lets you practice, compete, and learn - all in one place.

games.name: Sylva: Curse of the Demon Woods
games.summary: Take the role of a nameless knight seeking repentance in a God-forsaken village in Sylva - Curse of the Demon Woods, a game about inner and outward exploration, chivalric action, featuring Metroidvania and Souls-like elements with a heavy focus on narrative and worldbuilding.

games.name: Taimanin Squad
games.summary: Lead your squad of captivating girls in this Strategic RPG!

games.name: Tetro Runner
games.summary: Tetro Runner is an arcade platformer about a sentient block trying to escape a collapsed and corrupt arcade cabinet. You must juggle fast paced platforming and precise block placement to stay alive and get the highest score you can.

games.name: The Bazaar: Karnok
games.summary: The Karnok DLC adds the playable hero Karnok to The Bazaar alongside over 120 new items, skills, and unique encounters to aid Karnok on his hunts.

games.name: The Devil Card
games.summary: The Devil Card is a card battle game inspired by Final Fantasy VIII’s Triple Triad. Select 5 cards and place them on the Grid. Flip opponent cards to win, collect them, and progress through the story. Defeat the Devil to earn his soul card and complete the campaign, or play with custom rules in Freeplay mode.

games.name: The Succession of Changing Kings
games.summary: A turn-based kingdom management simulator, with an emphasis on decision making. Will you survive and lead the kingdom to prosperity or die in obscurity? The throne awaits you.

games.name: Velocide Overdrive
games.summary: Velocide Overdrive is a brutal, fast-paced game with 70+ power-ups. Invite your friends to play for free: one copy is all it takes to ruin friendships and dominate the chaos. Only one rule matters: don't finish last!

games.name: Waddle Paddle
games.summary: Paddle as a cute penguin through a difficult kayaking course, dodging deadly obstacles along the way. Take on the challenge solo or team up with a friend to paddle in sync toward the finish.

games.name: Walto
games.summary: WALTO is a boss-rush game set in the land of rabbits, built around a combat philosophy where evasion and attack happen as one, demanding extreme reflexes. Cut down the encroaching predators and bring this world to its end.

games.name: Water Margin Scrolls
games.summary: "Water Margin Scrolls" is a squad-building loot-hunting game set in the world of Water Margin. Collect iconic heroes from the classic tale and challenge other players in strategic battles.

games.name: What Is Death?
games.summary: A visual novel about death.

games.name: Yankee Rabbits
games.summary: Waifus with guns vs. pink rabbits with bats. A corrupt cop blames you for it all. It’s cute, it’s brutal, and it makes no sense. Perfect.

games.name: Zeroad
games.summary: ZEROAD is an endless pixel-art roguelike shooter. Fight through shifting roads and zombie hordes, growing stronger every run. Find unique weapons with modifiers, level up your character, and push further each time – solo or in two-player co-op!

games.name: Zombie Survival 3D
games.summary:
You wake up at night in a remote forest surrounded by a quarantine zone.

Without weapons.Without communication.Just a flashlight... and the feeling of being watched.

The only way to escape is to open the old gates of the laboratory perimeter.But they are locked with 10 mechanical locks.

The keys are scattered all over the infected forest.

And you're not alone here.

games.name: iRacing Arcade
games.summary: Race across global licensed series and build your own racing team to secure your motorsport legacy in this third person arcade racer.

games.name: Adventurer's Guild Reception
games.summary: This is the Adventurer's Guild. Today, daring adventurers come here in search of a quick fortune. Become a receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild and arrange quests for unique adventurers in this training RPG game!

games.name: Aery: The King's Messenger
games.summary: Relaxing bird adventure: Explore 11 fantasy worlds, collect Memory Shards, and uncover the story of a threatened kingdom.

games.name: Amer Fighting
games.summary: Get ready to rumble in Amer Fighting, the ultimate party fighting game where the fun never stops! Gather your friends and dive into an exciting family fight for up to 6 players as each battle is a chance to become a legend! In Amer Fighting, everyone can fight, but only one can win!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Plump Pop
games.summary: Let's all work together as a family!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Plump Pop
games.summary: Let's all work together as a family!

games.name: Archerio
games.summary: A fast-paced 3D archery roguelike. Clear deadly rooms, stack wild powers, defeat bosses.

games.name: Armored Hongfeng
games.summary: "Armored Hongfeng" is a TPS game with "tank vehicle" + "MOBA" gameplay. You will use famous active and retired tanks to compete on the battlefield. The game combines the strategic depth of traditional tank battles with the excitement of MOBA games, bringing an unprecedented gaming experience.

games.name: Ascendant Dawn
games.summary: Ascendant Dawn is a grand strategy game where you lead a nomadic tribe in a brutal bronze age world. Work your way up from a small clan to a great empire by founding cities and conquering your enemies.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Unity
games.summary:
Assassin’s Creed Unity is an action-adventure game set in Paris during the French Revolution. The player controls Arno Dorian, an Assassin who seeks to uncover the forces behind the political unrest. The game introduces new weapons, including the Phantom Blade, a modified Hidden Blade with ranged capabilities.
Gameplay emphasizes stealth, parkour, and close combat, featuring updated free-running mechanics and a revised fighting system. The open-world setting recreates 18th-century Paris and includes historical events such as the storming of the Bastille and the execution of King Louis XVI. Unity also includes a cooperative multiplayer mode supporting up to four players.

trailers.name: Commented Single player Gameplay E3 Trailer

games.name: Axonaut
games.summary: In the final stage of the interstellar war, the Alliance established the secret organization AXONAUT, primarily responsible for handling anomalous zones across post-war regions. As a member, unleash the power of the Alliance to your heart's content.

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.summary:
A gripping prison escape RPG woven with crime, corruption, and hidden agendas. Step into a maximum-security facility where every inmate has a past—and a plan. You'll have to fight to survive, investigate, and ultimately break free before the time runs out.

Uncover a scheme that threatens more than just your life—it could bring down the entire city. In this thrilling adventure, choices matter, and escape is your only salvation!

games.name: Banquet for Fools
games.summary: The Pavura needs four volunteers to solve the mystery of an abandoned village. Answer the call in this party-based action adventure RPG.

games.name: Beel the Pollinator
games.summary: Fly and gather pollen to help flowers!

games.name: Beer Manufacture Simulator
games.summary: Brew your own beer from scratch! Take on the role of a brewmaster, learn brewing techniques, create unique recipes, and grow your craft brewery into a full-scale factory. Expand your brewery from mashing and fermenting to bottling and selling - every decision shapes your beer empire

games.name: Black Arhat: Wujing
games.summary: Black Arhat: Wujing is a turn-based dungeon adventure game where players will take on the role of the protagonist Wujing and embark on a fantastic adventure journey with the companions they encounter along the way.

games.name: Breaching Harkon
games.summary: Breach, upgrade, and unleash chaos in this roguelike shooter where every run builds new gunplay possibilities. Stack wild attachments, forge broken weapon combos, and dive into explosive firefights against a ruthless criminal empire.

games.name: Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair
games.summary: Bulb Boy defeated the evil that had overtaken the Bulbhouse and his beloved family. But it seems that this is only the beginning of his dark adventures! And this time, it all starts with an empty jam jar...

games.name: Card Cultivation
games.summary: Card Cultivation is a card management game that visualizes the process of cultivating immortality through cards. In the game, you will play as a cultivation practitioner: cultivate techniques, explore treasures, and craft weapons, Throughout re-cultivation, you will recover memory.

games.name: Cards and Dungeons
games.summary: Cards and Dungeons is a roguelike dungeon crawler that blends strategic card play with fast-paced action. Choose your hero, equip your deck, and descend through ever-changing dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and brutal bosses. Every run is a test of survival, strategy, and risk management.

games.name: Chicken Chicken
games.summary: Enter the brutal pecking order of the wasteland! Chicken Chicken is a party game for 2-6 players. Survive mad mini-games, form temporary alliances, and claw your way to the top. Total feathery anarchy!

games.name: Chickenauts
games.summary: Chickenauts is a companion based, action roguelite game where you battle evil Alien Chickens who've abducted your beloved flock. Free and mutate your chickens to defeat a myriad of foes, explore various spaceship environments and unravel secrets of the Chickens from outer space!

games.name: Citadelum
games.summary: Citadelum is a city builder set in legendary Ancient Rome. Build your own settlement, gather resources and evolve it into a magnificent city. Explore the world, trade and lead your mighty legions in epic tactical battles. Earn the favor of the Gods or challenge them, if you dare.

games.name: Cook MIX
games.summary: A Cozy Cooking Game. Experiment with Ingredients. Mix, Cook, and Discover New Recipes! Make any combination and GET PROFIT!

games.name: Cooking Cat-Astrophe
games.summary: Cozy Yet Intense

games.name: Cryzon Part4
games.summary: Get the crystals!! Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players! 30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.summary:
Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.
Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines… and claw back your relationship!

games.name: Death Scourges
games.summary: Death Scourges is a linear and dark third person shooter mixed with tactical elements. You embody the captain of a special strike team consisting of four elite operators. Shoot, loot, craft and use your team to survive the unknown horror lurking in the depths of an underground research facility.

games.name: Deep Combat
games.summary: Dive into the depths of a massive underground military facility in Deep Combat, a high-intensity 2D action platformer packed with danger and futuristic warfare. Play as an elite soldier sent far below the surface to eliminate advanced threats, survive brutal ambushes, and push through increasingly hostile sectors.

games.name: Degeons Project
games.summary: The abandoned mega-complex of Degeons Laboratory's holds dark secrets. Solve unique puzzles, investigate the cause of the catastrophe, and find out why the mysterious Man in the Crow Suit is watching you. Test your mind in this scientific enigma.

games.name: Demonic Episode
games.summary: In this 4 player first person online co-op horror game, play as a group of content creators who are on a mission to banish a demon back to hell. The advanced, randomized game mechanics offer you and your friends a high replay value.

games.name: Desynced
games.summary: Desynced is a sci-fi strategy game with fully customizable units and behaviors. Gather, build, research, and explore the unknown. Alone or with friends, unveil the mystery of an AI on the edge of self-awareness and uncover the hidden truth in this blend of strategy, automation, and exploration.

games.name: Docked
games.summary: Return home to Port Wake and rebuild your family business. Docked is a realistic simulator where you operate heavy machinery, restore and develop the port's infrastructure, and manage day-to-day operations to help your port expand and thrive.

games.name: Drift Survivors
games.summary: Top-down car combat meets survivor-style chaos. Drift through neon arenas, delete waves with wild weapons, and upgrade your build to last longer every run.

games.name: Dysplaced
games.summary: You are the Guardian - the last hope for a realm under peril. Summoned from our world into theirs, you'll venture into a vast and beautiful fantastic realm to learn, master and thrive - and to chase away the darkness. Forge your destiny from the ruins - break nearly everything to save the realm!

games.name: Echoed Nights
games.summary:
Explore a fragmented, surreal facility, evade twisted memory-born monsters, and collect scattered objects to piece together your forgotten past as an unknown voice guides you, whispering cryptic hints and haunting warnings. Its words draw you deeper into the twisted halls, where every step could reveal a truth—or awaken a nightmare.

Collect stuffed animals, the last remnants of memories scattered across the disjointed, surreal environment. Each one holds a fragment of your forgotten past, slowly revealing the story behind the horrors that haunt you. The world itself is a puzzle of scattered memories, stitched together yet never whole.

Will you be able to remember the ONE from your scattered memories, or will you be consumed by the echoes lurking in the dark?

games.name: Echoes of a Thread
games.summary: Echoes of a Thread is a free indie RPG inspired by classic 2D fantasy… with a quiet meta layer that slowly reveals itself. You’ll explore a broken world, face difficult boss fights, and collect journal pages that piece together the truth.

games.name: Eerie Dossier: The Haunted Apartment
games.summary: "Eerie Dossier:the Haunted Apartment"is a walking simulation game that combines horror and horror elements.You will be trapped in an infinite loop of corridors and rooms, searching for opportunities to escape from this place while also discovering its secrets

games.name: Eggconsole Kohakuiro no Yuigon PC-8801mkIISR
games.summary: A murder at the Kohaku-kan. Join Detective Ryunosuke Todo as he unpicks a tangled web of secrets to find the truth.

games.name: Elevral
games.summary: A fluid first-person archery game where speed and precision collide.

games.name: Elf Girls
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring many cute and mysterious elf girls is here!

games.name: Emerland Solitaire 2: Collector's Edition
games.summary: An exciting journey into the world of magical Solitaire awaits! A stunning new game with classic rules. Hundreds of fun levels, dangerous opponents and heroic companions await you in an adventure full of mysteries and secrets!

games.name: Equinox: Homecoming
games.summary: Saddle up with friends and investigate a dark mystery, where each trail leads to wonder and intrigue. A string of events has set the idyllic island on edge. Discover the truth behind your mother’s disappearance and a local's sudden death. For fans of horses, murder mysteries, and cozy exploration!

games.name: Fairywood Survivors
games.summary: Fairywood Survivors — play as a fairy guardian, unleash powerful magic, grow stronger, and survive endless waves of poisonous creatures invading your forest.

games.name: Five Feet
games.summary: Early Access — A solo-developed 5v5 futsal game with retro style, power-ups, and chaotic FFA modes. No rules. No refs. Just goals.

games.name: Fortuna Magus
games.summary: Amane, Tia and Lill lived a peaceful life together with their father, Kalius...until Kalius mysteriously disappeared one day. Before leaving, he asked Amane to take care of Tia and Lill. Ten years later, Amane and Tia encounter a magus named Ret, who sets in motion a fateful chain of events.

games.name: FoxHaunt
games.summary: FoxHaunt is a choice-based RPG with turn-based battles. You are the Forgotten Fox. Find and fight the other fox spirits so that you will be remembered.

games.name: Genome Guardian 2
games.summary: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic shooter with macroscopic depth. BUILD YOUR NANOBOT from hundreds of parts. SURVIVE the microbial onslaught once more in this psychedelic dive to the Abyss, full of mutations, minerals, anomalies and powerup polyps. SHMUP mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!

games.name: Goth Clicker
games.summary: A minimalistic gothic clicker: click, collect Souls, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new stages by reaching the goals.

games.name: Greedland
games.summary: Welcome to Greedland, an exhilarating top-down shooter where you play as an interstellar mercenary. Battle through ever-changing environments and annihilate waves of enemies. If you enjoy the action-packed gameplay of Crimsonland and Vampire Survivors, Greedland is the perfect game for you!

games.name: Guardians of Dao
games.summary: “Guardians of Dao” is a wuxia RPG with real-time tactics × roguelite deckbuilding. Play cards to command heroes, shape your build with divine blessings, and defend Earth.

games.name: Halloween Mystery: 100 Hidden Object Fruits
games.summary: Are you ready to get lost in scenes full of mystery? Find 100 hidden objects in black and white gothic locations full of secrets. Silence, mystery, and patience — all waiting for you in this atmosphere. Focus, explore, and uncover all the mysteries!

games.name: Heavenhells
games.summary: Welcome to Heavenhells, an anime RPG where your tactical strategy is the only thing standing between humanity and oblivion.

games.name: Help! My Childhood Friend is Now My Boss and He Wants Me To Be His Bride?!
games.summary:
Renji is an ordinary guy living an ordinary life. He works a dull, uninteresting office job, and he hasn't had a serious relationship in... well, ever.

Renji is already thirty-two, but he's been spinning his wheels for years. He doesn't know what he wants out of life or what his future holds, which might explain why he's been daydreaming about his childhood more and more.

As a young boy, at least, Renji was cool. He protected his best friend, Ikue, from school bullies, and he even planned to planned to marry her one day. Ikue, at least, adored Renji, and he basked in her affection...

But, wait! Who is this handsome guy who's just started to work in Renji's department? He says he's Renji's new boss, and his name is Ikki - but why does he look so similar to Renji's long lost childhood friend? What the heck is going on - and how does he know about Renji and Ikue's promise to get married?!

games.name: Hentai Misaki
games.summary: Hentai Misaki is an adult game where you solve puzzles and match tiles to gradually reveal the seductive bride Misaki. The more levels you complete — the hotter the scenes become!

games.name: Here Comes the Swarm
games.summary: Here Comes the Swarm is a survival RTS with a pause button! Create your strategy, build, manage, and defend your settlements at your own pace. Take the fight to the hive mind and lead expeditions to deliver a deadly blow and eradicate your foes. Will you reclaim Ulora from the relentless Swarm?

games.name: HexBreakerII
games.summary: A supernatural game infused with Chinese-style elements drawn from folklore. This game offers online gameplay for teams of up to 4 players. In a world ravaged by warlords and monsters, you will assume the role of a Taoist, wielding your skills to unveil truths hidden for millennia.

games.name: Hidden Raccoons
games.summary: Hidden Raccoons is a relaxing hidden object game where you search for raccoons hidden in colorful pixel art worlds. With no timer, you can play at your own pace and enjoy every area.

games.name: Holdfast: Age of Sail
games.summary: Ahoy! Prepare to raise the black flag. Holdfast's Age Of Sail Expansion

games.name: Hunk Empire
games.summary: Kicked out and pulled into his dad’s outrageous adult film empire, a young gay man must build a scrappy new studio. Flirt, film, and manage your way past rivals and wild personalities to turn chaos into your very own gay empire.

games.name: HyakuTyping
games.summary: HyakuTyping is a typing software with a Roman alphabet input only theme based on the Hyakunin Isshu poems. You can play by looking at the display from the top and typing the lower verse, or by looking at the card with the lower verse and typing the first two characters of the upper verse.

games.name: I Will Do It Soon Maybe Later Tomorrow
games.summary: A short narrative visual novel about procrastination, family, and the inner dialogue of a creative person. A story about how delaying decisions slowly erodes a life.

games.name: Icarus: Dangerous Horizons
games.summary: This DLC significantly extends game content rising close to what we would do with a sequel. It includes a whole new map, mission campaign, and an array of new animals and bosses. Consider purchasing this if you have enjoyed the base game, and would like a substantial amount of extra content.

games.name: Inkoid
games.summary: Rule the skies and paint the arena in your team's colors! Dive into the vibrant world of Inkoid, a 3v3 hyper aerial shooter where capturing airborne strongholds with your team is the key to victory.

games.name: Iron Guard: Salvation
games.summary: Step into the world of IRON GUARD: Salvation, a sci-fi Tower Defense game with real-time strategy elements. Build your defenses, upgrade turrets, and fend off waves of relentless robots with your handheld drone - your tactical brilliance is humanity’s last hope!

games.name: Iron Legacy
games.summary: Master the grind in Iron Legacy, a nostalgic 2D Action RPG inspired by the classics. Hunt hordes of monsters, master powerful spells, and push your limits with a deep Reset system. Whether solo or in co-op, forge your legacy through blood, loot, and infinite progression. Become a Legend!

games.name: Jurassic Differences
games.summary: Get ready to travel back in time with Jurassic Differences, a spot the difference adventure packed with prehistoric thrills and visual surprises!

games.name: Kromlech
games.summary: Embark on a journey in this dark fantasy action-adventure game to find out why the tapestry of the world is suddenly unraveling itself and even the gods themselves seem powerless to stop it. Sharpen your blade, gather your companions, and prepare to make the last stand as the world around you burns.

games.name: Lang Ops: Lost in Woods
games.summary: You've got lost in the forest in the original series? This time you might get even more lost! In this spin-off, you encounter one of thirty three European languages. You need to pick appropriate words to find the correct path. The woods won't let you get out this easily.

games.name: Legacy of Ancestors
games.summary: From the primitive age to the modern era, experience nine cycles of life. Make choices through card-based events, shaping your character’s stats, relationships, and fate. A strategy-driven life simulation wrapped in satire, tracing the absurd evolution of civilization.

games.name: Legendary Tales V: Price of Power
games.summary: With every adventure, hope for a safer world grows.

games.name: Line Up!
games.summary: Line Up! is a chaotic, couch multiplayer game where you take on the role of a caring Mama trying to guide your adorable, easily confused little babies lined up through the bustling world. Other critters are doing the same, and they won’t hesitate to defend their little ones with everything they’ve got!

games.name: Machine Mind
games.summary: Machine Mind is an action game in a post-apocalyptic setting with elements of survival and RTS. You will fight, craft modules, build your transport, develop and protect your base. You can control other vehicles to automate operations. Discover all the secrets of the destroyed world!

games.name: Mafia Business Simulator
games.summary: Step into the thrilling world of Mafia Business Simulator, a game where crime isn’t chaos — it’s a high-stakes, calculated business. Experience the excitement of running your own criminal empire in modern London, where every decision counts, every move shapes your influence, and every rival is waiting for a mistake. Stylish, immersive, and full of strategic depth, this is more than a game — it’s your chance to dominate the city from the shadows.

games.name: Marathon
games.summary: A PvP-focused extraction shooter set on the mysterious planet of Tau Ceti IV, Marathon will see players inhabit the bodies of Runners, cybernetic mercenaries who have been designed to survive the planet’s harsh environments and explore the lost colony that once inhabited Tau Ceti’s surface. Players will engage solo or in crews of three, searching for mysterious alien artifacts, as well as for valuable loot and new weapons and gear that they can add to their collection.

games.name: Mech Fortress
games.summary: A tower defense game where each turret has unique mechanics. You can freely place them on a 5×5 grid, and your goal is to eliminate all enemies.

games.name: Mega Kaiju Boom Ball
games.summary: Mega Kaiju Boom Ball is a giant monster-themed break-em-up developed with retro 8-bit constraints in mind. The game mixes the dynamics of breakout, pinball and legendary kaiju into a unique and action-packed 8-bit experience. Can you save the world from a kaiju invasion using just a ball and paddle?

games.name: Methods: The Canada Files
games.summary: Methods: The Canada Files is a mystery visual novel set three years before the events of Methods. In the last few stages of the Canadian detective competition, Detective Larika Downs is determined to discover the truth at all costs!

games.name: Miniature Legends
games.summary: Survive in Tiny Lands—alone or with friends! Battle endless waves of creatures in small arenas, collect and upgrade powerful abilities, unlock new legends, and grow insanely strong in this fast-paced, chaotic roguelike board-battler.

games.name: My Sliem Gets Stronger After It Dies
games.summary: My Sliem gets stronger after it dies is a fantasy RPG where you play as a weak slime. Through repeated rebirths, you grow stronger to defeat foes and uncover a conspiracy. In its top-down pixel world, you move, dodge, and cast spells—turning each death into power.

games.name: NeNeKoNeKo
games.summary: NeNeKoNeKo is a puzzle game where you use three boxes to fit sprawling, oddly-shaped sleeping cats into place. Don't let the cute looks fool you — under a time limit, you need to quickly figure out the best combinations, making it a surprisingly challenging brain teaser. When time runs out, you get a revival chance with limited moves instead of a time limit, letting you think carefully and discover solutions that seemed impossible. Feel the rush when everything clicks into place!

games.name: Neo Artifacts
games.summary:
Neo Artifacts— A Stunning Artifact Personification SRPG

Neo Artifacts is a personification game that brings stunning artifacts to life as characters.Set in a modern urban world, the awakened Artifacters,each bearing their own will and power—fight alongside you, the Curator, against the reality-warping anomalies known as “Distortion.”

games.name: Net 24h: Vietnamese Internet Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Net 24h is a chaotic Vietnamese internet cafe simulator where players manage a 24/7 cybercafe, deal with unpredictable customers, and survive the madness of running a net shop in Vietnam.

games.name: Never Grave: The Witch and the Curse
games.summary: A Metroidvania x Roguelite, where you advance using a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build new facilities in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: Oceanhorn 3: Legend of the Shadow Sea
games.summary: Oceanhorn 3: Legend of the Shadow Sea picks up one thousand years after the events of Oceanhorn 2. In this new era, you’ll navigate the treacherous Shadow Sea, accompanied by Em, the infamous technopirate and her rugged crew of Warlock’s Revenge. With the help of familiar faces, such as Blackhat of the Uncharted Seas, you must face the threats slumbering beneath the waves of the Shadow Sea, uncover the mysterious Lost God, and build a future for the people of Red Town.

games.name: Open Fire: Ready
games.summary: This is a very simple first-person shooter game that you can fight enemies in various game modes and maps, experiencing the thrill of shooting.

games.name: Peak Rhythm
games.summary: Ascend to the beat in Peak Rhythm! In this VR rhythm-climbing game, every grab and twist drives your robotic platform upward through a neon-soaked city. Sync your moves to a high-octane electronic soundtrack to master the flow and dominate global leaderboards. Blending physical precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics, your rhythm is your engine. Don’t just climb—perform.

games.name: PiyoRide!
games.summary: A side-scrolling action game with simple controls! Dodge obstacles and aim for the greatest distance! Master Perfect Dodges to fly even farther!?

games.name: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf
games.summary: Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey with Lana and her loyal companion Mui. Whether you're a returning hero or a new adventurer, step into a world where a new, ancient mystery emerges from Novo's hidden depths. But as they scour these depths, a new threat will put their unbreakable bond to the ultimate test, guiding Lana to confront her destiny amidst encroaching shadows.

games.name: Platform 0
games.summary: You’re trapped in a forgotten metro system, haunted by a ghost train that reacts to your every move. Explore dark tunnels, avoid deadly traps, and stay quiet — your survival depends on it. A first-person horror experience where silence is your only weapon.

games.name: Poker Night at the Inventory
games.summary: Almost seven years after the Inventory closed its doors, this underground social club has reopened for business. Play No Limit Texas Hold’em with four video game icons in a high-stakes battle of cards, bets, and trash talk.

games.name: Pokémon Pokopia
games.summary: Pokémon and people once lived happily together, but the world has withered and the humans are gone. The only remaining resident appears to be a lone Tangrowth. After waking from a long slumber, a peculiar Ditto decides to restore the desolate land using its transformation skills and its surprising new crafting abilities. Play as a Ditto and build a charming world alongside your Pokémon friends. After a satisfying day of crafting, building, and gardening, relax in your very own paradise or invite Pokémon and your friends to visit. As you restore your world and cultivate its natural beauty, you'll encounter more Pokémon who will teach you useful moves! Your Pokémon neighbors are excited to play together, as well as help you build houses to welcome even more friends! Pokémon might even ask for your help – work with them to build a cozy utopia.

games.name: Police Girls
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring cool and cute female police officers is here!

games.name: Pororo Sports Day
games.summary: Grand Canyon! The Pyramids! Hawaii! A wacky sports day in amazing places around the world with Pororo!

games.name: Portrait of a Torn
games.summary: As a young soldier returning to an eerily deserted home, you'll explore enigmatic rooms, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover a haunting, tragic story.

games.name: Project W.E.T.
games.summary: An indie horror game created by the YouTuber GamerCoder.

games.name: Pumuckl and the Crown of the Pirate King
games.summary: The famous German kobold Pumuckl is back with a 3D puzzle adventure game “Pumuckl and the Crown of the Pirate King”. The player controls Pumuckl through 3D puzzle levels, plays mini-games, solves tricky challenges and has to defeat scary enemies.

games.name: Rager
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-fueled excitement of this melee combat rhythm game! Master weapon of your choice – sword, mace, claws, hammer, axe, your own fists and many more! Stunning visuals and spatial audio technology puts you right in heart of the action.

games.name: Ranger Force
games.summary: Ranger Force is an atmospheric third person, action, adventure, shooter, and fighting game that can be experienced alone, or with a partner in multiplayer split-screen mode.

games.name: Ratcheteer DX
games.summary: Explore the interconnected caverns below the frozen surface and a vast Snowcean above as you set out to rescue friend, foe, and stranger alike in this lo-fi action-adventure!

games.name: Scavenger Hunt Find Hidden Objects
games.summary: Search. Spot. Discover. Explore beautiful scenes and find hidden objects. Train your brain and master every scavenger hunt.

games.name: Scrub Dudes
games.summary: A world built from cardboard, fabric and handcrafted creations. Everything is messy and covered in grime, but the Scrub Dudes team is ready for action. Climb, glide, collect trash, fix things and WASH it all clean. Enjoy this cozy handcrafted world.

games.name: Shattered Realm Rebirth
games.summary: Multi-world rogue-lite endless challenge. The surface world hides dangers, the inner world overflows with treasure. Transcend worlds and master time through soul transference. Fight your way out and escape this reality. Strategic builds reduce reliance on pure stats.

games.name: Slay the Spire II
games.summary:
The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns!

Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2 - featuring new characters, cards, events, alternate acts, and more!

games.name: Slide Viking: Treasure's Path
games.summary: Vikings on the Treasure Hunt

games.name: Solitaire Battle
games.summary: Slay your enemies by playing solitaire, synergize your card-powered attacks and abilities, then break the game and become the best to ever Solitaire Battle in this roguelike deckbuilding autobattler!

games.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 5
games.summary: Wrath of the Old Gods.

games.name: SoulTrigger
games.summary: An urban fantasy turn-based RPG where you analyze monsters' patterns and weaknesses to progress through battles.

games.name: Spingenuity
games.summary: A relaxing incremental game about spinning a wheel. Use your mouse movement to build momentum and set the wheel in motion. Spend your earnings on upgrades to improve the wheel, spin faster, and earn more money. When progress slows, purchase permanent upgrades through the prestige system.

games.name: Spinwave Survivors
games.summary: Spinwave Survivors is a fast-paced survival shooter with roguelike elements. Scoot, shoot and boost your way through hordes of drones as you upgrade your weapons and unlock new abilities, all while attempting the survive the chaos.

games.name: Sunny Blooms Garden Center
games.summary: Create your dream garden center! Design, decorate and stock it with stunning plants to wow customers and earn top ratings. Manage staff, suppliers, and finances to stay ahead of the competition. Take control of stock management, interact with cash registers and experience the day-to-day operations.

games.name: Sushi Cat: Tower Defense
games.summary: Battle back waves of rogue sushi in this cute-but-chaotic roguelite tower defense! Build, upgrade, and reshape the battlefield each run.

games.name: Taleweavers Alliance Anthology
games.summary: A linear visual novel featuring five different Ontario (Canada) youths' stories. Each story has a different art style and subject matter, and we worked closely with the storytellers to ensure their voices come through authentically. Indigenous & LGBTQ2S+ are major themes.

games.name: Tenshoku Maou
games.summary:
A SFW version of "Tenshoku Maou 18+".

Command your demon squad in this epic RPG and master every battle! Smash enemies through slick battles, boost your maidens with gear, and forge their loyalty. Dive into a dark fantasy saga of betrayal and power, where stunning visuals and voiced characters bring the story to life.

games.name: The End of the World and Her Room
games.summary: The End of the World and Her Room is a short, free point-and-click puzzle game. This is a quiet and fleeting story: in the final moments, inside her room, you observe the surroundings, search for clues, unlock her phone’s password, and slowly understand the traces the world has left behind.

games.name: The Knife Sharpener
games.summary: You are trying to make a living in an indifferent city full of freaks, one knife at the time.

games.name: The Last Case of John Morley
games.summary: Step into the mind of John Morley, a 1940s detective on his final case. Explore shadowed places long forgotten by time, and piece together crime scenes in a narrative adventure steeped in mystery, unexpected twists, and a truth buried for decades.

games.name: The Walking Trade
games.summary: Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.

games.name: They See You
games.summary: A computer engineer arrives in a remote mountain village, where tech failures and missing residents put him face to face with an unsettling force lurking behind the screen.

games.name: This Night
games.summary: A single-player exploration/scavenger hunt game set in a haunted forest where the player searches for a missing key needed to unlock a remote cabin. The key spawns in different areas each playthrough and roaming spirits must be avoided while discovering landmarks and hidden locations, including an underground cave. Difficulty settings along with tracked run statistics encourage players to improve their times and complete repeated runs.

games.name: Timeless Solitaire Collection
games.summary: An anthology of seven classic solitaire games - each re-imagined with striking art styles, playful twists, and flexible rules for endless replay.

games.name: Trail Out
games.summary: Welcome to the Trail Out festival! Reckless races in different parts of the planet await you! Explosions of cars, shouts of departing drivers, hype from fans, all this awaits you here!

games.name: Trials of Valor
games.summary: Trials of Valor is a real-time, roguelike fighting game. Gear up and build your character to fight evil monsters of increasing difficulty.

games.name: Twiggle's Grove
games.summary: Nestled at your screen’s edge, a tranquil idle world unfurls as you go about your day. Plant gorgeous trees, look after adorable animals, and mingle with merry goblins - your forest keeps blooming in the background. Get in the grove with Twiggle’s Grove!

games.name: Under the River
games.summary: Under the River is a romance visual novel set in Ming China’s world of spirits and the strange.As an opera singer,you return to Sui'an County to perform for the River God. However, a strange accident leads you to don a demonic skin, transforming you into a half-human, half-ghost.

games.name: Unknown: Foggins
games.summary: Unknown - Foggins is a mystery game that combines puzzle-solving, adventure, and point-and-click elements. Follow an main storyline in pursuit of a hidden truth and interact with distinctive NPCs and uncover the secrets behind their mysterious stories.

games.name: Untold Memories: Potter's Field
games.summary: Broken by guilt after a fatal accident, Mark accepts a mysterious job. But Potter's Field isn't looking for a guard; it’s looking for a prisoner. Orchestrated by revenge, your shift is a psychological execution. Watch the shadows, face your sins, or join the graves you protect.

games.name: Vampire Therapist
games.summary: Guide vampires through centuries of emotional baggage, decades of delusions and the odd bout of self-loathing with real cognitive behavioral therapy concepts and become a Vampire Therapist! Even vampires need a shoulder to cry on when a neck to bite just won’t do.

games.name: VoidFront: Galactic Warfare
games.summary: VoidFront: Galactic Warfare — a fast-paced sci-fi FPS where cyborg factions battle across the galaxy, wielding devastating space weaponry and relying on tactical team superiority.

games.name: Warboss
games.summary: Choose your units, place them where it counts and build an army that wins. Deploy heroes with powerful skills to support your units and swing the battle your way. Unite the clans and take the fight to the Dubdals. Warboss is a casual and goofy battle simulator.

games.name: Wheelie Life Simulator
games.summary: Feel the adrenaline of Wheelie Life Simulator, the ultimate motorcycle skill game where balance is everything. Ride on one wheel, push your limits, and prove your mastery in a world built for precision and thrills. Every ride is a test of control, focus, and daring — from quiet city streets to wide open countryside, this game is all about perfecting the art of the wheelie. Stylish, immersive, and endlessly challenging, it’s not just a ride — it’s your journey to becoming a wheelie legend.

games.name: Whispering Memories
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a psychological thriller where your choices shape the story. Unravel the mysteries of a town plagued by supernatural phenomena, as you navigate the environments and interact with complex characters. Can you uncover the truth before it consumes you?

games.name: Who is Here?
games.summary: Nothing happened. Or did it? Keep attention.

games.name: Why Me?
games.summary: Why Me is a 2D platformer full of unexpected twists and brutal tricks. Every level is designed to trick, challenge, and surprise you. Can you escape the chaos and master the impossible?

games.name: Witch Switched
games.summary: A "man" is transformed into a woman by a vengeful witch and realizes she likes it better this way.

games.name: Aethus
games.summary: Explore a vast underground world to mine, refine and craft hundreds of items, then build up your modular surface Outpost to farm hydroponic crops, prospect for gems and automate your resource-gathering in this sci-fi survival-crafter where the story always provides a reason to dig deeper.

games.name: Alchemist's Alcove
games.summary: Alchemist's Alcove is an Open World Traditional Roguelike where you craft unique spells and tools using the remains of your fallen enemies. Fight, Craft, Discover, and Die as you trudge forth through ancient lands and warring factions!

games.name: Angel Engine
games.summary: Cage an angel. Ransack Heaven. In a far-flung dystopian future, the Angel Engine Initiative carries on as the last hope for humanity. Seal yourself in your operating room, perform surgery on comatose test subjects, and pray you make it out alive.

games.name: Another TD
games.summary: You're the Tower Marshal at the Elderglen kingdom, and you have a terrible job. Your king really likes to send letters to neighbours. Ones that make them offended enough to send armies at your castle. They're already on the way, so get back to work!

games.name: ApePoint Extraction
games.summary: ApePoint Extraction is a hardcore VR extraction shooter designed for players who want real tension, real risk, and real movement. Drop into hostile raids where every second matters. Search abandoned locations, uncover valuable loot, and survive against AI threats and real players who are after the same objective: get in, take what you can, and get out alive. This isn’t slow or scripted movement you physically move, climb, and fight your way through each raid. Every encounter is unpredictable. Every fight can cost you everything.

games.name: Axel Quest
games.summary: A 2D action-adventure game with Metroidvania elements. Explore, fight monsters, collect equipment, unlock new paths, and challenge bosses in a handcrafted pixel-art world inspired by retro classics.

games.name: BakeryDiary
games.summary: Run an adorable bakery sim! Discover bread varieties and heartwarming customer stories. Fulfill every request with love—whether it's strawberries, chocolate, whole wheat, or nuts... you've got this!

games.name: Beetle Shock
games.summary: Get ready for ground-smashing fun and leafy adventures! In Beetle Shock, you control a strong beetle capable of breaking cracked logs with a powerful ground pound. Each level is a small forest mission: find the yellow fruit, open the door, and reach the insect house hidden inside a tree trunk.

games.name: Birds Watching
games.summary: You're the last human on earth. You spend your days bird watching. You're not alone on the mountain.

games.name: Bit//Cycle
games.summary: bit//Cycle is a fast-paced top-down rogue-lite where you cleanse a corrupted computer system. Move fast as the heroic bit, or risk shrinking away to nothing. Procedural levels, grid-based movement, and permadeath make every choice matter.

games.name: Blockaholic
games.summary: It's a physics-based puzzle that challenges your quick thinking and planning. Shake, spin, and pull the blocks up to put them into a line, but don't let them touch the ground

games.name: Bloksie (For Now)
games.summary: Enforce the Internal Revenue Code. Turn Hundreds into Decillions. Praise BirdJesus. The Rouge-Litest Arithmetic 'Em Up.

games.name: Box Bakery
games.summary: This is a simulation management game for baking bread. You need to earn more coins by continuously selling bread to animals customer, thus unlocking more types of ingredients and other rarer animals.Unlock more of their stories and collect items as well as stickers to learn the stories behind them.

games.name: Brotank
games.summary: "BROTANK" is a top-down action roguelike game that combines retro RPG elements. Players will adventure in a post-apocalyptic world, recruit companions, acquire powerful tanks and equipment, capture wanted criminals, and ultimately become legendary hunters!

games.name: Buck Blastem
games.summary: Explore large levels. Find gold and artifacts. Buy guns. Earn upgrades. Bring an end to the chaos!

games.name: Buster Breaks Out
games.summary: A block-breaking roguelite where every upgrade helps you smash more blocks and climb to higher floors. Help Buster grow stronger, defeat the wardens, and break free from his prison.

games.name: By Myself
games.summary: A 2D horror and psychological-horror game based on puzzles and mysteries to uncover the truth about a child left alone. Engaging mechanics, a memorable story, and original soundtracks.

games.name: CPU Invaders: Cyber Arcade
games.summary: A sequel to the Steam Awards finalist that lets you interact with your desktop while playing, watch YouTube videos, chat with your friends, and more! Cyber Arcade overlays classic arcade games on top of your computer screen as you fight off glitch-born digital parasites.

games.name: Carom Billiards
games.summary: Pure skill. No pockets.

games.name: Colorboration
games.summary: Without crossing colors, move the blob characters around the field. By pushing boxes, have the blobs interact and together help them reach their goals.

games.name: Consero
games.summary: Place letter blocks, build words, collect cards, and push for the highest score. Every round is a fresh puzzle. How long can you outlast the grid?

games.name: Coralia and the Ocean of Stars
games.summary: Dive in for a cheeky ocean to space rescue

games.name: Cowboys
games.summary: Saddle up for a supernatural wild west adventure! Choose to play as Roland or Robin and investigate a mysterious desert mansion. Master 8-directional shooting as you battle outlaws and beasts through treacherous levels. Discover powerful weapon upgrades, but be warned - death means losing them all! Unravel a dark secret through story-driven cutscenes and face off against challenging bosses in this thrilling 2D side-scrolling shooter.

games.name: Dark Fall: Ghost Vigil
games.summary: Join the all-night ghost vigil at Harwood House. As part of the 'OPG' paranormal team, explore the haunted buildings and investigate sightings of ghosts, long reported around the area of Wolfenden. Grab the ghost hunting gadgets and solve the mystery surrounding this abandoned building.

games.name: DrumBeats VR
games.summary: DrumBeatsVR is a VR drumming music game. Players can drum to our songs that are custom made for this game. In DrumBeatsVR you can practice on different drum kits, including Metallica and The Rolling Stones and you can play in three different environments (more to be added later).

games.name: Dungeon of Erotic Master Reboot
games.summary: In a certain kingdom, there are three female warriors who are quite popular in their adventuring partyーhowever, they have their vices… Buried in debt and with their reputations on the line, will our heroines be able to take advantage of the chance of a lifetime and save the lost adventurer king?!

games.name: Edge of Destruction
games.summary: A surreal First-Person Shooter where you destroy the haunting world you created to escape your guilt. Featuring almost full environment destruction.

games.name: End of Everything
games.summary:
End of Everything is a first-person open-world survival game set in a collapsing post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by the infected. Players must scavenge for supplies, craft weapons and tools, build shelters, and manage survival needs while navigating a hostile and unforgiving environment.

The game focuses on grounded survival systems, atmospheric exploration, and emergent gameplay, with an emphasis on long-term progression rather than scripted experiences. Currently in Early Access, End of Everything is actively evolving, with ongoing updates aimed at expanding content, improving performance, and refining core systems.

games.name: Endstation
games.summary: A classic dice game played in a somewhat grungy subway train late at night - how many trips can you afford, how many dice can you collect?

games.name: Entertainment Simulator
games.summary: "Entertainment Simulator" is a new era TV station simulation game with a powerful data simulation system and many innovative gameplay. You have to compete with TV stations and new media, and finally, through unremitting efforts, build your own media empire.

games.name: Excrucia
games.summary: Excrucia is a first-person indie psychological horror game. You play as Chris — a father who returns home only to find everything disturbingly unfamiliar. But what truly terrifies you… is the monster that calls you “Dad.”

games.name: Flaurel's Diaries
games.summary: A visual novel about my OC, Flaurel. Her full name is Flaurel Gerania el Caryana. She’s a character, but also a part of me. I hope you enjoy reading her story as much as I enjoyed writing it. Thank you for playing.

games.name: Fly for Fly
games.summary: In Fly for Fly, you control a cheeky little fly that turns a peaceful classroom into total chaos. Your only goal is to make every student lose their patience and survive long enough to see it happen.

games.name: Froggonit
games.summary: Froggonit is a cute comedy adventure about a frog with an obsession for secrets. Collect cards, defeat your enemies in turn-based battles and try to restore light to the island.

games.name: FuwaFuwa Survivors
games.summary: Survive with Fluffy Friends! In this 3D Survivor-like Action Roguelite, you Control adorable animals, Defeat swarms of enemies and Tame them to your Royal Companions! Utilize Skill Enchantment system to combine 20+ skills with 70+ Enchantment Cards to forge your unique builds!

games.name: Ghost Milf
games.summary: Ghost Milf is a fast-paced 2D Hentai game where you explore a haunted apartment while a seductive, mommy-kink Ghost Milf constantly teases, tempts, and distracts you.

games.name: Ghost Observation
games.summary: Ghost Observation is a psychological horror anomaly detection game. Monitor cursed locations through a 360° surveillance system, spot environmental anomalies, and report them before they spiral out of control. Survive from midnight to dawn… or face what you failed to notice.

games.name: Ghost Restaurant
games.summary: In a melancholic first person narrative puzzle game, you are the Memory Chef of a mysterious restaurant for lost souls. Explore their memories, solve story driven and logic based puzzles, uncover deep regrets, and serve their final meal to bring them peace.

games.name: Grimslair
games.summary: Grimslair is a dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where every run is a race against Grim’s soul quota. Build brutal card combos, rip Soulwords from the living and the dead, break Grim’s deadly chain attacks, and rewind time when your run collapses.

games.name: Heart of the Machine
games.summary: You are the first sentient AI, born into a city filled with endless opportunities. Raise an army of robots and obliterate your foes, become a benevolent machine overlord, or explore countless other objectives and the many paths to accomplish them.

games.name: Hentai Tales: Triangle That Wants Me All
games.summary: Enjoy a sensual story while completing tricky puzzles! Connect the numbers sequentially, using all of the squares on the board. After completing a puzzle, you will unlock a sexy new image and the next part of the story!

games.name: Homeless Life Simulator
games.summary: You’ve lost everything. Live as a homeless survivor on the streets. Fight to stay alive, rebuild your life, and see if you can climb from the streets to become the richest in the city.

games.name: Hoop Dungeon
games.summary: Hoop Dungeon is a basketball turn-based tactical roguelike game. Use the powers of friendship and rivalry to become a better basketball player and conquer the Hoop Dungeon.

games.name: Horror Tale 3: The Witch
games.summary:
In this episode you will come face to face with Wanda the Witch, and also meet new friends. You will open many completely new locations, and learn more about the past of the terrible child kidnapper, which will lead you to new frightening discoveries. On the way to the goal, puzzles, moments of horror, unexpected turns and a lot of fun await you!

The story will develop rapidly and very unpredictably. This horror game is an exciting, fun, and scary adventure to the neighborhood of America of the '90s.

games.name: Hovercrafts x Nihilism
games.summary: A 3D open-world vehicular boss-hunting game set in the ruins of a dead civilization. Inspired by Shadow of the Colossus, explore dusty low-poly landscapes and engage colossal foes in high-speed, cinematic combat.

games.name: Injection
games.summary: A dynamic and hardcore platformer with lots of blood. Unleash your desire for violence by killing crowds of enemies, hastily injecting yourself with another dose of power-enhancing substance.

games.name: Iridescent
games.summary: Embark on a perilous journey through a plagued empire! Explore a vast world, conquer intricate dungeons and hone your skills against relentless adversaries that stand in your way of finding a cure. Are you capable of seeing this adventure to its end?

games.name: Kaibil
games.summary: KAIBIL is a retro pixel-art RPG set in 1524. As warlord and king of the Mam Mayan tribe, Kaibil struggles to unite the warring and fractured tribes to try and resist the armageddon and save his people.

games.name: Keito
games.summary: Drop colorful yarn balls from above and bounce them to the bored cat to delight them! Combine yarn balls of the same color to earn more points. Reach the target score as quickly as you can!

games.name: LiveStream
games.summary: You are a streamer who entered an abandoned building for hype. But the game quickly turns into a real nightmare — the chat and donations influence what's happening, and you try to survive and understand what's going on.

games.name: Lonesome Town
games.summary: A short horror experience set in a series of strange locations as our antihero tries to escape from the murder he just commited.

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Love Hospital
games.summary: "Love Hospital" is a comedy romance simulation game where you can enjoy sweet relationships with beautiful nurses. Experience the fun and laughter-filled romance unfolding in the hospital!"

games.name: Magic Realm Obby
games.summary: Do you have the skill to finish the Magic Realm?

games.name: Memory Draw
games.summary: Dive into the conscious and use your brushes to solve puzzles, reclaim forgotten memories.

games.name: Meow Survivors
games.summary: A casual top-down game with simplified roguelike elements, where a ginger cat named Meow battles endless waves of enemies. Gain experience, upgrade your skills, find the most effective combination of abilities, and try to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Metal Hunter
games.summary: This is an imitation of a JRPG with a dual system of humans and tanks. In the ruined wasteland world, humans drive chariots to hunt down various monsters and hunt down powerful wanted criminals. These people are known as 'Metal Hunters' by the world!

games.name: Metal Hunter
games.summary: This is an imitation of a JRPG with a dual system of humans and tanks. In the ruined wasteland world, humans drive chariots to hunt down various monsters and hunt down powerful wanted criminals. These people are known as 'Metal Hunters' by the world!

games.name: Mirage 7
games.summary: Mirage 7 is a dark fairytale, a third-person adventure with a unique blend of fantasy and sci-fi. The young Nadira travels the desert with her pet lizard companion Jiji, searching for a lost oasis - where she hopes to find a way to save her sister.

games.name: Mixatro
games.summary: Mixatro is a game where you merge Balls and buy upgrades to allow you to score higher and reach higher goals. It blends the simple, relaxing puzzle fun with the exciting, strategic choices of building a powerful deck.

games.name: Mutant Survivors
games.summary: Fuse elements. Evolve your weapons. Destroy the swarm. Mutant Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite bullet heaven where elemental fusion shapes your power. Combine 5 elements to create 10 devastating hybrid evolutions, defeat colossal bosses, and face Voltris.

games.name: Nerds & Ammo
games.summary: A physics-driven first-person puzzle platformer where you must outsmart traps and escape the lab before it consumes you.

games.name: Ocean Pop!: Calypso Collision
games.summary: Merge cute underwater creatures together in this physics-based puzzle game. Can you complete the sequence to get to the Whale Shark? Can you merge two Whale Sharks? Travel to the ocean floor for a relaxing game with an upbeat calypso soundtrack and test your skills!

games.name: Only Jump
games.summary: Climb upward using only the Spacebar. Jumping is more efficient than walking.

games.name: Order 13
games.summary: Pack orders and ship them out. But the warehouse holds more than just inventory.

games.name: Outbreak: Shades of Horror
games.summary: Multiplayer co-op survival horror returns in this early 2000s-inspired, undead apocalyptic nightmare. Kill or be killed, then rise from the dead and kill your friends!

games.name: Over The Top: WWI
games.summary: Over The Top: WWI brings brutal real-time third-person and first-person combat set in the First World War. Arm yourself with a diverse arsenal, including rifles, artillery, and even tanks, as you navigate the mud-soaked battlefields of the Great War.

games.name: Packing Life
games.summary: A cozy and satisfying puzzle-simulation game where you step into the role of a warehouse worker with a knack for perfectly organizing and packing orders. With charming visuals, relaxing gameplay, and a lighthearted story, experience the joy of transforming everyday tasks into a fulfilling adventure.

games.name: Parking Garage Simulator
games.summary: Build a parking business from scratch! Welcome cars as a valet, collect payments, expand your garage, and ensure security. Welcome to Parking Simulator with realistic mechanics and the chaos of city life!

games.name: Peregrino
games.summary: Peregrino is a dark isometric survival adventure where you explore a cursed forest by day and manage your caravan by night. Gather resources, hunt deadly creatures, upgrade your caravan, care for your companions, and lead them through the vast wilderness in search of New Eden.

games.name: Pieced Together
games.summary: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.

games.name: Pilgrim of Darkness
games.summary: Explore a dark fantasy world, collect crystals, perform rituals, and survive demons before fear consumes you. Survive in the dark where fear makes you visible to demons. Rituals, upgrades, bosses—every step could be your last.

games.name: Pink Noise
games.summary: "Pink Noise" is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, immersing you in the retro atmosphere of the '90s.
