Players open packs to collect titles of varying rarity based on popularity, complete franchise sets, and trade cards through a server-synced marketplace.

The game features a central currency used to acquire packs, trade with other players, and buy listed cards.

Rare shard drops can appear from high-demand games, with each title split into four collectible parts. Collecting all four shards allows a player to craft a unique Relic, with only one Relic ever existing per game.

games.name: GearDude
games.summary: GearDude is an ordinary plumber, working day in and day out just to make ends meet. When he gets a routine call to fix a pipe deep in the city sewers, it sounds like just another dirty job.

games.name: Going Medieval
games.summary: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

games.name: GravBot
games.summary: GravBot is a physics-based puzzle platformer, where you decide which way is "up" as a little robot falls and pivots through each level. Collect all the batteries to win, but watch out. A wrong move could be deadly!

games.name: Hearthstone: Cataclysm
games.summary: Cataclysm is Hearthstone's 32nd expansion, featuring 135 new collectible cards released on March 17, 2026. This expansion continues the story of Across the Timeways, where Murozond refused to accept the defeat from Chromie, smashing the Hourglass of Time and opening a portal to a nightmare timeline where Deathwing never fell.

games.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction
games.summary: A turn-based sci-fi strategy that combines exploration and exciting clashes on the battlefield. Take control over several different species, raise powerful armies for your heroes and destroy your opponents! This HoMM-like is set in a scifi universe, with new mechanics on top of the classic formula.

games.name: I Shouldn’t Have Drawn That!
games.summary: Decks are dungeons. Each turn reveals four cards and you must face three: fight monsters, swap weapons, or manage your health in this single player rougelike dungeon crawler. Build custom dungeons and share runs with your friends using the same shuffled decks, so everyone faces the same challenges!

games.name: In Tow
games.summary:
In Tow is a fast-paced one-button game.

You score points by collecting chickens. The more chickens you have, the more points you get. To collect chickens, you run forward and jump between platforms. Hold a button to jump higher, press a button while mid-air to jump multiple times. The number of times you can jump depends on the number of chickens you have and you lose one chicken with each additional jump. You lose all your chickens when you hit a bullet.

The game is over when you fall or hit a bullet when you don't have any chicken.

games.name: Jaxx Blorgin's UFO Jam
games.summary: Legendary space-baller Jaxx Blorgin is comin' at you with the only UFO sports title licensed to use his name! Master physics and your UFO to shoot, dunk and defend in this arcade basketball game.

games.name: Jimmy Jumps
games.summary: Jimmy Jumps is a throwback platformer that combines the simplicity of classic platformers with the mechanical depth of speedrunning. Compete for high scores in over 90 hand-crafted levels!

games.name: Jiǔměizǐ zhī Sǐ: Zhāohé Shàonǚ Xuèsè Gàobái
games.summary: In 1988, on the eve of the bursting of Japan's bubble economy, he transformed himself into a detective who was wrongly accused of a crime. He investigated the strange suicide case of Qingmei, which led to the secret of a 20-year-long serial murder case. He shuttled through the streets of Showa, which were filled with cigarettes, alcohol and neon lights. Amidst the choices between human hearts and life and death, he searched for clues and found the truth of the bloody case.

games.name: KeyBreach
games.summary: Your keyboard is your weapon. In this high-speed typing roguelike, speed isn't enough. Stack items to break the game economy, exploit glitches for profit, and battle unique bosses. Reach Root Access before the timer hits zero. Try not to break your spacebar in panic.

games.name: Kimi to Koishite, Soshite Sotsugyou Suru
Linsips
games.summary: Divide chaos into order! In Linsips, place two lines to split bouncing balls into four quadrants with the exact same number of balls in each. 20 levels of pure arcade precision with authentic OPL3 FM synth music, MS-DOS aesthetics, all under 600 KB on SteamOS.

games.name: Maid of Sker VR
games.summary: Maid of Sker VR is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from Welsh folklore. Brave the nightmares of the Quiet Ones. Do not panic…don’t even breathe!

games.name: Medieval Life Simulator
games.summary: Rise from nothing to wealth! Mine ore, harvest crops, cut trees, gather livestock products, sell resources, hire workers, buy rentable houses, gamble with card games, bet on fights, and expand into an empire.

games.name: Midnight Scenes: Among Graves
games.summary: When the graves stop whispering in your ear, it’s time for you to surrender to eternal silence. So says the Agreement, and so it must be fulfilled. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

games.name: Monster Tavern
games.summary: A Roguelite Deckbuilder where drinks are your weapons and monsters are your guests. Serve smart, upgrade your drinks and hold the bar together for another night.

games.name: Never Forget
games.summary: You're trapped in a repeating basement corridor. Watch closely: objects shift, signs change, and something is always slightly wrong. Detect anomalies, choose wisely, and survive the darkness miss a detail and the loop pulls you back.

games.name: Opus Magnum: De Re Metallica
games.summary: An independent story set before the events of Opus Magnum, De Re Metallica follows a maverick alchemical researcher named Saverio Daas, who believes he can unlock heretofore unknown metallurgical secrets. Includes new puzzles, glyphs, story, music, and even a new Sigmar's Garden variant!

games.name: Out of Range
games.summary: Play as a dissident robot who tries to flee a spaceship as other robots thinks you're a menace. Gather new weapons and power-ups to travel through enemy-filled arenas in this 15 minutes action-packed twin-stick shooter adventure

games.name: Pawafuru Puroyakyu: Eikan Nine Crossroad
games.summary:
Eikan Nine is a mode in which you become a high school baseball coach, train your team, and lead them to the Koshien Japan National High School Baseball Tournament.

Powerful Pro Baseball Eikan Nine Crossroad retains the traditional Eikan Nine setup, but adds new elements for even deeper team building, including “Scholarship Students,” “Growth Board,” and “Rival Schools.”

games.name: Petal by Petal
games.summary: Petal by Petal is a relaxing incremental gardening game where mindful movements are rewarded. Water seeds, grow flowers, sell your harvest, and unlock permanent upgrades across a sprawling skill tree.

games.name: Pirate Ghost Ship
games.summary: "Step into the boots of Jack, trapped on a cursed pirate galleon. Solve dark mysteries, hide from the undead, and survive the wrath of a ghostly captain. Every decision you make determines if you'll find the treasure or become part of the ship's crew forever."

games.name: Planetary Inc.
games.summary: A short incremental game about building a career by destroying planets, meeting corporate goals, and investing in profitable — and maybe not so ethical — ventures.

games.name: Pretend Cars Racing 2
games.summary: An old school top-down racer with split-screen multiplayer, track editor and night and day transitions.

games.name: Primarch
games.summary: Primarch is a roguelike auto-battler centered on a single hero. After being exiled to a foreign planet, you are challenged by a fallen God and pitted against your comrades to determine who is most worthy of the title ‘Primarch’.

games.name: Project Castaway
games.summary: Project Castaway is a survival crafting title set in the Pacific Ocean. Live the life of a stranded castaway, with only yourself - and the island's inhabitants - for company! Sail the ocean, hunt, explore unique islands and gather resources as you fight for survival.

games.name: Rags to Riches
games.summary: Rags to Riches is a financial market simulation where you build wealth through investments, business tactics, and ruthless decision-making. Start from humble beginnings and climb the Wall Street ladder by hiring employees, making risky trades, and accumulating luxury assets. Choose from historically accurate eras like the Great Market Crash of 1929 or the 1980s, each with unique scenarios. Decide whether to use lawyers and spies against competitors, engage in insider trading, or enjoy your success. Watch your office grow as your client base expands across three difficulty levels.

games.name: Retro Rewind: Video Store Simulator
games.summary: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

games.name: Rikua
games.summary: Rikua is a 2.5D action platformer ninja cyberpunk game surrounded in beautiful, realistic and futuristic 3D aesthetics, and introduces a unique hack-and-slash/third-person-shooting mechanics that will keep you constantly on the edge!

games.name: Saccharine Echo
games.summary: Saccharine Echo is a story that walks the line between psychological drama and dark paranormal romance. Your choices will shape the fate of a young woman haunted by an obsessive entity from another world.

games.name: Sculplings
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Sculplings! Here, trainers collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion! Sculplings is a mashup of roguelikes with traditional monster fighter games!

games.name: Shapes of Memory: Jigsaw Puzzle
games.summary: Shapes of Memory brings the tranquility of Suitcase Stories to the traditional jigsaw puzzle format. Choose an illustration from the original game and lose yourself in the calm flow of putting pieces together. A Zen experience to organize your mind and complete beautiful images without rushing.

games.name: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online
games.summary: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online is a clicker game where progression is replaced with gambling, where the goal is simply to collect the rarest silly linguine cats.

games.name: Skeleseller
games.summary: Skeleseller is a laid-back idle game set in a vibrant fantasy world. You're a skeleton shopkeep who hires adventurers to collect loot for you after your untimely demise. Send adventurers into battle, sell what they find, and build up your town!

games.name: Sludgineers
games.summary: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, and unlock new areas and perks.

games.name: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club
games.summary: Join Snoopy and the gang in an all-new mystery adventure packed with charm, clever puzzles, and heartwarming friendships! Step into Snoopy’s paws and detective hat as you explore the town, solve challenging cases, and uncover hidden secrets—with help from the lovable Peanuts gang.

games.name: Sphere Shootout
games.summary: "Blue Warrior 4" is a 2D cover tactical shooting game. The key to win in the game is not the shooting technique but the tactical walking.

games.name: Sub Optimal Co.
games.summary: It's simple. Maneuver your submarine to collect the target and return back to base while not scratching the cave-walls. Invite your friends to take control. Navigate carefully and consider every move while exploring unique cave systems in this slow pace, athmospheric, multiplayer diving experience.

games.name: Tales of Klodan
games.summary: Prince Fescillia's mission in Klodan was meant to bring peace, but the cold hides something far more sinister. Alongside his friend Leonar, he becomes entangled in shadows of the past and meet a mysterious warrior in a beastly mask. Five paths, one fateful choice… Will the prince find the right one?

games.name: Tekken: Dark Resurrection
games.summary: A port of Tekken: Dark Resurrection, originally released on the PSP (PlayStation Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: The Abyssal Maze
games.summary: Trapped in a nightmarish labyrinth, you have only two goals, find the ancient book and escape. But the walls are alive with echoes, and the monsters that stalk the corridors never sleep.

games.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
games.summary: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

games.name: The Cube, Save Us
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic extraction action game built around brutal, close-quarters combat. Step through the Cube Gate and discover ever-shifting worlds filled with strange landscapes and terrifying enemies. Escape the Cube by fighting your way through twisted mutants and Raiders you once called allies.

games.name: The Demon's Apple: Otome Game
games.summary: The Demon's Apple is a Dark Fantasy otome game with mature content. Pomme, a herbalist as to make an alliance with a bloodthirsty demon she saved to survive in a world hostile to both. Play as Pomme who has to learn to live under the same roof as the demon who wants her blood and more.

games.name: The Ratline
games.summary: A murdered priest. A secret list. Hunt Nazi fugitives across the globe in this gritty 1971 detective thriller. Analyze evidence, follow leads, and make sharp deductions before the trail goes cold. From the creators of Family, Rivals, Conspiracy, Echo Beach and Riley & Rochelle.

games.name: Thelos
games.summary: Your main ability is to place two crystals on a viable surface and pull towards them. You can use dashing, jumping, running, and perform a special jump which is available after collecting rewards. Your opposition will be two types of sentries, dragons, mines, and traps who all want to keep you down.

games.name: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor
games.summary: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Hop into the cabs of North Western Railway’s classic steam team to enjoy nostalgic stories and all-new narratives right from the drivers’ seats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await!

games.name: Till and Hat
games.summary:
Till & Hat is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action game for the SNES.

Take control of Till, a whip-wielding thief in pursuit of treasure, and Hat, a mysterious sentient artifact she recovers from the Imperial vault who lends her his powers.

Use your whip and newly-found shooting abilities to their fullest to fend off the incoming legions of imperial soldiers and machines sent to hunt you down.

Along the way, you will come across a wide variety of environments and unique gameplay segments which aim to show off the various strengths of the hardware.

The game has been fully made in assembly targeting actual SNES hardware, and should work on any compatible system, clone or emulator.

games.name: Timber Rush
games.summary: Timber Rush is a fast-paced incremental roguelite where every swing explodes into upgrades, chaos, and massive numbers.

games.name: Trinket Bag Maker
games.summary: Trinket Bag Maker is a retro sandbox game inspired by the 2000's girl games, where you can create your own trinket bag! Choose between many adorable charms and bags to create the trinket bag of your dreams!

games.name: Twisted Fate
games.summary: A turn-based roguelike with a deep ability-modification system. Lead a party of three heroes, adapt their skills using modifiers, collect artifacts, and craft unique builds to destroy the source of corruption… or die trying.

games.name: Valkyrie Destruction
games.summary: Explore a classic JRPG world together with a cute battle maiden! Upon being rescued from a monster by a passing battle maiden, the protagonist Batz begins journeying together with her. But taking advantage of her weakness, the scoundrel Batz has other plans for his beautiful savior.

games.name: Victorian Debutante
games.summary: Simple visual novel in which you play as a young upperclass woman preparing for her debut before the Queen and her royal relatives. All of your decisions lead to one of four very different endings. Who will you become? The jewel of the season or the outcast, never again mentioned by your family?

games.name: Whispers of the Eyeless
games.summary: Guide your Cult. Oversee your Sanctum. Stay in the Shadows. Serve the Dead Gods.

games.name: Wild Wizard War
games.summary: You are an all powerful Wizard. Craft spells from elemental cards. Battle against friends and other Wizards in this turn based party game. Learn deep elemental synergies or lean into wild magic for over the top destruction. Fast paced duels and the luck of the draw ensure no two battles are alike.

games.name: A Game About Achieving Stuff
games.summary: Cut out the annoying "gameplay" and get straight to what matters: making numbers go up. Walk down identical corridors, hoard useless loot, and perform 200 highly specific, stupid tasks just to make a little notification pop up on your screen. Pure achievement satisfaction.

games.name: AI.VI
games.summary: A mercenary robot is forced out of retirement as the P.A.S.C.A.L. Gigacorporation conquers his planet to squeeze it dry. Combine your FPS and tower defense skills, then send the corporate invaders to the scrapheap, seize the means of production, and take the planet back for the worker bots!

games.name: Abandoned Stories: Inherited Silence
games.summary: Adopted into a new family, Maria soon realizes she was never meant to feel safe there. Trapped inside a quiet home with something watching you, Maria must uncover the truth behind a growing nightmare.

games.name: ArvusForge
games.summary: Craft your own weapons and carve your path in this fast-paced 3D roguelike action game. Defeat enemies, collect materials, and build powerful gear as you progress through a node-based world. Every run is a new challenge with randomized skills and endless crafting possibilities.

games.name: Awakeroots
games.summary: Awakeroots is a passion project—crafted by two brothers who combine creativity with a deep love for Slavic culture and storytelling. It’s not just a game—it’s a journey into a world that could have been… and now awakens again.

games.name: BK Simulator
games.summary: A simple Idle game, designed specifically for use with the Archipelago Randomizer program. Walk to 'BK' to get lunch, and find random items; either for yourself (ex. to help you walk faster), or for others in your randomizer room (to help them with whatever game they are playing).

games.name: Back to the Village
games.summary:
Back to the Village — build your dream farm and enjoy a peaceful life in this cozy indie game!
Have you ever dreamed of escaping the noisy and polluted metropolis? The hero of Back to the Village takes this step and starts a new life among fields, gardens, and cozy buildings.
Create a farm from scratch that you can truly be proud of: grow crops, care for animals, develop production, and step by step turn a small household into a thriving business. And who knows — maybe this story will inspire your own farm

games.name: Big Theft Valkeala 3: Revenge
games.summary: Terentius Duval is dead and his Wife Mary Duval is coming to Valkeala to rob money and finish missions in this third part of third person open world action game

games.name: Cloudwalkers
games.summary: Cloudwalkers is a hilarious third-person shooter-platformer where you defend the cloud world from quirky alien invaders.

games.name: Crawling Angels
games.summary: Smash and thrash the mysterious Forever Chicken, a living ragdoll central to a frightful midnight carnival. Your Uncle Tontine assures "you can leave as soon as you desire" but despite their efforts no child has ever gone home... Will you be the first?

games.name: Curse of the Mirror
games.summary: Curse of the Mirror is a 2D platformer that features a unique set of mechanics and ideas in each and every level inspired by similar games in its genre, a simple moveset that's easy to learn but difficult to master, and a rich story with fun and quirky characters!

games.name: Defender of the Kingdom
games.summary: "Indie wave-based defense game with exploration and resource management. Protect the castle, face hordes, and complete missions as the weather and day/night cycle change with each challenge."

games.name: Defending Camelot
games.summary: Defending Camelot is a tower defense video game, similar to Plants vs. Zombies, developed for PCs and consoles. The game involves Arthur who use a variety of different warriors to prevent an army of monsters from entering Camelot.

games.name: DigDigDrill
games.summary: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

games.name: Everything Will Be Fine!
games.summary: A dark conversation with a girl during a nightly car trip. A short multi-ending novel game where you try to understand this girl and her pain.

games.name: Fireside Fables
games.summary:
Fireside Fables is a narrative driven 3D platformer, which follows a group of children telling stories around a campfire. These stories then come to life, and you play through them as your favourite plushie!

You will be transported across worlds! From a pirate island, to a lush forest, even to outer space - Anywhere that the children's imaginations can take you!

games.name: Flourish
games.summary: Find your rhythm in the cycle of the garden: prune to gather, water to renew, and trade your clippings for deep-rooted progression.

games.name: Foodslingers
games.summary: Cook, run, jump, and throw— all in the name of FoodCorp. This chaotic, physics-based spin on the classic cooking formula demands speed, strategy, and just the right amount of panic! Play with up to 4 friends and try to run the restaurant smoothly... or let it all go up in flames.

games.name: Foolish Earthlings!
games.summary: A side scrolling side-on shooter from the depths of a long-lost arcade cabinet where you take the role of a UFO on the hunt for human prey! Capture them alive with your tractor beam and pull them into your saucer while unleashing your heat ray upon tanks, planes, and all manner of military might!

games.name: Goritaire
games.summary:
Goritaire is a solo card-based survival game centered on building a troop of seven or more gorillas. The deck consists only of Gorillas and Bananas, demanding strategic balance.

Bananas are essential for survival; if the supply fails, the troop scatters, resulting in defeat.

Strategically master diverse actions unique to each stage, expand the troop, and secure the necessary resources to reign as the master of the jungle!

games.name: Gun Store Simulator
games.summary: Take control of a gun store in Gun Store Simulator and manage every aspect of the arms trading business. Buy licenses, select products, hire staff, and ensure safety to grow your store and build a successful chain. Can you dominate the market?

games.name: Gunja Tteokbokki
games.summary: Orders pouring in, broth bubbling over, and the daily pressure of balancing the books! Manage your ingredients, cook tteokbokki to perfection, and run your very own shop in this culinary tycoon simulation game.

games.name: HSNU Academy 79th Anniversary
games.summary: "HSNU Academy 79th Anniversary" is a dark, narrative puzzle game set at HSNU. Explore the campus via chat to uncover secrets and reach multiple endings. This 1-hour experience unlocks Free Mode upon completion. Stay tuned for new games in future celebrations!

games.name: HeadHunters
games.summary: HeadHunters is a chaotic couch/online party game where you don’t pick a character… you are the head. Attach to different bodies to gain new weapons and abilities, and adapt on the fly. Improvise. Adapt. Overcome. Up to 4 players. Fully cross-platform. Don’t lose your head.

games.name: Idle Hacking: An Inaction RPG
games.summary: A persistent idle MMORPG, with a text-based hacking theme. Enjoy the "Inaction RPG" design philosophy by crafting equpiment using ARPG influenced prefix/suffix systems, build or join player managed syndicates, trade on the marketplace, and compete in community events.

games.name: Immortal Clan: Grandmastery
games.summary: Immortal Clan: Grandmastery is an Eastern fantasy xianxia sim-management game. As founding master, build a sect from scratch. Recruit disciples with unique quirks and personalities. Assign daily tasks, guide cultivation, and lead them from mortal to ascension.

games.name: In Their Shoes
games.summary: From the first day of spring, to the last day of winter, wear seven shoes of seven characters and live their most intimate moments. Explore their thoughts, choose their steps and shape their paths in a mumblecore narrative game where the most extraordinary setting is ordinary life itself.

games.name: Jump into the New Year
games.summary: Jump into the New Year! But if you don't keep jumping for three seconds straight, you'll get swallowed up by another world!?

games.name: Last War 2044
games.summary: Last War 2044 will allow you to feel the atmosphere of the world that survived a nuclear war. And with the remnants of mankind, you must be saved from mutated creatures by the help of improvised means of protection.

games.name: Let's Freeze Some Penguins
games.summary: Walnut the Walrus sets out to save his friends, and all of Northern Bear, from the dreaded Emperor Penguin. Luckily, his chilly Walrus Wind is ice cold. Now let's freeze some penguins!

games.name: Letters to Arralla
games.summary: Deliver letters, parcels, and packages to the residents of Arralla, a small fictional island off the coast of Australia populated by big booty cutie fruits! In this relaxing RPG, you play as a mail delivery turnip covering the holiday of the previous mailman. It’s your job to get the mail where it needs to go by solving visual puzzles and exploring.

games.name: M.B.E 3: Horror Escape
games.summary: A first‑person psychological horror, focused on atmosphere, sound, and constant tension rather than cheap scares.

games.name: Manor Dynasty Strategy
games.summary: Begin your journey in the Early Stone Age, when your ancestors lived in simple huts and survived through hunting and gathering. In Manor Dynasty Strategy, every resource you collect and every decision you make lays the foundation for generations to come.

games.name: Mimikaki Collect
games.summary: Operate an ear pick to clear "ear debris = mimigomi" from inside an ear. There are various types of debris, and removing them earns you money. Use your earnings to purchase new ear-cleaning tools and furniture. Decorate your own unique room with the furniture you acquire.

games.name: NevoMove
games.summary: NevoMove is a mobile RPG that turns your real-world steps into in-game progress. The more you walk, the stronger your Nevomon gets. Explore your surroundings to discover portals, capture creatures ranging from common to legendary, and build a team that matches your playstyle. Every Nevomon has unique traits that affect how it fights and evolves, giving you full control over your strategy. You can challenge other players in ranked online battles or jump into casual duels with friends. The game also features daily missions, equippable Arches that add buffs and bonuses, mini-games to earn rewards, and a built-in step tracker to follow your activity over time. A global chat and private messaging let you stay connected with the community. Everything is free to play with no paywalls blocking core content.

games.name: Null: Initiative
games.summary: Shoot and slash your way through Enemies and Levels while upgrading, in Endless Mode and the Campaign in this fast-paced Hack 'n' Slash. You can even face these challenging levels while playing up to 64 players online!

games.name: Overthrown
games.summary: Lift and throw anything as you build and manage your kingdom in this chaotic city builder for 1-6 players. Harness the power of your soul-stealing crown to defend your citizens from bandits and mutants, farm the land, and gather resources. Keep citizens happy or see them desert you!

games.name: Overwords: Infinity
games.summary: Overwords is back: Stack, fuse, and expand.

games.name: Paddlenoid
games.summary: Paddlenoid is a fun brick breaker you can play solo or with a friend. There’s nothing out of the ordinary and absolutely no reason to suspect a deeper purpose. Just have a good time and remember to ignore the crystals!

games.name: Panda Keeper
games.summary: Snack Time!

games.name: Patches
games.summary: A daily spatial logic puzzle game where players create shapes of different sizes in attempt to fill a grid according to the clues contained within.

games.name: Peasant or Rebel?
games.summary: A chaotic, asymmetrical party game for up to 5 players! One player becomes the Lord, while the others are Rebels hiding among the Peasants. Will the Lord expose them in time - or be overthrown?

games.name: Poly Impulse
games.summary: Poly Impulse is a fast-paced FPS platform game where you will have to shoot colorful polyhedrons to impulse yourself through the level. Speedrunning is not an option, only the fastest with godlike aim will get the SS rank.

games.name: Prescription: Madness
games.summary: In this visual novel, you take the role of Tenty, and interact with (mainly) dark and humorous characters, that aim to find the cause of a mysterious virus that's been unleashed in the Overworld.

games.name: R.U.S.H.: Rival Ultimate Steel Hand
games.summary: Rival Ultimate Steel Hand - A 3D fighting game inspired by classic Tekken, which emphasises movement and strategy. The game is in early development, but available for anyone to play for free on itch.io, complete with fully functional rollback netcode. Everyone in the community will be able to contribute by helping me play test builds as the game progresses, and providing feedback and suggestions.

games.name: Rescue Team: Legion of Destruction
games.summary: What began as a scientific breakthrough has spiraled into a nightmare. Now, the Rescue Team needs your help to stop the brilliant engineer that has betrayed the world. Can you save the world from the man who used to dream of building it?

games.name: Revenger 3
games.summary: The third installment in the Revenger series, a retro RPG from the Japanese feature phone era.

games.name: SOG: Vietnam
games.summary: Head to Vietnam as a lone SOG operative. Gear up, upgrade your skills, and explore the danger-filled jungles. Complete the missions assigned by your country and eliminate enemies using napalm and artillery in a brutal, tactical, turn-based 2D roguelite that does not forgive mistakes!

games.name: Scritchy Scratchy
games.summary: Scritchy Scratchy is a satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy tons of scratch-off's, buy an auto scratcher to do all the hard work and win jackpots! Will you risk it all for the big reward or play it safe?

games.name: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
games.summary: Skillfully hide from and sneak past the enemies fields of view, take their formations apart and hide their bodies to cover your tracks. Quick Save will enable you to execute your plans perfectly. Tactically plan actions for your whole team and execute them all at once. Make use of the vertical gameplay and jump from roof to roof to silently kill your foes from above.

games.name: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun - Aiko’s Choice
games.summary: Aiko's Choice is a brand-new standalone addon to the beloved stealth tactics game Shadow Tactics. Set in Japan around the Edo period, you take control of kunoichi adept Aiko and her deadly assassin friends to hunt down the ghosts of her past.

games.name: SpaceShift
games.summary: Save the crew in this 2D puzzle platformer! As a small robot, you manipulate gravity, time, and your size to repair a damaged ship. Use portals to change perspectives, avoid dangerous lasers, and solve creative puzzles in an unstable pixel world.

games.name: Super Clown Puzzles
games.summary: New Super clown platformer where super clown need solve puzzles, avoid traps and collect stars

games.name: The Finals
games.summary: The Finals is the world’s first Dynamism Shooter, a free-to-play, fast-paced, physics-driven, first-person shooter set on the stage of the biggest Gameshow of the future! Fight for Fans and fortune in fully-destructible, virtual Arenas that guarantee no two rounds will ever play the same!

games.name: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight: Definitive Edition

games.name: Avian Knights

games.name: Bang! Bang! Bandits
games.summary:
Looking for a thrilling yet fun-filled combat experience? Look no further than Bang Bang Bandits! This top-rated entertainment game is a must-try, and trust me, you’ll be hooked from your very first playthrough.

All you need to do is shoot, earn coins, and achieve high scores. Being a first-person shooter, all you have to do is aim and shoot, while movement is taken care of. This allows you to focus on shooting and obtaining a massive amount of rewards. What’s special is that the game does not limit the amount of ammo, so you will never run out of bullets while playing, a truly pure entertainment experience.

If you want to tryhard, the game also has 12 unique levels, each with its own differences and attractions, allowing you to discover countless different ways to play. You start the game with a basic pistol, but don’t worry because you can also upgrade your gun! Over time, the weapon you use will become a laser beam, a Gatling gun, or even a giant rocket.

Feeling too easy with the 12 levels above, Challenge Mode will be something that will excite you. This mode has increasing difficulty, so you can accurately test your skills. You can also join forces with friends in a 2v2 battle to bond or solo 1v1 bring hilarious laughter.

With its engaging but extremely easy-to-learn gameplay, diverse levels and creative upgrades, Bang Bang Bandits is rated to bring unforgettable entertainment moments to all players who have the opportunity to experience the game on hand.

games.name: Basketball Classics
games.summary:
5 on 5 Pro Basketball born from the golden era of sports games. This spiritual successor to the 8-bit ballers bridges the gap between retro and today’s simulation games.

Side-scrolling, sweaty arcade action with simplified 3-button gameplay and retro vibes galore. Explore decades of rosters featuring 160+ teams and 800+ players – all with individualized attributes. Introducing the first seamless play calling system of its kind, along with sensational cut scenes. Single player Story Mode unlocks secret teams or engage in endless scream-inducing local multiplayer.

Lace up those hi-tops, hot shot. It's time to show us what you got.

games.name: Console Archives: Ninja-Kid II
games.summary:
Ninja-Kid II was released by UPL in 1988 for an 8-bit home console.¸

In this action game, you embark on an adventure across diverse fields—including mountains, oceans, and caves—to defeat your greatest and most powerful foe, Ashura.

Despite its cute art style, the game offers hardcore ninja action, featuring wall-kicking and intense battles using a wide variety of weapons.

The Console Archives series is developed with the concept of faithfully reproducing masterpieces released on various home game consoles, allowing players to easily enjoy them on the latest hardware.

The series is packed with convenient features, including customizable button layouts and screen settings, as well as the ability to save and load at any point.

Whether you played them back in the day or are experiencing them for the first time, please enjoy the masterpieces that shaped the history of console gaming!

(The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.)

Between being able to hunt down whatever collectibles you want, taking advantage of deep movement mechanics, and three playable characters to choose from, you decide how you tackle this adventure!

games.name: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
games.summary: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach is a third-person action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by otherworldly creatures. Players control Sam Porter Bridges, a retired porter, as he traverses the open worlds of Mexico and Australia to connect isolated survivors to a wireless communication network called the Chiral Network. The core gameplay revolves around delivering packages across hazardous terrain, managing cargo weight, building infrastructure like roads and monorails, and navigating natural disasters. Combat has a greater focus than its predecessor, offering lethal and non-lethal options alongside stealth approaches. You have 5 rounds to meet or exceed the quota, or… you're out. Permanently.

games.name: Valor of Man

Valor of Man is a roguelike tactical RPG where enemies react to your actions, giving you endless chances to outsmart them with your tactics.
Valor of Man is developed by Legacy Forge, small indie studio created by 2 brothers.

games.name: Vanished Puzzle Quest
games.summary: Vanished is an immersive, first-person puzzle adventure where an encroaching fog of forgetfulness which has robbed everyone at the Great Centers of Islamic Science of their memories and you must now battle against a mysterious foe to reclaim memory, history, and purpose.

games.name: Virtual Ties Isekaijoucho Träumerei

Seikai, who had been on the verge of giving up on her dream of becoming an idol, looks somewhat gloomy. Wanting to make her smile again, Yu proposes that she debut as a virtual idol named "Isekaijoucho" based on an illustration he drew himself.

games.name: Voidwrought
games.summary: Voidwrought is a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. Explore the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation and strike down the gods that dwell there. Grow your powers, uncover ancient Artifacts, and expand your shrine amid the wreckage.

games.name: Xray Customs
games.summary: Xray Customs puts you in the role of a customs inspector with one clear responsibility: don’t let anything dangerous slip through. Using an Xray scanner, you search through bags, spot prohibited items, and clear each checkpoint by finding everything that doesn’t belong. Whether you prefer a calm, methodical experience or the thrill of racing against the clock, Xray Customs rewards sharp eyes and attention to detail. It’s easy to pick up, satisfying to master, and turns the simple act of scanning luggage into an engaging and addictive puzzle challenge.

games.name: Yelling At Cats: The Game

games.name: Youth Academy

games.name: Zoo Life Simulator

Build and manage your dream zoo from the ground up!
In Zoo Life Simulator, you can play solo or with up to 4 friends in co-op mode take care of animals, expand habitats, manage staff, and keep your visitors happy in this realistic management and simulation experience.

Start small with simple animals and grow your park step by step as you unlock new biomes and exotic species. Feed, clean, and care for your animals while balancing your zoo’s economy and visitor satisfaction. Whether you’re expanding enclosures, rescuing runaway rabbits, or designing the perfect visitor area, Zoo Life Simulator offers a fun and creative sandbox for all animal lovers.

games.name: 1000 Score: 2D Platformer

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Singapore

games.name: Bobo in Hell

games.name: Capybara Zen
games.summary:
Capybara Zen is an indie narrative game that blends humor, adrenaline, chaos, mystery, and a touch of urban adventure, featuring immersive cutscenes, a complete story mode, and a frantic arcade mode.
You follow an ordinary capybara trapped in an empty, meaningless routine, until a visit to an old place turns its life upside down.
On the way to a job interview, the capybara observes abandoned streets, dirty alleys, closed stores... a city without color, without life, without anything. Along the way, it discovers that the old CapiGames, an arcade abandoned for years, has reopened downtown.
Upon entering and trying to turn on one of the arcade machines, the capybara is suddenly sucked into the game itself.
After a wild interdimensional journey, it awakens as Zen, a stylized, confident, and aggressive version of itself, trapped inside an unstable urban arcade world filled with obstacles, dangers, and unpredictable situations.
The game progresses with an arcade-paced rhythm, featuring constant challenges, money collection, and continuous progression. To free the capybara from this world, the player must reach increasingly higher stages while surviving an environment that grows progressively more chaotic. The story unfolds through cutscenes that can be replayed from the main menu after completing the story mode progression.
Capybara Zen is a frenetic experience that combines fast-paced action, storytelling, and an urban atmosphere. A game about persisting, moving forward, and trying to escape when everything feels out of control.

games.name: Castle Tycoon Simulator
games.summary: Let's build a castle!

games.name: Chris's Classroom
games.summary: Chris's Classroom is a comedic indie horror game where players must collect Stress Toys while avoiding Chris and his friends.

games.name: Chthonian TD
games.summary: Fast-paced co-op action roguelite × tower defense. Fight escalating waves, risk resources in a dangerous mine, defeat the boss - then see how long you survive in Endless.

games.name: Colornova
games.summary: A color matching space shooter about saving your home planet from total destruction!

games.name: Cowboy Kart
games.summary: Good, old-fashioned kart racing in the old west! Up to 4 players.

games.name: Cube KaBaam: Cryptic Trail
games.summary:
The disposal team has discovered a strange transmission after the artefacts on site one were destroyed. Was this discovery meaningless, or could the artefacts hold a greater secret? Site two might just have the answer.

The level of challenge has grown. Fifteen stages will have to be cleared as part of site two. Intelligence suggests that the artefacts found there have regenerative capabilities. Due to these circumstances, central command has issued a software update to all units. Your power-ups will now recharge over time. Make good use of this.

games.name: Curse of the Shadow
games.summary: "Curse of the Shadow" is a BL-themed horror visual novel. Cursed by a "ghost", protagonist Xu finds eerie dark shadows in every photo he takes.Once escaping reality, he’s forced by fate to face fears again.To uncover the curse’s truth, he and two friends embark on a terrifying, unknown journey.

games.name: Desktop Fishing Cat
games.summary: Here’s a cute, chubby black cat. All it wants to do is quietly go fishing. “Right in the corner of your desktop!” Collect fish to fill up the cat’s encyclopedia, earn money, and dress it up in adorable outfits!

games.name: Digger: Goblin Caves
games.summary: Go to the gloomy dungeons in search of treasures. All kinds of traps and monsters will stand in your way.

games.name: Doodle Wipeout
games.summary: Doodle Wipeout is an action rougelite - survive waves of chaotic doodles by erasing them. Dodge, upgrade, and clean the canvas before it’s overrun.

games.name: Dragon Skips
games.summary: Collect coins, and reach higher levels to get the victory. But watch out for the mobs. If you fall down you jump back up again, climbing through these mountains is not easy.

games.name: Excoverse
games.summary: A story-driven action RPG where you play as a noble lord torn between rescuing his lost daughter and leading a dying nation. fast combat, stealth, moral choices, and anime-style intensity await.

games.name: Fading Five
games.summary: Fading Five is a free browser-based strategy game built on the classic five-in-a-row formula with a unique twist: every mark placed has a limited lifespan and gradually fades away, forcing players to factor timing and sequencing into their strategy alongside spatial positioning. The game features a large game board, support for 1-3 players, online multiplayer via room codes and matchmaking, bot opponents, and a local hot-seat mode.Two game variants are available: Classic, with standard fading rules, and Switch, which rotates color assignments between players mid-game. Free to play with no download or account required.

games.name: Fidget Widget
games.summary: Fidget Widget is a collection of mini games that chill on your desktop, ready to play anytime you’ve got a few minutes to spare.

games.name: Football Legacy
games.summary:
Football Legacy offers realistic football manager features: transfers, training, scouting, detailed infrastructure, sponsor negotiations, and matches against real players. Later, it will even be possible to compete against players from all over the world.

Football Legacy places a special focus on long-term development and realistic club building. Unlike in fast-paced casual games, managers start at the bottom: on the cinder pitch of League 6. From here, the aim is not only to strategically strengthen the squad, but also to expand the club's facilities step by step. From a simple training ground to a modern stadium complex, each expansion unlocks new opportunities in training or revenue, making forward-thinking financial planning essential.

Close cooperation with the community is at the heart of the philosophy. Players can provide direct feedback via Discord and social media, which is incorporated into regular updates. The result is a football manager game that is transparently developed "by players for players."

games.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection
games.summary: Command an army of specters, unleash terror on the town of Gravenville, and solve puzzles to unlock mysteries in this strategic adventure game of resource management and supernatural mayhem.

games.name: Gravity Biker
games.summary: Defy gravity and race through thrilling obstacle courses in Gravity Biker! Hop on your futuristic bike and master the art of balance, timing, and precision as you perform daring jumps, flips, and stunts across challenging tracks.

games.name: Grizzly Cup Turbo Challenge '92
games.summary: A retro-inspired local multiplayer arcade racer where you pick a car, race solo or with up to 4 players on one screen, and battle through short, fast-paced events with easy-to-learn but hard-to-master handling. It features three camera modes, distinct cars, single races, Time Attack, multi-race Cups, and a built-in track editor with test drive plus track code sharing for custom circuits.

games.name: GunX
games.summary: Get ready for the ultimate VR Gun assembling experience with PvP Duels, Zombie Campaign and a Shooting Range for perfecting your assembling speed and accuracy. Challenge your friends or join them in co-op and immerse yourself in an adrenaline-fueled fight.

games.name: Happiness Laboratory
games.summary: Happiness Laboratory is a Psychological Horror Visual Novel with 14 Endings!

games.name: HeXO
games.summary:
TicTacToe, but with Hexagons! This is a two-player connection game on an infinite hex grid. Make a straight line of 6 before your opponent to win!
A competitive strategy game for all ages.

games.name: Hell Dice Gambit
games.summary: Hell Dice Gambit is a strategic roguelike game using dice. Collect various relics, dice, and pills to grow stronger and struggle on. Can you escape from the abyss of hell?

games.name: Hentai Tales: Sin City of Lust
games.summary: Neo-Tokyo promised safety and heroes to idolize. But from the depths of its surveillance system, I see a different truth. Their perfect facades hide secrets waiting to be unraveled. With a few keystrokes, I shatter their divine images and invite them into my domain.

games.name: I Became an Evil Witch that Cursed the Male Lead
games.summary: I fell asleep playing a game where you romance a cute grim reaper and then... I woke up as the wicked witch in a dark fairy tale?!

games.name: Inky Blinky Bob
games.summary: Fly a weaponized hot air balloon across a chain of dangerous islands overrun by failed experiments. Scavenge resources, upgrade your flying machine, and dismantle the defenses of an occult biotech corporation before its greatest creation breaks free.

games.name: Isekai Guild Simulation
games.summary: Isekai Guild Simulation is a guild management game where you run an adventurers' guild: recruit adventurers, send them on quests, trade items, and grow your guild's rank and reputation. Manage your party, complete kingdom decrees, upgrade your hall, and balance your gold and fame as your guild rises from humble beginnings to legendary status.

games.name: It's Locked
games.summary: A first-person Backrooms game where you have to wait for PATROL to rescue you. In the meantime, you try to stay safe.

games.name: Kozeni Mushi
games.summary: A game about rummaging through vending machine change while worrying about social status.

games.name: Kuromaku
games.summary: Kuromaku Is An Indie First-Person Psychological Thriller Experienced From A Child’s Perspective. Complete Chores Assigned By Your Mother, Uncover Hidden Secrets, And Survive Unsettling Encounters. Objectives Must Be Completed To Progress Further Into The Rich, Unfolding Story.

games.name: Legend of the Master Baiter Origins: Gills Gone Wild
games.summary: Discover and catch various species of fish as you travel up the Megami River in intense fishing battles, where timing and perseverance are key.

games.name: LoopiaLike
games.summary:
LoopiaLike — A bullet heaven roguelite where spell fusion changes everything.

Choose your wizard, survive endless waves of enemies, fuse spells into devastating combos, and become unstoppable. Every run is different. Every build is unique.

games.name: Lost Wiki: Kozlovka
games.summary: Explore a wikipedia-like database and solve a small town mystery in Eastern Europe. Step into the shoes of a journalist in the 90s as you sprawl through articles and uncover the secrets that have been laid in front of you.

games.name: Machine Gun Fury
games.summary: On a bold and potentially dangerous mission to revive the classic Arcade military shooter. Fully loaded with addictive top-down and side-scrolling run-and-gun gameplay, pixel-perfect 2D graphics, explosive SID soundtrack and massive destruction! Fight on foot and in heavily armed vehicles.

games.name: Mafioso's Dice
games.summary: A high-stakes mafia-themed dice and risk game. Four players roll dice to climb toward victory, then face off in deadly rounds of Russian roulette. Strategy, bluffing, and hidden cards determine who walks away alive.

games.name: Mamon King
games.summary: "Mamon King" is a monster-raising simulation where you aim to become the King. Battles feature simple turn-based command combat, yet each monster possesses unique skills. Combined with the SP required to activate these skills, this creates intense strategic gameplay that anyone can easily enjoy.

games.name: Meta Card Backpack Legend
games.summary: The third installment of the MetaCard series, MetaCard: Backpack Legend, is a backpack management Roguelike card game! Before Battle: Manage your artifact backpack to build and synergize your playstyle. During Battle: Drag and drop cards to unleash skills on key enemies at the right moment.

games.name: Mini Up
games.summary: Mini UP is a free parkour game where every second counts. Optimize your movements, perfect your precision, and achieve faster and faster times.

games.name: Mooooon
games.summary:
You play as Cow, a cow who has always wanted to jump over the moon! Luckily, their friends have figured out a way it might just be possible...

Jump through interesting levels and speak to a cast of silly characters as you make your way there!

games.name: Mote: The Old Office
games.summary: MOTE: The Old Office is a reflective walking simulator where you explore an abandoned startup space through the eyes of its CEO. Wander through meeting rooms, break areas, and forgotten corners as voice memories surface—stories of late nights, impossible deadlines, and the small moments that shaped everything. Along the way, collect 20 hidden donuts—a sweet reminder of the “night shift” days when sugar and panic powered the dream.

games.name: Moto Rush Reborn
games.summary: Feel the pulse of retro-futuristic Tokyo veins urging you to go faster, drawing you deeper. Surrender to the speed, let the thrill consume your essence. Each surge, each flicker of light, is your path to glory or oblivion in 'Moto Rush Reborn'. Is your soul worth this speed?

games.name: Off Course
games.summary: Stuck in a time loop, stop the possessed captain's plans in this cooperate-with-yourself puzzle game. Record each pirate’s actions to solve puzzles, interact with adorable animal companions and get to know the brave pirate crew and the bond they share with each other!

games.name: Only Up Rush
games.summary: Jump, parkour and compete against yourself in thousands of metres of tough challenges. Race the clock, beat it, break records and reach unprecedented heights!

games.name: Paracesium
games.summary: PARACESIUM is a body horror time management game where you collect, analyze, dismember and reassemble body parts in order to create a pure cadaver for your experimentation. Every action takes time, so make your next decision carefully. Manage time, bodies and monsters and stay alive. Who is Delilah?

games.name: Payroll
games.summary: You owe the loan shark everything. Chain devastating combos, break the game wide open, and outsmart the odds. A roguelike deckbuilder where clever beats lucky. Pray it's enough.

games.name: Pie Pie Cafeteria
games.summary: Welcome to Pie Pie Cafeteria, an irresistible puzzle where round little desserts meet, collide, and transform into increasingly delicious treats. Inspired by the Suika style, dive into a charming café where combining identical sweets is the key to fulfilling orders, earning extra time, and keeping everything under control before the mess overflows.

games.name: Poke All Toads
games.summary: A puzzle game starring mischievous fairies. Solve levels by working as a team, operating dangerous machinery and manipulating local wildlife.

games.name: Pound for Pound
games.summary: A sports management simulation where you build an MMA promotion from the ground up by signing fighters, running events, and expanding your reach in a living competitive world.

games.name: Re.dive Wonderland
games.summary: Re.dive Wonderland is a mystery × romance visual novel where a girl wakes up in a strange RPG world with no memories. Make choices, connect with companions, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth. Includes 4 story routes and multiple endings.

games.name: Ringbound
games.summary: Ringbound is an experimental minimalist incremental game

games.name: Rubato
games.summary: A collect-a-thon about a frog fixing the solar system after it explodes for some reason.

games.name: Run Shiba Run!
games.summary: Goma the dog has escaped from their owner’s leash and is running around the park without restraint to eat as many biscuits as they can. Help them fill their stomach before time runs out or choose to explore the park on your terms.

games.name: Samurai Simulator: Kensei Warrior
games.summary: Fight with honor. Decide your fate.

games.name: Shop Farm Tycoon
games.summary: Grow crops, craft goods, and serve happy customers. Turn a small farm store into a thriving business!

games.name: Silent Ward: Forever Lost
games.summary: The game is built using Unreal Engine 5 with an interactive 3D UI. Players must explore the ward and repair damaged circuits while evading the harassment of the Listener. Along the way, they must locate notes left by other survivors. With the help of the item information, they can leave.

games.name: Skinny & Franko: Fists of Violence
games.summary: Brutal next chapter of Amiga's legendary beat'em'up 'Franko: The Crazy Revenge' is here. It's time to clean the streets of shit. The iconic game finally gets a sequel it deserves.

games.name: Socks!
games.summary: Strategic, Satisfying Sock Packing Action! Pair up socks, fresh off the clothesline, in this cute and relaxing physics-based puzzler. Match two socks to roll them up into an adorable bundle and free up space in your sock basket. But don't let your bundle basket overflow either! Pack wisely!

games.name: Spinner Smash
games.summary: Master your spinner in SPINNER SMASH, a 3D Fighting Platformer. Throw, jump, strike, and dodge with your spinner to overcome Aroa’s challenges. Face the leaders of each stage and rise to the top. Give Bart, the school bully, what he deserves!

games.name: Spirit & Steel
games.summary:
The spirits of a remote volcanic island have lived in balance for generations, until William Von Pingleton III arrives with a mining army and a plan to turn them into fuel for his machines. When his first attack knocks the island’s shaman, Ila, off her feet, the spirits answer with a gift: the power to command the elements themselves.

In Spirit & Steel, you play as Ila, a short but stubborn 70-year-old shaman who hits harder than she looks. Swap between elemental fists, chain melee combos, and weave in dashes and air movement to outplay swarms of mechanical enemies in tight, focused combat encounters. Every arena asks you to use your full toolkit; knock foes back with wind, pull them in with crashing waves, and burn through armored threats with searing fire.

As you fight deeper into the island, lush beaches and sacred temples slowly clash with scaffolding, smokestacks, and churning machinery.

Your journey builds toward a final showdown with Pingleton in his volcanic stronghold, where you’ll put all of your unlocked elements to the test. Defeat him, free the captured spirits, and restore the island’s balance, or watch it disappear under steel.

games.name: Spot the Spy Guy
games.summary: Can you find two identical hidden objects?

games.name: Taksakah
games.summary: Taksakah is a strategic multiplayer party game designed for competitive group play and social gatherings. The game features 24 intense rounds where players spin a category wheel to determine their challenges, combined with a tactical card system that allows players to influence the game's flow, sabotage opponents, or boost their scores. Whether played among friends or with a live audience, Taksakah blends luck, knowledge, and strategy into a fast-paced web-based experience on the Joyn platform.

games.name: The Great Flood
games.summary: "A War you can grasp." An upcoming strategy game, featuring the ability to engage in duels in VR/MR Dual Modes.

games.name: The Portsmoor Abysm
games.summary: Explore the Catacombs of Portsmoor, push boulders, avoid deadly traps, face otherworldly monsters, and solve mind-bending puzzles. The Portsmoor Abysm is an atmospheric puzzle game with Sokoban-like mechanics, inspired by classics such as Boulder Dash, Supaplex, or Emerald Mine.

games.name: The Undermall
games.summary: This is an anomaly game set inside a mall. Currently only one store is available ("Warm Subject") with many more planned. Spot the difference game with a touch of horror / jump scares.

games.name: Them's Tale: The Road to Her
games.summary: Them's Tales is a story-driven game series based on Reddit-style storytelling. The stories are written to seem inspired by real events, but they're completely fictional.

games.name: Thor: God of Thunder
games.summary: Thor: God of Thunder is a third-person beat-’em-up where you battle across realms, climb the frozen mountain, and defeat the Frost King. Unlock new armor and storm powers like Thunder Wave and Loki’s Illusion. Crush Frost Giants, transform into a Titan, and fight to a reactive rock soundtrack.

games.name: Tow the Line
games.summary: Chained together meets tow trucks in this challenging platformer. Play solo or co-op!

games.name: Trox: The Reversal
games.summary: TROX: The Reversal is a dark, story driven first person survival-horror game set in a world rebuilt on sacrifice. Explore and investigate your surroundings to uncover disturbing truths and survive the psychological toll of a collapsing society.

games.name: Two Beasts Or Not To Beast!
games.summary: This censored port removes the incest included in the original release. The player takes control of Haruki, who prepares for a study date with his crush on Sunday and must resist the lustful temptations of many women for an entire day. The game functions as a simulator with minigames and time management.

games.name: Upstairs
games.summary: A short classic point-and-click adventure with a verb-based interface and dialogue choices, where you explore a strange building, meet unsettling characters, and slowly uncover a dark, ancient secret.

games.name: Vault Vandals
games.summary: Chaotic local multiplayer roguelite for 2-4 players. Command robots through deadly dungeons - but don't control them directly. Issue AI directives, grab cursed treasures, steal from friends, and escape before the Wall of Doom rises.

games.name: VeilWood
games.summary: Protect your farm from twisted creatures as you cultivate the land and put an end to the Azure Haze in this first person real time strategy dark farming sim.

games.name: Vice Versa
games.summary: Play solo or with up to 5 players in this strategic card-stacking challenge. Place your entire deck on ascending and descending stacks, use clever resets, and survive two unique modes filled with tense, cooperative decision-making.

games.name: Village Merchant
games.summary: Run and expand your own medieval shop! Sell weapons, armor, food, and rare goods to peasants and lords alike in the immersive medieval store simulator.

games.name: VitvitDriver 3D
games.summary: a late-90s inspired eclectic delivery driving game. perform tricks, stack combos and complete deliveries to earn points across a set of unique maps.

games.name: Vlare
games.summary: A supernova, a broken telescope, Lum, and a night full of strange encounters and painful memories. Join Eli on a short, emotional point-and-click journey through the city.

games.name: Whispers of the Seasons
games.summary: You have been marked by a monster to be its next prey. Defend your cabin against the beast across the four seasons, listening out for its attacks to stop it before it gets inside. Complete tasks throughout the night in an effort to free yourself from its curse and return to a normal life.

games.name: Wonders Puzzle
games.summary: Slide. Unite. Wonder.

games.name: Word Quest Space
games.summary: The stars are calling!

games.name: A Game About Fishing
games.summary: Cast your line and unwind in a cozy, stylized fishing game. Explore calm waters, catch charming low-poly fish, and enjoy satisfying, relaxing gameplay at your own pace. A peaceful solo experience focused on comfort, atmosphere, and the simple joy of fishing.

games.name: Bargalian Regicide
games.summary: Bargalian Regicide is a stylized fantasy game about a disgraced prince in servitude of an ancient being. Cut through hundreds of soldiers to bring about change in a crumbling empire.

games.name: Biotype
games.summary: Test the limits of bio-mechanical clone Model 137 a.k.a BIOTYPE in this free, endless bullet hell. Master the Biotype's patented tri-laser and push as far as you can. Will BIOTYPE prove it can make a difference in the fight against the enemy in the real world?

games.name: Conductor: Eternal Service
games.summary: Conductor: Eternal Service is an atmospheric horror simulator of a Russian train conductor. Perform routine duties, sell goods, and keep the carriage in order… until passengers begin to show signs of demonic possession.

games.name: Conservation of Bass
games.summary: The Law of Conservation of Mass states that mass can neither be created nor destroyed; it can however, be rearranged.

games.name: Double Switch: 25th Anniversary Edition
games.summary:
Welcome to the Edward Arms, a mansion full of intrigue and shady characters who are never as they seem. At first, you must watch rooms closely, trapping any intruders with ingenious hidden devices.

Experience Double Switch - 25th Anniversary Edition in a way that has never been experienced before with enhanced video quality and never before seen bonus content.

games.name: Dozy in Grackleland
games.summary:
The main goal of Grackle is to control a little lazy caterpillar named Dozy, who is a bit of a late bloomer. Hatching later than the rest of his buds, he's got to hustle across a few trees, eating leaves and avoiding danger.
The main threats of Grackle include starvation, thorns, frogs, spiders, and of course, grackles.

games.name: Ephialtes
games.summary: THE NIGHTMARES NEVER END. Survive a series of antagonists that linger in the corners of your mind, each playing by their own rules.

games.name: Gambler's Fallacy
games.summary: An isometric action roguelike with light deck building mechanics, set in a high-stakes western casino. Fight your way through rooms of cunning enemies, using strategic card play to escape the gamblers fallacy.

games.name: Gems of Egypt
games.summary: Treasures of Egypt await your match!

games.name: Hail the Devourer
games.summary: Hail the Devourer is a darkly satisfying incremental clicker where destruction becomes progression and razing cities to the ground brings an ancient evil closer to ending it all.

games.name: Ice Slider
games.summary: Ice Slider is a game by Shining Watermelon Studios where you play as a hiker named Rob who enters Icy Cave. A cave with a Gauntlet of Ice Puzzles, in which he has to complete to exit. Play as Rob as he goes through this gauntlet of puzzles.

games.name: Innbc Starfighter
games.summary: A free-to-play 90s-style bullet-hell shooter with high-res graphics, unlocked 60+ FPS, single-player campaign, and online co-op multiplayer!

games.name: Junkyard Garage Simulator
games.summary: Step into Junkyard Garage Simulator, where every rusted wreck tells a story and every repair brings a forgotten legend back to life. Take control of your own fully equipped garage and immerse yourself in the art of car restoration. From scrapyards to showrooms, every vehicle is a challenge waiting to be mastered.

games.name: Mistfall Ruins
games.summary: Follow the mist. Discover the forgotten.

games.name: Pinball Dream
games.summary: Pinball Dream is an 80s arcade-style pinball and brick-breaker game. If you want to relax and relieve stress, this game is perfect for you. Get amazing power-ups, break all the blocks, and defeat the boss! Drop everything and play "Pinball Dream".

games.name: Pure Idle
games.summary: Become the hand of the Creator in search of lost perfection. Collect the light of millions of stars, sending them into the heart of a black hole to find the one — Pure Idle. 505 technologies, production chains, and an endless path to the universe's most beautiful star.

games.name: Rosalie
games.summary: A chaotic 2-player co-op road trip. Share the controls of a pedal car as tourists: sit on the left to turn left, sit on the right to turn right! Coordination is key!

games.name: Smash Balls 2
games.summary: Aim fast. Smash hard.

games.name: Threadline
games.summary: A clean, rhythm‑infused precision runner where you weave through shifting obstacles with focus and flow. Threadline rewards instinct, timing, and mastery, delivering short, intense runs that pull you into a calm, satisfying state of momentum.

games.name: Crazy Hotel Together
games.summary: Discover Crazy Hotel Together, a hotel management game where you and your friends have to run a rather unusual hotel! Fulfill your guests’ requests and upgrade your establishment to transform it from a low-cost hotel into a palace!

games.name: DeckLand
games.summary: DeckLand is a rogue-lite combining deck-building with the Korean traditional Yutnori game. You are a guru returning to the kingdom of morning calm. Use various cards and tools to break through obstacles, defeat strong enemies, and approach the source of the catastrophe plaguing the kingdom!

games.name: Egregore
games.summary:
EGREGORE is a short surreal puzzle game with tones of mild horror.

Your objective is to venture through your mind and make the most of the last few minutes you have on this plane of existence.

games.name: Eternal Chrysalis Dream
games.summary: a yume nikki fan game made by shell32224 with programming/music help from catcatcatsix

games.name: Fear of Hunger
games.summary: Healthy breakfast before school lunch

games.name: Hyouhon Hako de Uka wo Matsu
games.summary: A romance between an unidentified human-plant and an human(?) girl, both of them trapped in a cage.

games.name: Inside The Mind Of Irene Moroz
games.summary: A game about the past.

games.name: Iris
games.summary: A Yume Nikki fangame and love letter to RPG maker games and Yume Nikki itself.

games.name: Keg & Quest
games.summary: Keg & Quest is a free-to-play idle RPG with online multiplayer. Build your hero, join a guild, compete in PvP, and take part in world boss events where strategy and progression matter more than reflexes.

games.name: Mistbound
games.summary: «Mistbound» is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological romance genre. Loneliness can be too loud. And salvation can be too quiet!

games.name: Roco Kingdom
games.summary:
Roco Kingdom: World is the official sequel to the classic "Roco Kingdom" IP developed by Tencent's Morefun Studios. Built on childhood nostalgia, it combines creature collection and battles, open-world exploration, and casual social features into one charming new Roco Kingdom!

No gacha, no selling creatures — over 400 elves are completely free to catch! Enjoy fair multi-system turn-based battles, full cross-platform support (PC, Android, iOS), and seamless single-player roaming or co-op adventures.

Magic, stunning scenery, egg hatching, farming, dressing up... Play exactly the way you like, build unique bonds with your elves, and relive the dream world from your childhood!

Players take on the role of a freshman at the Magic Academy, venturing into the vast Kalosia Continent teeming with elves. Form deep bonds with your creatures, uncover the world's secrets, and make choices in times of crisis. With over 50 hours of story content and 347+ elves in the illustrated handbook, a brand new adventure awaits!

games.name: Shū Liàn yǔ Jūn: Xiānzǐ Xiàn
games.summary: A vibrant, white-haired beauty, but her true identity is actually a timid, short-haired, glasses-wearing girl?! I'm still dating her! A 200% sweet college romance! Dates, hand-holding, hugs, kisses, and marriage after graduation!

games.name: Summer’s Heartbeat
games.summary: Village romance hotter than summer's heat! Drowning in debt, you escape to the countryside only to meet the loan shark noona, your first love, and the tsundere village princess! This summer, your heart’s melting faster than ice cream. Who’s going to set your world on fire?

games.name: Suprabac.io
games.summary:
You like the Scattergories game ?
You will love Suprabac !
Compete against your friends and be quick to find the right words !

games.name: The Case of Arcadia Springs
games.summary: A short, story-driven, detective-mystery game where you are tasked with solving a deceptively simple break-in case. Meet the citizens of Arcadia Springs, find and follow the clues, make the right choices, and you may unlock a dark secret kept under lock and key.

games.name: Trigger of Silence
games.summary: "Trigger of Silence" is a first-person survival defense game that combines intense melee combat with firearms. In this invaded world, you play as a super soldier tasked with holding your ground and fending off waves of dragon-like creatures.

games.name: $$$://Somnialys, I Am Tired So I Bought a Couple Dreams
games.summary: Explore the dreams purchased by someone who is bored with their life.

games.name: A Little Physics Roguelike
games.summary: In A Little Physics Roguelike aim to grab the best equipment, then build your unique board with a variety of item to defeat cute enemies.

games.name: A Sinister Glitch
games.summary: You're a punk hacking into the cameras and devices of an abandoned building. Except it's not really abandoned, and whatever inhabits it senses your presence and plans to eliminate you.

games.name: Al'ulA
games.summary:
First-person narrative puzzle game made by a team of French students!
In Al’ulA you play as Mariam, a moroccan astronomer that just lost her mentor. One day while studying, she discovers a strange cube, a prototype created by a strange Entity.
You will manipulate the room around you using the alien Artefact : turn, rotate and twist the environment to your will and pierce the secrets of a strange and unknown dimension!

Think, Rotate, Escape

games.name: Assassin of Monsters 2: Spacenator
games.summary: FPS Shooter game where warrior with space weapon need kill 6 different bosses in 6 different levels and collect items. So be a hero and fight against several different big enemies

games.name: Astro & Suzy Go to the Circus
games.summary: Astro & Suzy are going to the circus! There are all kinds of yummy circus food being shot out of the circus cannons that Astro & Suzy are happy to eat.

games.name: Cyberscape
games.summary: Cyberscape is a classic FPS with RPG elements, inspired by the best traditions of the 90s. It features open-ended level design, multiple playstyles, character upgrades, an inventory system, full modding support, and a built-in level editor.

games.name: Dam Rush XD
games.summary: A fast-paced 2D action platformer where you play as a determined beaver fighting off enemies, dodging hazards, and surviving the wild. Grab you wood to complete your dam and get to the next level!

games.name: Detective 26
games.summary: DETECTIVE 26 is a relaxing, turn-based mystery board game for 5-minute investigations. Roll dice and traverse low-poly maps to gather clues. Use logic to unmask the Wanted before turns run out! Level up your rank, unlock new content, and master the art of being a true detective!

games.name: Diggin It
games.summary: Dig, upgrade, and take risky buffs in this chaotic tunnel adventure! Team up with your loyal cat and dog companions, discover powerful upgrades, and decide how far you're willing to push your luck while digging deeper and deeper.

games.name: Dungeon Bodega Simulator
games.summary: Dungeon Bodega Simulator is a retro styled fantasy shop game where you can grow crops, brew potions, sell items and raise slimes as pets! Can you build up your bodega into a one stop adventuring shop while solving the mysteries of the dungeon beneath you?

games.name: Floppy Dick
games.summary:
Floppy Dick is an arcade game inspired by classic side-scrolling reflex challenges.
Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible while navigating increasingly difficult obstacles.

What starts as a silly and absurd concept quickly turns into a demanding test of timing, focus, and precision.

games.name: Focus Knight
games.summary: Focus Knight is a relaxing focus and productivity RPG. Set a timer, stay focused, and watch your hero automatically explore dungeons, fight enemies, and grow stronger. The longer you focus, the greater the rewards.

games.name: Formula
games.summary: FORMULA is a game in which you need to fly a ball and collect elements of the formula. After each collection, the shape of the curve of the field changes, along which you can move. Points are awarded after selecting each element of the formula. The game ends when the ball touches the walls of the narrowing field.

games.name: Frog Holm
games.summary: Unexpectedly, you become the owner of a pub that has seen better days. During the day, set sail to explore a variety of new islands, each with its own unique treasures and ingredients for your cocktails. Can you restore the pub to its former glory? Dive into this charming adventure and find out!

games.name: Frozen Stillness
games.summary: Frozen Stillness is a rich yet concise pixel-art story about a father and daughter trying to survive on a planet that was once their home but has now become a deadly trap. Keep track of the characters’ conditions, use your energy shield and weapons to stay alive.

games.name: Game Dev Simulator
games.summary: Game Dev Simulator is a story-driven VR office simulator. Players take on the role of a new hire at 'Mundane Interactive', a small game studio, where they test games on a fully interactive virtual PC. The game features a fictional operating system with playable mini-games, a phone call system, emails, and an unfolding narrative that's deeper than it first appears.

games.name: Golfle
games.summary: A daily golfing game, where players aim to complete a unique 9-hole course in as few strokes as possible.

games.name: Jesus Simulator
games.summary:
Jesus Simulator is more than a game — it is an interactive journey of faith, choice, and spiritual reflection.
Live the story. Become a witness. Discover its meaning.

games.name: Journey of the Garden Rose
games.summary: Lily must explore a fantastic palace and contest with the machinations of a cruel prince to rescue her mother in this Old-School 3D Action-Adventure game!

games.name: Kakegurui All In
games.summary: Kakegurui ALL IN is a browser-based strategy board game based on the Kakegurui anime television series. Players roll dice to advance across stages in a board-game format, with the goal of progressing through increasingly challenging levels. Gameplay centers on collecting characters and items drawn from the Kakegurui franchise, which can be equipped to provide strategic advantages during play. As the player builds their collection, they gain access to stronger combinations that influence the outcome of each stage. The game runs entirely in a web browser and requires no account registration or software download to play.

games.name: KatchFoundry
games.summary: KatchFoundry is a voxel game focused on survival and building. There are two main modes of play, where in one you have infinite resources and can't die. The other mode you have limited resources and health, and you must carefully gather resources while avoiding any harm or monsters.

games.name: Melody Friends
games.summary: Just drop in your favorite song—done! A cute rhythm game that auto-generates multiple difficulties. Play comfortably with any key and clear a song your way with five friends.

games.name: Microsoft Bubble
games.summary: Aim the Bubble launcher to match 3 or more of the same bubble color. Release the launcher and send your bubble to pop the matching bunch off the board!

games.name: Monster Travels
games.summary: A 2D top-down RPG with turn-based combat, going from defeating small slimes to dragons, and much more. Travel many different maps and fight several foes, and level up to unlock new abilities.

games.name: Moonlight In Garland
games.summary: A chill open-ended life sim about finding your feet, making a positive impact and enjoying the journey in the big city. Find an apartment, make friends, grow plants and love your city life!

games.name: No Vacation for an Executioner
