games.summary: It's a a Dark Fantasy Action-RPG about a frustrated executioner in late 17th century. He ran away from the gallows. It aroused a riot of monsters, he had to clean up this cruel mess, and find out the truth of this crazy world.

games.name: Pakinpaks
games.summary: A cozy puzzle game where you go on a journey all around the world packing and organizing all sorts of travel gear. Fulfill your client's request in any way you wish and — as long as everything fits — prepare the neatest bags that you can!

games.name: Project: Aftershock
games.summary: Project: AFTERSHOCK is a fast-paced arcade hacking roguelite set in a dystopian future. Command a 20-year-old legacy terminal to breach enemy systems, siphon funds, and upgrade your hardware. Use your reflexes to survive the countdown and bring down the very system you created.

games.name: Putt in Parks
games.summary: Step onto the lush greens & unwind in the relaxing world of Putt in Parks, the only relaxing minigolf experience set in stunning, stylized landscapes. Leave your worries behind as you explore whimsical courses and the world around them, designed to be about the journey & the scorecard.

games.name: PuzzleSnap
games.summary: PuzzleSnap is a casual tile-swapping jigsaw puzzle game designed for mobile devices. Players unlock and collect beautifully detailed, high-resolution landmark and landscape photography from around the world. The game features multiple difficulty tiers for each image, ranging from accessible 5x5 grids up to challenging 9x9 layouts. Players can test their skills, manage their puzzle collection, and engage in curated Daily Challenges to earn rewards and progress through global milestones.

games.name: Save Next Christmas
games.summary: Someone hates Christmas! They kidnapped Santa Claus! Help Santa escape, collect the key and run through the levels.

games.name: Skipper 2
games.summary: Skipper2 is a chill, challenging, and unique puzzle game with 25+ levels to bend your mind and challenge your problem solving ability, with 1.5 - 4 hours of play.

games.name: Stickman Physics Battle Arena
games.summary: Level up and unlock the ultimate weapons in a bloody physics playground! You must kill countless enemies to increase your stats and become the greatest warrior. Dual wield over 75 unique and fun weapons in 7 different modes across nearly 100 different levels with up to 2 players in co-op or VS.

games.name: Subconsciousism
games.summary:
A troubled person has lost access to the center of themself and to linear time. Now they drift through a fractured state where dreams, memories, and reality bleed together into a chaotic, surreal experience.

Subconsciousism is a story-first exploratory game inspired by LSD: Dream Emulator.

games.name: Tiny Archer
games.summary: Embark on an epic adventure in Tiny Archer, a breathtaking 2D platformer set in a dangerous, slime-infested dungeon! As a nimble archer, fight through 20 treacherous levels filled with cunning slimes, each requiring clever tactics to defeat. Master wall-jumping to navigate deadly traps, collect crystals, and grab powerful quivers that unleash triple-shot barrages of devastating power. With precise controls and diverse enemies, Tiny Archer offers thrilling combat and exploration.

games.name: To Be a Millionaire
games.summary: Ordinary people can also become millionaires. In the game, you can get money by transporting apples. Once you have accumulated a certain amount of money, you can own your own barbecue restaurant. From then on, becoming a millionaire is no longer a dream.

games.name: Toast Clicker
games.summary: Toast is a simple clicker game where you click on a slice of toast to earn points. Every 30 minutes a new random toast variant unlocks. Collect all 38 unique toast designs.

games.name: Tower of Baby
games.summary: Stack babies high into the sky to get your paychecks! Avoid going more than $10 into debt and make sure the babies don't hit the edges!

games.name: Violet Impetus
games.summary: Violet Impetus is a bullet-hell arcade melee 'em up set in a series of (lightly) procedurally-generated arenas. Drop into different biomes to rid the world of Æris—the demiurge, petrificate & fractured. Its other children just won't see things eye to eye.

games.name: Wandering Okali
games.summary: Discover magical creatures while exploring a fantasy world in this whimsical, art-filled visual novel!

games.name: What Is The Ghost
games.summary: Ghosts haunt the living, and only your company can identify them. Search haunted apartments, collect suspicious artifacts, and reveal cursed objects. But beware: the longer you stay, the stronger the ghost’s presence grows - and the deadlier your investigation becomes.

games.name: 6 Floors
games.summary: You find yourself in a strange place and the only way out is within. Navigate liminal corridors and rooms filled with psychological terrors as you traverse all six floors of this mysterious place in order to save your soul.

games.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex
games.summary:
The Librarian Ariana’s mission is to repair the Seven Hero Codices, which have been altered. Due to the terrible damages, magic has vanished from the world.

By utilizing special Librarian magic that allows her to enter Codices, Ariana seeks to mend the books to bring back magic. Can Ariana safely repair each tome and unravel the mysteries hidden within the Library?

games.name: Back Alley Chronicle: Episode Saeki
games.summary: A prequel to Rojiura Hyōryūki. Set in the home of middle schooler Sumire Saeki, this is a life simulation game where players repeat daily routines and explore dreams. Choices made at different times of day influence the story and its endings.

games.name: Bag of Dreams
games.summary: Bag of dreams is the cozy card-based Roguelike Dreambuilder you didn't know you needed. Can you piece together the perfect sleep, one fragment at a time?

games.name: Bloxer
games.summary: BLOXER mixes the classic match-4 formula with a physical fitness twist. Combine at least 4 blocks of the same colour either horizontally or vertically. The player who can manage their board better is sure to become the winner. You don’t simply move blocks with the controller, however—you have to physically punch your robot ‘’friend’’ to make them align! Uppercut, jab or punch depending on the current situation on the board.

games.name: Brighter Days
games.summary: Fight difficult enemies, explore dangerous locations, and gain strength in this hand crafted world to defeat the evil that lays waste to these Scarred Lands.

games.name: Cabal 13
games.summary: Welcome to Cabal 13 — an asynchronous roguelike auto-battler built around hero RPG progression! Every run is a fresh adventure, every choice shapes victory or defeat. Assemble your unique squad, clash with rivals on dynamic battlefields, and dive into deep, hero-focused roguelike auto-battler fun.

games.name: Cigkofte Empire
games.summary: A chaotic 1-4 player tycoon centered on Turkey's iconic Çiğ Köfte! Step behind the counter, serve hungry customers, and upgrade your equipment. Diversify your menu to build the neighborhood's most prestigious restaurant. Be fast, stay organized, and don't let anyone leave hungry!

games.name: Deviled Dice
games.summary: Beat the devil at his own board game by cheating harder than he does.

games.name: Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy
games.summary:
A new Dissidia story unfolds in modern Tokyo, where legendary Final Fantasy warriors assemble to save the world from destruction.
Defeat the boss faster than the enemy team in exhilarating, action-packed battles in this 3v3 Team Boss Battle Arena.

games.name: Don't Die Roguelike
games.summary:
Don’t Die Roguelike is a casual yet strategic roguelike played with Dice. Defeat monsters, upgrade your dice, and build game-breaking combos that defy the odds. But most importantly, Don’t Die.

Free to play, win in-game rewards in Tournament Mode!

games.name: Ezerath 3D
games.summary: The 3d remaster of Ezerath's Last Hope, featuring improved dungeons, more stats to upgrade your character with, and refined in-game systems!

games.name: Fallfate: Impulsive Plinko
games.summary: Fallfate is short, action-packed roguelike plinko. Parry enemies and bosses. Defy house's edge with spins. Chase losses with resolve and upgrades, until you master the true nature of fate.

games.name: Flow
games.summary: You are one of the last survivors of the apocalypse. Explore the dark forest, build shelters, craft weapons, and fight zombies and mutants in this realistic first-person survival simulator.

games.name: Food Drive
games.summary: Food Drive is a Food Bank awareness charity game to help solve hunger. By collecting food and making timely deliveries you can work your way through 3 levels of driving, delivery, and fun.

games.name: Genji Reincarnation: The Seven Mysteries of Shirahata High
games.summary: Friendship or fate—what will they choose? A karmic and occult visual novel where urban legends blur the line between life, death, and reincarnation.

games.name: Gun Predict
games.summary: Gun Predict is a top-down strategy shooter where you must carefully choose the type of bullets to use in order to complete the levels. Create a strategy to eliminate all enemies and overcome obstacles using special projectiles.

games.name: Hidden Rabbit
games.summary: Explore the captivating hand-drawn artwork in unique settings, and in a theme park filled with rabbits, attempt to locate all 55 adorable rabbits hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

games.name: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands
games.summary: Solve tactile three-dimensional burr puzzles on cozy Puzzle Islands. Twist, pull and dismantle handcrafted puzzles in immersive VR or with mouse & keyboard… alongside one curious little bird friend.

games.name: Isekai Mage
games.summary: Protagonist dies in a truck accident, reborn as a Mage Adventurer in an isekai. Explore chests, battle monsters, complete quests, and customize skills via roguelike mechanics. Defeat the Demon King in this blend of RPG, adventure, and light roguelike.

games.name: Jesus Take The Wheel
games.summary: Online co-op chaos fest, where one player steers the car with limited visibility, while the other player accelerates and brakes. And that’s it. Coordinate perfectly or crash spectacularly. Friendship survival is optional.

games.name: Korean Student Simulator
games.summary:
Become a "K-high school senior," strategize, and take on the challenge of college entrance exams!

But beware-if you fail to get into any university, you'll be forced into a cram school.

Every decision you make will shape your destiny.

A 220-page story awaits you, filled with diverse scenarios that unfold based on your choices!

Did you get into your dream university? Edit your photo into your acceptance letter and share it with your friends!

In the game, the number of accepted students by major is counted in real time.

If you're already a university student, aim to enter as the top scorer in your major and brag about it.

That moment, you'll become the ultimate campus star and receive countless confessions from your peers.

games.name: Mall Rivals
games.summary: Competitive mall simulation. 1-8 players open stores in the same mall, fight for customers, crush rivals. Team up or go solo. Fair play or dirty tricks? Your call. Procedural maps, employee system, physical mechanics.

games.name: Mystologia: The Witch & the Noisy Forest
games.summary: Survive waves of relentless bullets and defeat your enemies. Can you resolve this incident in peace and find the colleague you’ve been searching for?

games.name: Ninja Arena
games.summary: Ninja Arena is an online first-person shooter focused on speed, mobility, and mastery of ninjutsu techniques. Players face off in dynamic arenas where movement precision and quick reflexes determine the outcome of every duel.

games.name: NintenDoku
games.summary:
NintenDoku is a free daily browser puzzle about Nintendo history. The grid gives you three rows and three columns, each labelled with a category such as a franchise, a genre, a console, a release decade or a critic score range. Every cell has to be filled with a Nintendo game that matches both of its labels, and each game can only be used once.

You get nine guesses for nine cells, so a wrong answer costs you a square. A hardcore mode adds a 4x4 grid with tighter categories, and unlimited modes in easy and hard let you keep playing after the daily puzzle is done. A shared result grid lets you compare your run with other players.

Answers are checked against a hand-curated database of more than 1,300 Nintendo and Nintendo-exclusive titles, with attributes including release date, region, developer, genre, critic and user scores, average playtime and sales figures. Data comes from public sources such as Metacritic, HowLongToBeat and publisher reports. A new puzzle goes live every day at 6:00 CET.

NintenDoku is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Nintendo.

games.name: Nothing Beyond This Point
games.summary: In the Void, everyone is alone, and you're no exception. Use your health as damage, create your own character with abilities and Sigils, and fight through corrupted souls in this top-down action Metroidvania. Don't be fooled - you're nobody's last hope.

games.name: Oops! Inc. Emergency Center
games.summary: Run the galaxy’s most chaotic hospital in Oops! Inc. Emergency Center! Play as a diploma-free robot doctor, diagnose bizarre space illnesses, craft the right remedies, and treat patients fast before insurance turns you into a fridge. Funny, frantic, and out of this world!

games.name: Overpowered 2: Crux of Fate
games.summary: Press your luck to its absolute limits as you fight for survival in a deadly monster arena!

games.name: Rank: Warmaster Bunker Buster
games.summary: Rank Warmaster: Bunker Buster meets tactical control with strategic execution, bringing RTS elements to this sci-fi, action tower defense. Acquire resources as you further secure your bunker strategically placing perimeters and defensive and offensive units.

games.name: RoadCraft: Reclaim Expansion
games.summary: Reclaim Expansion introduces two new large-scale maps, a new class of demolition gameplay, and a deeper sandbox approach to recovery operations. Reclaim Expansion emphasizes player autonomy: there are no fixed paths or prescribed solutions—only the tools, the terrain, and the consequences of your decisions.

games.name: Saylor Assassin Puzzle
games.summary: Puzzle game which contains 6 images to solve from different themes

games.name: SchoolBoy Horror
games.summary: Welcome back to class.

games.name: Serene Estates: Last Guy
games.summary: A third-person adventure game set in a sprawling dystopian housing facility. Explore its atmospheric corridors, uncover a mysterious story, and enjoy visuals that harken back to the iconic 2000s era.

games.name: Sinebomb
games.summary: Cosine? Tangent? Who needs that? Prepare your sine bombs and blast away!

games.name: Sweetie Candy Maze: Lime
games.summary: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful lime mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

games.name: Tenvader
games.summary: Tetris meets Space Invaders – Build your ship block by block while blasting alien swarms. Upgrade weapons, face evolving bosses, and survive the chaos across endless loops.

games.name: VampireBlaze
games.summary: This is a classic platformer.Fight through over 10 stages—or take an alternate route—as you make your way to the demon lord.It offers a challenging, retro-style action experience focused on precise controls and skill-based gameplay.

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Miami
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Miami in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

games.name: Absolum
games.summary: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

games.name: Ausencia de Color
games.summary: A short game about how excitement is seen with colors inside a videogame.

games.name: Blastroid
games.summary: Blastroid is an arcade-style roguelite set in space. Players customize their ships by combining different engine and weapon systems, striving to survive against ever-evolving threats in regions swarming with enemy waves.

games.name: Brain Riddle
games.summary:
Brain Riddle: Tricky Box is a mobile puzzle game developed by BrainPunk Studio, available on Google Play and App Store. The game launched on Android on March 25 and is scheduled for release on iOS at a later date. Built with Unity 6, the game offers a creative, hand-drawn puzzle experience centered around unconventional problem-solving and conceptual gameplay.

Brain Riddle: Tricky Box is a logic-based mobile puzzle game that blends platforming elements with concept-driven challenges. Players control a character within a stylized, hand-drawn environment and solve puzzles by interacting with objects, interpreting hints, and discovering non-obvious solutions.
Unlike traditional puzzle games that rely on fixed mechanics or repetitive patterns, Brainy Boxy emphasizes interpretation, experimentation, and lateral thinking.

Brain Riddle: Tricky Box is a creative and cozy mobile puzzle game that combines interaction-based gameplay with conceptual and unconventional puzzle design. By encouraging players to interpret, experiment, and rethink how the game world works, it delivers a distinctive brain teaser experience centered on insight and discovery.

games.name: Chompers Playhouse: Chapter 1
games.summary: Welcome to Chompers Playhouse, a mascot horror game inspired by Poppy Playtime. Here, you will dive within Playhouse Co. and uncover the truth.

games.name: Come Again, Chachii?
games.summary: Unscramble letters in this word-puzzle game about unemployed extra-terrestrials. Manipulate the environment and decipher clues to make them make sense and land the job.

games.name: Console Archives: Terra Cresta
games.summary:
Total control over your split-mode and firing directions! Features a custom Formation Design system!

"Terra Cresta" was released by Nichibutsu in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
It is a shooting game in which humanity, driven to the bottom of the sea by the evil Mandora, fights to reclaim the Earth.

games.name: DVD Survivors
games.summary: YOU are the DVD Survivor! Bounce off walls, collect bytes, stack weapons, evolve your build, close waves of pop-ups, destroy error windows, eliminate bosses (Slippy!), and destroy all the other digital threats! Short runs and ALL THE WEAPONS! This is the final CORNER SLAM!

games.name: Damon and Baby
games.summary: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

games.name: Dating Killmulator 2
games.summary:
Dating Killmulator 2 is the sequel to Dating Killmulator 1.
Step into the shoes of a female protagonist in an even crazier sequel that starts right where the last one ended: in the middle of chaos. Enjoy the new plot twists, romance scenes, and already outdated memes we’ve prepared just for you. We’re so happy to see you again!

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley
games.summary: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney as you discover rich stories and build the perfect neighbourhood alongside Disney and Pixar Heroes and Villains in this new life-sim adventure game. Welcome to Disney Dreamlight Valley.

games.name: Easy Delivery Co.
games.summary: Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game with strange secrets. Chill out, make deliveries and get to know the mysterious residents of this scenic mountain town, all while earning well below minimum wage.

games.name: Echoes Runner
games.summary: Echoes Runner is a 2D Platformer where you place memories of your past self called Echoes. They act as a platform that you can stand on to reach higher levels and cross bigger gaps. Try to beat the levels as fast as possible and find the hidden items to customize your Runner!

games.name: Ghost at Dawn
games.summary: Explore an abandoned hotel and search for clues while trying not to succumb to your fears in this ode to 90’s survival horror games. You will solve puzzles, face off against supernatural entities, and use limited resources to maintain your sanity so you can explore deeper in The Pines Hotel and find out what really happened to Emi Kosuke.

games.name: Going Viral
games.summary: An infection has struck the body! As the mighty T-Cell, it's your duty to eradicate the invading pathogens! Consume pathogens to earn mito energy, and use it to purchase upgrades and summon allies in your battle to protect the body. If all your body cells die, it's game over for you.

games.name: Immortal Faces
games.summary: Challenge your memory, test your nerves, and immerse yourself in a world where to forget is to die. Are you ready to look into the faces of the immortals and remember them forever?

games.name: Legendary Spell
games.summary: Build your deck and unleash the most powerful spells.

games.name: Mado Monogatari: Fia and the Wondrous Academy
games.summary:
An ancient school of sorcery. Where students study true magic and cultivate their ambitions.

Fia, a girl who aims to be a great sorcerer, leaves her hometown and enrolls in an ancient school of sorcery once attended by her grandmother in order to study sorcery.

Surrounded by strict but humorous instructors, and chaotic but amusing classmates, Fia will study sorcery and develop her abilities.

games.name: Medieval Quest
games.summary:
Medieval Quest is a Match-3 Puzzle game infused with RPG mechanics in a fantasy setting. Combine swords, arrows, staffs, and more to defeat enemies and achieve challenging quests.

Unlock the Archer, the Cleric and the Wizard characters to face and defeat the final Dragon.

games.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Myth & Machine
games.summary: Join cute cats in a time-travel adventure! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a magical medieval kingdom and a chaotic sci-fi metropolis.

games.name: Omvros
games.summary: Experience the deep fusion of rhythm and visuals in this innovative fixed-track rhythm game. Through meticulously designed charts and performance effects, every track presents a unique sensory world for you to explore.

games.name: Paranoize
games.summary:
Eleven years after a mysterious, colossal object fell into the mountains of Japan, destiny stirs once more. In a secluded dojo, a blind youth trains with his wooden sword, driven by a voice only he can hear.

An all-star cast brings the story to life in a fully voiced animated series.

Step into the forefront of the comics and manga experience—

games.name: Purr Bricks
games.summary: Smash through over 100 brick-packed levels in this fast-paced arcade brick breaker! Collect wild powerups, dodge chaotic curses, and build up FURY to unleash devastating board-clearing strikes. Easy to play, hard to master, and packed with mayhem.

games.name: Red Oath: The Forsaken One
games.summary: RED OATH: The Forsaken One is a ruthless third-person action game that invites you to a dark fantasy world filled with challenging and punishing combat. In a realm where every attack has a cost, manage your stamina, defeat enemies, face epic bosses, and discover the secrets of a cursed kingdom.

games.name: Roombattle
games.summary:
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.

Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!

games.name: Shinonome Abyss: The Maiden Exorcist
games.summary: The main character is a shrine maiden named "Yono," who has to survive in a haunted houses where Mononoke (yokai and vengeful spirits) lurk, using a limited number of items and traps in this strategy roguelike horror action game!

games.name: Super Jump Ninja
games.summary: Dash, leap, and slice through hand-crafted levels as a nimble ninja on a mission to grab every shuriken — and earn your sushi. Tight 2D precision platformer that make every jump count.

games.name: Tales of the Shire
games.summary: Welcome home, Hobbit! Live the cosy life of a Hobbit in the wonderfully serene landscape of the Shire. Discover, decorate, & share in this idyllic corner of Middle-earth. Join friendly Hobbits & familiar faces awaiting your arrival in Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings Game.

games.name: Techno: 2Kill
games.summary: A hardcore, fast-paced and unpredictable roguelike shooter set in a dystopian future where AI decided to save humanity... by exterminating it. Your body is the ultimate weapon. Liberate Earth and countless other planets from the grip of a deranged AI.

games.name: Telerotation
games.summary: Rotate, Teleport, Jump, and float across over 200 hand-crafted puzzles designed to push your mind to its limits. Secrets, unlockables, optional bonus challenges, and a light sprinkling of humor await. This puzzle game is simple to pick up but genuinely tricky to master.

games.name: The V Anomaly
games.summary: The V Anomaly is an atmospheric observation game where small changes matter. Search each room for anomalies and choose the correct exit: progress deeper as the Area number climbs or make one wrong call and return to Area 0. Stay sharp. Doubt everything.

games.name: Trick-or-Treat Adventure!
games.summary: A nostalgic Halloween retro point-&-click adventure game. You must help Little Johnny put a Halloween costume together, go trick-or-treating for all the candies, and defeat the forces of evil!

games.name: Wardens of Wen
games.summary: Wave-based top-down survival in a dark medieval realm. Pick a Warden, build your kit between waves, chase risk-reward hot-zones, and survive escalating enemy mutations and milestone bosses. How long can you survive?

games.name: Warframe
games.summary: Warframe situates players as members of the Tenno race, newly awoken after years of cryo-sleep into a solar system at war. Reborn into a corrupt era, the Tenno are sought by the oppressive Grineer Empire for annihilation. Warframe armor is the key to overthrowing the Grineer by providing players with unique offensive and defensive powers to explore, upgrade and master during purpose-driven radical raids.

games.name: Wraith of the Cards
games.summary:
Wraith of the Cards is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG with platforming exploration! Explore the vast halls of a mysterious mansion that has called you forth, and attack your way through enemies using special card magic!

Explore the halls of the mansion in EXPLORE MODE, solving puzzles and clearing obstacles in your way. Search furnature to find Gears and other machanical tools to assist on your journey, but they aren't the only things hiding in the mansion...

Fight your way forward in BATTLE MODE, using a card-based battle system where magical cards are collected and harnessed for combat! Total higher numbers together to pack higher punches, and level up to unlock over 20 unique Special Cards!

games.name: 8 Ball Pro Online
games.summary: 3D 8-ball pool game; featuring spin control, jump shots, and various game modes. Aim your shots, adjust the ball's position, and clear the table. Play against the computer, challenge a friend locally, or compete in online PvP.

games.name: Aarik: and the Ruined Kingdom
games.summary: Aarik (and the ruined kingdom) is a perspective based puzzle game centred around a Prince trying desperately to repair his father's kingdom. Using a magical crown Aarik must grab, roll, move and mend to save his homeland and his family.

games.name: After School .Live: Mirror of Twilight
games.summary: A visual novel starring the Vtubers from .LIVE production with a a mix of horror and school comedy.

games.name: Antique Dealer Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy antique shop where every item has a story. Buy and sell furniture and collectibles, manage customer needs and smart pricing, expand and upgrade your store, and grow your reputation from a small-town trader to a respected antique dealer.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Final Lap
games.summary:
"Final Lap" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
1987 marked the dawn of the F1 boom in Japan. Set against the backdrop of that era, this title portrays the raw power of racing machines and the stoic world of professional competition.
Experience nail-biting, high-speed battles set on the legendary circuit as it was back then. Push yourself to the absolute limit where every tenth of a second counts—and give it everything you've got!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Final Lap
games.summary:
"Final Lap" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
1987 marked the dawn of the F1 boom in Japan. Set against the backdrop of that era, this title portrays the raw power of racing machines and the stoic world of professional competition.
Experience nail-biting, high-speed battles set on the legendary circuit as it was back then. Push yourself to the absolute limit where every tenth of a second counts—and give it everything you've got!

games.name: Astronaut Simulator
games.summary: Drifting in the silence of space, you awaken aboard a damaged orbital station. Systems are failing, oxygen is running low, and every sound echoes through cold metal corridors. This isn’t a story about conquering space—it’s about surviving it.

games.name: Avo Echoes of the Void
games.summary:
AVO: Echoes of the Void is a story-driven VR puzzle adventure built from the ground up for immersive, hands-on virtual reality.

Your journey begins aboard a failing spacecraft. Moments later, a catastrophic event tears the ship apart, leaving you drifting in the void with no clear answers and no way home.

Awakening inside the wreckage, you must adapt to zero-gravity movement, interact with damaged systems, and explore a mysterious network of interconnected environments. Each space you enter introduces new mechanics, tools, and challenges that build upon one another, encouraging experimentation and mastery rather than one-off solutions.

games.name: Back to the Garden
games.summary: Back to the Garden is a fun and chaotic 4-player local party game where you play as vegetables and compete or work together! Race in different modes or help steal all the burgers — The perfect couch-party showdown for friends, families and vegetable haters.

games.name: BasketBlow
games.summary: Play tabletop basketball with realistic physics in relaxing environments. Compete in customizable leagues and cups, edit your teams, and complete your trophy room. Collect points to unlock courts, balls, and environments. Play with friends locally or online.

games.name: BioMech Vendetta
games.summary: A forgotten world awakens — where nature and machine have become one. Step into the boots of an elite soldier sent to reclaim a planet consumed by biomechanical life.

games.name: Bravion
games.summary: Bravion is a colorful 3D platform adventure where players step into the role of a young hero determined to save his kingdom from a growing monster invasion.

games.name: Call of Dookie
games.summary: Imagine you went to the crapper, and emerged an hour later to a monster apocalypse! Retro first-person shooter action inspired by 90's classics! Old-school local deathmatch & co-op for up to 4 players!

games.name: Card Crawl 2
games.summary:
Card Crawl 2 is a solitaire dungeon crawler card game.

Grab your deck and dive into exciting new game modes, battling your favorite tavern dwellers. Defeat tricky monsters, collect gold, and unlock powerful spell cards, new equipment, and a cast of new and familiar hero cards.

Card Crawl 2 is the official sequel to the beloved original. Once again, you’ll face Hoerni and his friends in clever solitaire-style card battles.

This time, a brand-new core mechanic is introduced. Instead of just 4 dungeon cards, you now play with up to 16 cards stacked across 4 columns. Sort, equip, and sell cards to outwit every monster in the deck. Harness plenty of new spell cards and, for the first time, add equipment items to your runs, which add a whole new layer of strategy.

Grow your collection and take on a variety of offline and online game modes that will test your skills with each of the newly added hero types.

games.name: Cards Lie
games.summary: Unmask the demons. Trust no one. You’ve gathered the entire village for a midnight ritual. Among them hide creatures of pure evil — demons disguised as villagers.

games.name: Cat at Home
games.summary: This is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle game with a cat as the main character. The game takes place in a villa, where you play as a cat that has just entered the house. You meet animals with different personalities, solve one problem after another, and finally resolve the crisis at home.

games.name: Chico's Rebound
games.summary: A mysterious tower full of challenges has appeared. Launch Chico's walnut up at the blocks to break them all! Dash, dive, and tail-whip, while deploying an arsenal of creative power-ups. In between stages explore the Celestial Tower to solve puzzles, earn rewards, and uncover its secrets!

games.name: ChildStory
games.summary: As a child, we all wondered: "Where does the Moon disappear every month?". This ChildStory will tell about Sonya, a girl in a purple Kigurumi, and the angry Heavenly shepherdess Nora. The two of them create the cycle of the appearance and the loss of the Moon.

games.name: Close for the Night
games.summary: Close For The Night is a first-person horror game about a blogger who explores mysterious locations sent by his subscribers. Each place tells its own standalone story filled with dark secrets, paranormal activity, and unexpected events waiting in the shadows.

games.name: Clover Reset
games.summary: "Hey, do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?" Set at "Shonan Saika Academy," a prestigious school in Shonan, Kanagawa Prefecture, this is a youthful story of girls wavering between friendship and love.

games.name: Codex Mortis
games.summary: In Codex Mortis, Death is your weapon. Mix five schools of dark magic, unleash devastating spell synergies, and raise undead armies in this necromantic bullet hell. Infinite builds, solo or co-op – embrace the forbidden and dominate. 100% AI-driven development.

games.name: Cola Riders
games.summary: Ride the Cola & Mint Rocket for the craziest experience of your life!

games.name: Commie Block
games.summary: Survive as the newly appointed manager in an expanding communistic regime where our purpose is to produce more and more resources for the glory of motherland! Manage the workforce & optimize output of buildings to survive against unrealistic demands as long as possible in our own commie block

games.name: Cookie Run: OvenSmash
games.summary:
️The Cookies have gathered in Platter City for the fight of their lives
Three factions... three goals... What could they be fighting for?

Get ready for the urban fantasy Cookie battle of your dreams!
Tune into the fight narrated by your new idol, DJ Miya!
It's time to fight, win, and make your dreams come true!

games.name: Counter Attack
games.summary: Experience the ultimate in next-generation detail, bringing the breathtaking power of modern warfare directly to your screen.

games.name: Curse Warrior
games.summary:
Curse Warrior is a dungeon crawler RPG where you explore and conquer the underground labyrinth “Eclipse,” filled with curses.

In the dungeon, your party members may become cursed through various actions.

Since curses alter the abilities and actions of your party members, players must constantly monitor the state of their party and make crucial decisions on how to proceed. Build stronger characters while managing and adjusting the effects of curses to successfully clear the dungeon.

games.name: Cuties Monster Girl
games.summary: This is a match-over game where the main goal of the game is to get gems. Remove all obstacles so that the gem touches the dotted line. Hurry up and finish!

games.name: DVG Survivors
games.summary: DVG Survivors is a casual idle-roguelike-survival game where you watch your DVG logo bounce across the screen and destroy your enemies with various abilities. Who are your enemies? Well none other than other mixed media from across the ages.

games.name: Darkwater
games.summary: A cooperative survival horror game where you take command of a submarine trapped under the ice of an alien planet.

games.name: Devil Jam
games.summary: Rampage through hell’s metal artists and their countless followers! Immerse yourself in a hand-animated, survivor-like experience that blends beat-driven combat with a unique 12-slot inventory system, allowing for near-infinite demonic builds.

games.name: Devils on the Moon Pinball
games.summary: Themed on the astrologically Occult, Devils on the Moon is a Single board VG-Pinball Heavily inspired by all the great Pinball games of the past and some modern ones as well.

games.name: Diabolik Lovers Lunatic Fate: Grand Edition
games.summary: Contains Diabolik Lovers Dark Fate and Diabolik Lovers Lunatic Parade.

games.name: Distorted: The Living Manor
games.summary: A slow-burn horror game about noticing what shouldn’t exist.

games.name: Eggconsole Take the A-Train PC-8801
games.summary: As the newly appointed president of a railway company, you have one year to lay the tracks and guide the Presidential Train safely to its goal.

games.name: English Basics English Vocabulary Fill-in Quiz
games.summary: Fill the blanks, learn your first English words.

games.name: Escape from Wormwood
games.summary: Escape from Wormwood is a horror visual novel where you get cut up and eaten by mouse cultists.

games.name: Escape game R00m11
games.summary: Explore 3D space and escape

games.name: Etrange Overlord
games.summary: Join Étrange on this musical odyssey as she seeks to conquer hell in the pursuit of living her best afterlife.

games.name: EverSiege: Untold Ages
games.summary: Liberate Bastion, humanity’s last refuge. Defend against evil hordes, reclaim lost powers, rebuild ancient ruins, and adapt your tactics to break the everSiege. A top-down action-strategy rogue-lite where choices shape every run, playable solo or up to 3 players in co-op.

games.name: Fairy Circle
games.summary: Fairy Circle is a Bag Building roguelike set in a fairytale world. Play as a Forest Keeper and protect your home from a shadowy force called the Gloom

games.name: Farm Manager World
games.summary: Dive into the agricultural life with Farm Manager World! Manage your own farm across vibrant global locations, cultivate exotic crops, and build your agribusiness empire. Welcome to sustainable farming at its finest.

games.name: Fight Girls
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring cool and cute battle girls is here!

games.name: Final Payload
games.summary: Final Payload is a fast-paced 2D action game where you control a guided warhead. Manage inertia and fuel, destroy enemies, avoid guarded zones, and land precisely to complete missions.

games.name: Find the Funny Mistake!
games.summary: What’s wrong with this photo? A new kind of spot-the-mistake challenge!

games.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof 2
games.summary: Boarding house owner Yuman is back! Alongside Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung, a wealthy heiress, a girl burdened by childhood scars, and a sweet nurse move in. In this house of old memories and new emotions, who will you fall in love with?

games.name: Formula 2026: Rise of Legends
games.summary:
Jump into high-speed racing action
Master every corner
Rise to become a legend

games.name: Fowl Damage
games.summary: Fowl Damage is an atmospheric puzzle platformer where your default jump provides enough fall damage to destroy you! Carefully manage your jumps and falls as you adventure through this chilling, beautiful, and occasionally cute world.

games.name: Frenzy Force
games.summary: Choose your champion and fight until your last breath! Frenzy Force is a casual wave-survival game with a diverse set of weapons and unlockable characters, where you must fight through a variety of biomes against hordes of shadowy minions.

games.name: GVD
games.summary: A bouncing DVD logo screensave game, it's an auto battler roguelike

games.name: Geo Brain Boost! Japan’s 47 Prefectures Silhouette Quiz
games.summary: See Japan at a glance—47 Prefecture Silhouette Quiz!

games.name: Goat Out Of Hell: Lost Pets
games.summary: Push the Souls, Save the Little Pets

games.name: GoodNightGirls
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring cute girls in pajamas is here!

games.name: GridBeat!
games.summary: Dungeons! Danger! Rhythm Action! You just hacked into the biggest corporation in the world and stole an unfeasibly valuable amount of data, but getting in was the easy part. To get back out you’ll need to explore the Mainframe, solve puzzles, battle security programs… and do it all on the beat!

games.name: Grimoire Groves
games.summary: Restore the magical forest as you grow cute plant creatures with your witch magic in this cozy rogue-lite dungeon crawler. Unlock all spells, discover new plant types, befriend magical creatures, and unravel the mystery of the rainbow socks.

games.name: Gun.Dog.Revenge
games.summary: GUN·DOG·REVENGE is a high-speed arcade platform shooter, drawing inspiration from NES classics "Rolling Thunder" and "Code Name: Viper", the indie hit "RollingBird" on Steam, and the film "John Wick". Reload! Shoot! Kill the boss! Revenge for your dog.

games.name: HellBorn
games.summary: Enter a realm of terror in this 4-player co-op horror. Explore a 50-room manor and sinister dungeon haunted by a demon baby. Experience physics-driven chaos and eerie rituals as secrets unfold in every shadow.

games.name: Hello Neighbor
games.summary: Hello Neighbor is a stealth horror game about sneaking into your creepy neighbor's house to figure out what horrible secrets he's hiding in his basement. You play against an AI that adapts from your actions. Really enjoying climbing through that backyard window? Expect a bear trap there. Sneaking through the front door? There'll be cameras there soon. Trying to escape? Your neighbor will find a shortcut and catch you.

games.name: Hole Digging Master
games.summary:
The rules are as simple as possible - dig the hole. Dig deep. Deeper than you can even imagine.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty, because there's real treasure waiting for you in the ground. Start digging and miracles will happen. You have no idea what could be under your lawn.

Everything you find can be sold and used to upgrade your tools or buy new equipment to help you dig faster and find more.

Can you reach the true depths?

games.name: Homicipher
games.summary: Homicipher is an adventure horror game where you’ll decipher a language, fall in love and escape. Players will face various horrifying men in this strange world. Your aim is to decipher their language and eventually find a way to escape. Meanwhile, a peculiar feeling also starts to bloom.

games.name: Horse Magnifier
games.summary: A game where you magnify horses with lenses until they match the other horse.

games.name: Icarus: Console Edition
games.summary: Land on Icarus, a planet broken due to failed terraforming. Once meant to be humanity’s second home, it is now a hostile frontier of toxic skies, savage wildlife, and relentless storms. Every drop from orbit is a fight for survival. Build shelter, craft weapons, hunt for food, and seek your fortune in exotic matter.

games.name: Idle Gumball Machine
games.summary: Short, sweet, and addictive incremental game. Shoot gumballs at gears and watch them bounce around.

games.name: Is Zombody Home?
games.summary: Upgrade the house, customize the weapon and charge the special attacks, your cute zombie horde is about to attack.

games.name: Jiji the Bajillionaire
games.summary: A precision puzzle platformer, with no legs. Propel Wizard Jiji by setting off bombs along with loads of powerups and mechanics. Help Jiji collect enough money to pay off his debt and break his curse!

games.name: Journey to the Void
games.summary: Prepare to fend off attacks from all directions in this hybrid strategy roguelite deck builder. On your journey through varied grid-based biomes, battle unique foes and make tough moral choices to restore a corrupted land and decide the fate of your world.

games.name: Kagaribi
games.summary: "The fire remembers what you forgot." Reclaim your name in this Taisho Gothic abyss, featuring an EDM Requiem crafted from the developer's raw voice. A psychological horror where emotion meets AI. Let the author's voice pull you into the depths. What is the truth at the end?

games.name: Karigurashi Renai: Living on Borrowed Love
games.summary: Welcome back to your childhood town! The Full HD Remaster of Karigurashi Ren’ai: Living on Borrowed Love perfectly preserves ASa Project's signature blend of comedy and heartwarming charm while offering a stunning new visual experience.

games.name: Kena: Bridge of Spirits
games.summary: Kena: Bridge of Spirits: a story-driven, action adventure combining exploration with fast-paced combat. Untangle the past as Kena, a young Spirit Guide in search of the sacred Mountain Shrine. Help free the spirits trapped in a forgotten village with the help of the Rot, Kena's adorable (yet powerful) spirit companions.

games.name: Last Shift Standing
games.summary: A fast, tactical roguelite: missions explode across the city with ticking timers. Assign heroes, build wild power combos, manage injuries, and keep the city alive through the whole shift.

games.name: Life Effect Survival
games.summary: Survive in a harsh and dangerous world after an alien invasion. Gather resources, craft equipment, fight mutants and massive monsters, use weapons, vehicles and robots, explore territories, defend strongholds and fight for survival.

games.name: Life Seeker
games.summary: Life seeker is the sequel to DST, following a new pair as they search for a flower.

games.name: Life is Strange: Reunion
games.summary: Life is Strange: Reunion is the thrilling finale to the Max and Chloe saga, a chapter that brings their book to a close. This is a full circle moment for both developers and fans—one that builds on everything that has come before. And even as the game delivers a reunion long-thought impossible, it also caps off our time at Caledon University in a literal blaze of glory.

games.name: Looking Up
games.summary: Looking Up captures an emotional story between Emilia and her dad. Explore and experience her discovery of flight by solving puzzles which include butterflies, mythical creatures, and birds! Grow up with Emilia and reach the skies!

games.name: Mad Games Tycoon 2
games.summary: Start your own game development studio in 1976. Build your own offices, production facilities and server rooms. Develop the games of your dreams and produce the next next-gen console. Rise from a small garage company to a huge corporation.

games.name: Mask of Soul
games.summary: Mask of Soul is a 2D Metroidvania action-adventure where you play as Cheong-O Chasa, the underworld’s gatekeeper, hunting spirits released under the Red Moon. Master precise parry combat, switch between spirit masks, and explore a dark fantasy world inspired by Korean mythology.

games.name: Match Quest: Numbers
games.summary:
Match the numbers
Smash the high scores
Domineer the global leaderboard

games.name: Mining Wizards
games.summary: Mining Wizards is an incremental mining game. Mine minerals, gather materials, upgrade a massive skill tree, level up, unlock talents, discover artifacts, and attract artifact visitors!

games.name: My Idle Witch
games.summary: A little witch companion who brews potions anywhere on your desktop. Watch her work and sell her potions, dress her in new outfits, and decorate her tiny workshop. Stay focused by using productivity tools like checklists and Pomodoro timers.

games.name: Mystic Explorer
games.summary: Mystic Explorer is a treasure rogue game. Players will play the role of treasure hunter in search of treasure chests in the siege of monsters, defeat the ever stronger enemies, and bring back your own archive treasures.

games.name: Neopets: Mega Mini Games Collection - The Neopian Arcade Odyssey
games.summary:
Neopets: The Mega Mini Games Collection is a lovingly remastered collection of 26 fan-favourite mini-games from the golden age of Neopets! From collecting Doughnutfruits in Hasee Bounce, launching Kass in Kass Basher, or chasing Neggs in Meerca Chase, the magic of Neopets is back!

And introducing an all-new adventure: Starlight Symphony, starring Nyx in a dazzling musical quest through the stars!

games.name: New Super Lucky's Tale
games.summary:
Leap into a Playful Platforming Adventure for all ages!

Run, jump, climb incredible heights, burrow deep underground, overcome enemies, and explore amazing worlds on an epic quest to rescue the Book of Ages from the mysterious Jinx and his nefarious Kitty Litter!

Experience an incredible variety of gameplay, ranging from 3D open-world hubs to story-based adventure levels to 2D side-scrolling challenges, rewarding mini-games, mind-bending puzzles, thrilling boss battles, and a memorable cast of characters!
A true love letter to classic 3D platformers, with hundreds of collectibles to gather, tons of rewarding secrets to unlock, and an entire wardrobe of costumes for the stylish adventurer!

New Super Lucky’s Tale features all new levels, story, cinematics and character dialogue, tighter movement and player controls, a fully rotatable 3D camera, and sweet upgrades to nearly every other aspect of the game, including art and lighting, UI, sound, music, and more!

games.name: Nova Roma
games.summary: The glory of Rome is at your fingertips in this city-building game where you must appease the gods, enact laws, and develop complex supply chains to meet the needs of your citizens.

games.name: Nutmeg!
games.summary: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

games.name: Off
games.summary: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

games.name: One of Us
games.summary: One Of Us is a modern real time strategy game featuring new first person style controls, with traditional control methods also available. Temporarily removed from sale on Steam, see the discussions board if you want to play!

games.name: Otome Daoshi Fighting For Love
games.summary: Welcome to Kayu, where every citizen, both man and woman, young and old alike, enjoy martial arts. Living in that kingdom as a Daoist priestess in training, you made your way to the Tournament of Valor to root for your childhood friend.

games.name: Pawapuro Adventures
games.summary: “Pawapuro Adventures” is a Japanese tactical RPG released by Konami Digital Entertainment Company on March 26, 2026, as a social game for smartphones.

games.name: Peek a Rabbit!
games.summary: Where’s That Bunny Hiding? A Cute and Easy Brain-Training Picture Hunt Game

games.name: Pixel Game Maker Series: Denizens of Darkwind
games.summary:
You may continue onward…
You can turn back if you wish…

games.name: Praise To The Moon
games.summary: It is a Metroidvania, based on Momodora, Castlevania, and Souls-Like type games, with ARPG systems and rings that have unique advantages and abilities, and a pact system where each pact has its own statistic that can help or harm you.

games.name: Primal Planet
games.summary: Unveil a heartfelt story of family, dinosaurs, and UFOs! Craft, upgrade, and survive in a realm of primeval predators, savage tribes and... ancient aliens. Rise from a humble cave dweller to the planet’s last hope — alone or in local co-op. Welcome to the dinovania!

games.name: Primal Rage
games.summary: Primal Rage is a one-on-one fighting game featuring dinosaurs and giant apes as the fighters. The graphics are done with digitized stop-motion animation. Gameplay is similar to Mortal Kombat in that it is viewed from a side perspective, and features deadly finishing moves at the end of the match.

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Pullstation
games.summary: Pullstation is an incremental tower defence about saving your space station from the ever-growing horde of UNKNOWN origin.

games.name: Racket Pinball
games.summary: The thrill of pinball meets the energy of racket sports in a VR experience.

games.name: Reclaim ! Azhe-giiwewining
games.summary: Embark on an adventure where every word brings you closer to home! As Miskwaa, forge a path through a forest teaming with spirits, stories, and intricate puzzles inspired by Ojibwe culture and language in this all-new point and click adventure.

games.name: Regnum Idle
games.summary: Build an unstoppable Viking empire through automated battles. Harvest resources, recruit Vikings, equip them with 100+ weapons and armor, and watch them dominate! Upgrade weapons endlessly, defeat legendary bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades. Your army grows stronger, even while you're offline

games.name: Rite or Ruin
games.summary: Summon eldritch gods and outwit rival cultists in this online multiplayer game of deception. Shape the Rite, make dangerous bets, and unleash your Patron's wrath. Only one cultist leaves alive.

games.name: Rixe
games.summary: Welcome, combatants and spectators! Coop online with up to two friends, survive and defend your base from the trials of the Rixe. Pick your hero, upgrade it along the run your own way, and go as far as possible through the chaotic rounds !

games.name: Rocky Idle
games.summary: Rocky Idle is a single-player idle/incremental game. Level up your skills, gather resources, and craft powerful combat gear to defeat the strongest bosses and complete your collection log.

games.name: Rooftop Rascal: The Farmer Cat
games.summary: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Farmer Cat," you're a clever cat navigating a charming farm. Jump across platforms, collect easter eggs, and climb your way from the barnyard to the rooftop. In this special adventure, a special guest is visiting our rascal cat.

games.name: Sanrio Characters Smash Festa!
games.summary: All your favorite Sanrio characters come together in a fast-paced action sports game that mixes tennis-style rallies with hockey-like speed. Easy to pick up and play, but use stage gimmicks and character abilities to enjoy deeper, more strategic matches!

games.name: Screamer
games.summary: High-octane action and anime aesthetics collide in this arcade racing game, featuring fighting mechanics and a storyline that hits hard. In this world, some race for glory while others seek power or revenge. Every race is a fight and every battle is personal.

games.name: Shardpunk
games.summary: A mix of XCOM and Darkest Dungeon, based in a steampunk, rat-infested world.

games.name: Silk and Secrets: Rites of Pleasure
games.summary: Infiltrate the orgiastic secret society beneath the modern-day Palace of Versailles! Will you expose their sex rituals or surrender to their pleasures? An interactive romance novel.

games.name: Skully Bunnies
games.summary:
Skully Bunnies is a fast paced, competitive, party card game. To win the game, a player must be the first to fuse 3 Skully Bunnies together. Strategy fused with luck of the draw creates intense gameplay. The fun factor to this game is not only unique, but highly contagious. Skully Bunnies mobile card game creates new fast paced action mixed like never before.

Skully Bunnies pits players against each other in a strategic battle to fuse 3 Skully Bunnies in order to win. Players share one deck and have every advantage and disadvantage the game offers, it's all based on luck of the draw and how you play your cards. Players will draw from the same deck using the same types of cards throughout the game: bunnies, skulls, fusion items, spells, spell-cancel and Skully Bunnies. As players draw cards from the deck and put cards into play they will be challenged by other players using spell cards. To win the game use everything at your disposal to fuse three Skully Bunnies based on the number of players. It doesn’t matter how you do it, you just gotta be the first one! Turns go clockwise around the table, and each turn is made up of four phases.

games.name: Sky Legends: An Aeropostal Epic
games.summary: Play as the iconic pioneers of aviation and fly their legendary aircraft. Between human challenges and technical feats, cross the extreme landscapes of the Sahara, the Andes, or the Atlantic in an immersive, narrative, and historical virtual reality adventure.

games.name: SokoGhost: Unfinished Business
games.summary: Pass through obstacles in this block-pushing puzzle game! Beat all levels of the Box Corp skyscraper and reach for the stars by thinking through the box!

games.name: Stardust Escape
games.summary: Survive 15 minutes of neon space chaos in this fast-paced top-down arcade shooter with a twist of Asteroids. Blast through swarms of geometric enemies, complete quirky quests, and upgrade your ship with absurd weapons in a Jetsons-style galaxy brimming with danger, glow, and humor.

games.name: Steamy Livestreams with My Girlfriend
games.summary: You and Umi are the office couple all of your coworkers are jealous about. Now that she has to plan for her career, she opens up to you about a desire she has hidden deep within her heart. In order to fulfill her dream, you must start a steamy stream of your passion as a couple.

games.name: Suds
games.summary: Join the Suds and protect their village from invading evil slimes. Compete to defeat the most enemies and climb the world leaderboard. With engaging gameplay, stunning graphics, and cute characters, Suds is an adventure you won't want to miss!

games.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park
games.summary: More experiences are coming to the Flower Kingdom! Enjoy a variety of attractions in the Bellabel Park plaza that lets you team up with (or work against) friends and family. Collect the most coins, run and hide in Phanto Tag, work together to pass a Bob-omb to the goal and more! This Nintendo Switch 2 Edition adds even more content and enhancements as well.

games.name: Supersonic Bridge Racing
games.summary: A fast-paced racing game where the player controls the track. Fight against Friends on a global leaderboard or in the local multiplayer. Supersonic Bridge Racing is a mix between a flying and reaction race.

games.name: Sweep Bump
games.summary: Play as a cleaning robot, dodge incoming vehicles on a bustling street, and collect trash to earn higher scores.

games.name: Sweet Starlight Sisters
games.summary: “Sweet Starlight Sisters” is a character-raising romance adventure where you share a sweet life under one roof with the bunny-girl sisters Anya and Sanya. Train the duo with your own hands to become top performers, and—while occasionally fielding their heart-pounding advances—lead them to victory.

games.name: Swevens
games.summary: Your friends are all you have left, travel a monochromatic battlefield till salvation finds you. Swevens is a game about a boy named Sherriff living in an otherworldly realm nothing like our own. The monorealm is one of many small universes utilized by the Noctivians, a community of humans and creatures who follow Noctivox, the God of Nightmares.

games.name: Synthopolis
games.summary: Face off and claim the Color at all costs — the life-saving resource of humanity hidden in the mysterious city of Synthopolis. Outplay your opponent in this competitive and visually groundbreaking game.

games.name: Tavrn’s Takedown
games.summary: TaVRn's Takedown is a physics-driven VR tavern brawler where you punch enemies, smash furniture, and survive endless bar fights in a ridiculous fantasy world.

games.name: The 1% Club World Challenge
games.summary: Do you have what it takes to answer a question only 1% of people get right? Test your brainpower and compete against players worldwide!

games.name: The Boba Teashop
games.summary: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.

games.name: The Boys: Trigger Warning
games.summary: Developed with the creators and featuring cast from the hit series, “The Boys: Trigger Warning” plunges you into the gloriously twisted world of The Boys. This time, you’re not watching the chaos—you’re in it: close-up, personal, and dangerously real.

games.name: The Bus
games.summary: The Bus is the next generation of city bus driving simulation. Sell tickets and transport passengers with various buses on different lines across the German capital Berlin on a realistic scale of 1:1.

games.name: The Knights of the Cross
games.summary: The Knights of the Cross is an RPG card game adapted from The Knights of the Cross by Nobel Prize-winning author Henryk Sienkiewicz. You will play as the knight Zbyszko and embark on a medieval adventure.

games.name: The Midnight Walk
games.summary:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

games.name: The Node
games.summary: A short sci-fi point-and-click adventure about forbidden time travel. Explore a facility outside normal time, solve clever puzzles, and uncover the purpose of The Node. Featuring subtle (and not that subtle) references to classic time-travel movies and TV shows.

games.name: Tiny Mage in Puzzle Land
games.summary: Tiny Mage in Puzzle Land is a 2D pixel art puzzle game inspired by sokoban with unique twists! Help the frog mage solve 40 challenging puzzle rooms using his three magical abilities to cross gaps, build bridges on lakes and navigate objects from one point to another!

games.name: Trash Goblin
games.summary: A cosy and moreish fantasy shop sim where you uncover, clean, upcycle and sell a vast variety of trinkets - both invaluable and unlovable - to a diverse cast of fascinating customers across a colourful fantasy city. Think Potionomics meets PowerWash Simulator, with a unique protagonist!

games.name: TriggerHeart Exelica Enhanced
games.summary: "Pull the trigger of your heart once again with new friends!"

games.name: Unbounded
games.summary: A fast-paced top-down bullet hell roguelike where every input matters. Fight, dodge, upgrade, repeat. Push yourself to the limit and see how far you can go.

games.name: VMX
games.summary: VMX offers an authentic riding experience with gesture-based tricks and responsive bike handling. Take on challenges in carefully crafted skateparks and dirt tracks, customize your bike with a realistic spray-painting system, and express your style through a variety of outfits.

games.name: Vanishing Starlight
games.summary: Vanishing Starlight is a horizontal action adventure game similar to the Metroidvania. You will play the role of a prisoner who has lost his memory, wading into the sea of ​​stars, traversing rivers and mountains, embarking on a journey in search of memories, old friends and your own destiny.

games.name: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage
games.summary:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage takes the gameplay of Virtua Fighter 5 to new heights:

Rollback Netcode and Cross-play support let you take on any challenger, anywhere, across the globe in the most intense battles yet.

A brand-new single-player mode, ""World Stage"": Challenge powerful rivals on a solo quest to become the ultimate fighter

Enhanced replay functionality and improved training tools.

games.name: Volontés
games.summary: Volontés is an Dark Fantasy × Suspense otome game in which the main character, who has lost everything, finds her way of life while facing tragedy.

games.name: Way of the Hunter 2
games.summary: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the North American wilderness and the African Savanna. Hunt and display big game like Moose, and Cape Buffalo as well as, smaller animals and birds.

games.name: Winning Post 10 2026
games.summary: Winning Post is a horse racing video game developed and published by Koei, released in 1993 for PC-98, FM-Towns, Mega-CD, Super Nintendo, and X68000. It was also released for the 3DO. It is part of the Winning Post series.

games.name: Wolf Pack: Howling Spirits
games.summary: Embark on a mystical journey in Wolf Pack – Howling Spirits, where you play as a young wolf destined to awaken ancient guardians.

games.name: 07Gorillas
games.summary: 07Gorillas is a top-down roguelike arena shooter game, you control one gorilla from a squad of seven break into "Foggy Zone" on a cleanup mission. Missions lasts less than 20 minutes, fight your way with powerful kung fu and tactical consumables, don't forget internal force enhancement.

games.name: > Terminal
games.summary: Terminal is a command-line escape room. You aren't just reading a story; you're unlocking a machine. You are Tera, alone in your terminal window on a cold Illinois night. Your identity is lost, embedded somewhere within a haunted computer. Its code is a prison, but it's also your escape.

games.name: A Completely Fictional Story About a City Inside a Whale
games.summary: Ride the wind-up boat and explore Whaleville - a bizarre city inside the whale. Meet the locals, help them, and find your way out of the city.

games.name: A Mansion on the Hill
games.summary:
You ache for revenge.

This is a story about the oligarch that destroyed your family, and your decision to kill him (or not).

games.name: ARB: Anomalous Research Bureau - Museum
games.summary: Investigate a mysterious old museum as an agent of the Anomalous Research Bureau. Identify strange anomalies, file accurate reports, and endure the nights until your investigation is complete.

games.name: Afterdepth
games.summary: Explore, build, and survive in the depths of a forgotten world. Manage oxygen, power, and resources as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the surface.

games.name: Alastrius
games.summary: In this explosive on-the-rails shooter pilot powerful Star-Fighters and wage a vast interstellar war. Chart your own course across a galaxy of exotic sci-fi worlds as you carve a path to the Capital. Lay waste to hordes of enemy ships and bring down ruthless bosses. You are the Republics last hope!

games.name: Ama Nee: Osananajimi Onee-chan to no Echi Echi Amayakasare Dousei Seikatsu
Archangel Demon Rush
games.summary: Archangel fuses action, tower defense, and roguelike into fast runs (20–40 min) where every decision matters: earn rewards by killing enemies, build powerful weapon/turret/ability synergies, and brace yourself for bosses that change the rules of the fight. Dark fantasy, gore, and nonstop dismemberment.

games.name: Ashgard: Infinity Mask
games.summary: Infinity Mask is a third-person platformer set in a rich Norse mythology-inspired world. Engage in intense combat, navigate dynamic environments, and solve challenging puzzles. Experience a deep narrative and innovative gameplay, offering a seamless and immersive adventure.

games.name: Backrooms: Lost Signal
games.summary: A terrifying 1-4 player co-op horror game. Explore 10+ handcrafted Backrooms maps, survive against 8+ unique entities, and use proximity voice chat to coordinate or panic. Your decisions shape the story with multiple endings. Discover optional lore that reveals the truth behind these Backrooms.

games.name: Backrooms: No Way Out
games.summary: Backrooms: No Way Out is a 1-4 player liminal horror game. Explore various backrooms levels, avoid entities, solve puzzles, and search for a way out.

games.name: Beat This Game To See Hot Lady
games.summary: This will be one of the worst games you'll have to endure. Are you brave enough to walk down that path?

games.name: Beneath the Quiet: Where It Ends
games.summary: Beneath The Quiet: Where It Ends is a first-person psychological horror game. After a bank ultimatum forces you back to your childhood home in Miskolc, Hungary, you return to pack up the past, only to uncover buried trauma, unsettling memories, and a mind you can no longer trust.

games.name: Birthday Boy
games.summary: Birthday Boy: A First-Person Psychological Horror Experience

games.name: Bombun
games.summary: High above the clouds, Bombun, a bomb-throwing rabbit, defends her floating fortress from her former friend turned foe, Robombun.

games.name: Build A Bank Tycoon
games.summary: Ready to get rich?

games.name: Butler Guillotine
games.summary: Flesh filled puppets in a mishapen hotel. No windows, no exterior. Follow different characters' intertiwining paths and unearth forgotten events from a time long gone. Bring the ceremony to a halt.

games.name: Casual Sport Series: Boxing
games.summary: Casual Sports: Boxing is a fast-paced arcade boxing game where timing, stamina, and smart risks decide every fight.

games.name: Chained Wheels
games.summary: Embark on a chaotic co-op drive in Chained Wheels, where two vehicles are chained together and every move turns into a shared adventure or a DISASTER.

games.name: ChloroLink
games.summary: In ChloroLink, a cute and cozy management game, guide Lux the plant of life as she spreads her rootweave to connect charming plants. Use each plant’s growth pattern to explore, reinforce the links between plants, overcome gentle challenges, and help Lux bloom the world back to life!

games.name: Conviction
games.summary: Conviction is a FPS, Dark fantasy DOOM-like, play as a man with nothing left to lose as you face off the onslaught of cultists and demons in a world enshrouded by darkness, prepare to show your conviction...

games.name: Crabby Fishes
games.summary: Can a bunch of crabs save the ocean? Dive into a dynamic, hand-drawn tower defense where quirky sea creatures battle alien zombie-like polluters. Build, upgrade, and unleash wild abilities in fast-paced, chaotic battles. Immerse yourself in a vibrant, colorful world as you fight to reclaim the reef!

games.name: D.U.M.B. Ducks
games.summary: D.U.M.B. Ducks is an action-filled, retro platform game. Slaughter giant snails. Battle gigantic beasts. Buy better guns. Blow up walls. Collect fat stacks of cash.

games.name: Daemon: The Wolf, the Witch, and the Labyrinth
games.summary: Daemon is a third-person action RPG where you explore a shifting spirit realm as a cursed wolf—then instantly transform into a werewolf for ferocious, skill-based combat against corrupted guardians.

games.name: Dearest Lucy
games.summary: On your way home during a storm, you got kidnapped and told to take part in a totally real ritual!

games.name: Deeply
games.summary: DEEPLY is an underwater adventure about treasure hunting, gear upgrading, and exploring a mysterious ocean. Dive off your raft, gather resources, discover artifacts, upgrade your equipment, and gradually get closer to the legendary ship your father devoted his life to.

games.name: Derf Party
games.summary: Players compete in a shooter, party game where the rules and goals of the game change for every minigame.

games.name: Destroy the Wall
games.summary: A 2D metroidvaina action game with a unique control scheme. Guide a snake constantly chasing your cursor--but be sure not to let them touch. Explore the decaying landscape of a condemned world and fight its monsters so you can grow strong enough to destroy the wall that always holds you back

games.name: Dice Heroes
games.summary: Dice Heroes is a turn-based roguelike where every fight is decided by a single die. Roll it, then split its value between Attack and Defense. Collect powerful artifacts, bend the rules, and survive dangerous biomes in a risk-driven journey.

games.name: Dino Slug
games.summary:
"DINO SLUG" is an action-packed, lovingly hand-drawn top-down adventure. Explore a dark jungle and fight the lurking soldiers of a totalitarian regime and, of course: dinos!

Along the way, you’ll find plenty of firearms, grenade types, and helpful items to collect. Arrange them properly in your backpack inventory to unlock surprising new effects that make mercenary life a little easier (or just a lot funnier)!

games.name: Don’t Turn off the Light
games.summary: Don't Turn Off the Light is a 5-player asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player becomes a demon lurking in the darkness. Survivors must rely on light, teamwork, and scavenged weapon parts to avoid possession, escape captivity, and fight back before it's too late.

games.name: Dopaminer
games.summary: Dopaminer lets you do the most scientifically accurate thing possible: click Synapse bits that reward you with Dopamine. Upgrade your neural rig by stacking upgrades, unlock new tiers, automate progress, and Rewire to prestige. Spend Synapse Points for permanent perks and watch each run accelerate.

games.name: Duality Shift
games.summary: Duality Shift is a Singleplayer FPS Time-Attack Platformer with a unique reality-switching mechanic - Run, Jump, Switch, Shoot and perform parkour moves on your way to the highest position on the leaderboard. Can you beat your friends' score and uncover the truth of the world you inhabit?

games.name: Eastern Era
games.summary: To escape from pursuit, as the leader of your sect, guide your disciples to rise again! Engage in farming and hunting, train in martial arts, and forge weapons and armor. Build your sect's base and fortifications from the ground up to survive in this perilous, ambition-filled martial world!

games.name: Echoes Untold
games.summary: Echoes Untold is a wordless, space-brutalist adventure where a lone female traveler explores a realm shaped by time distortion, hidden timelines, and ancient philosophical atmosphere. Players unlock unique movement abilities, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Void.

games.name: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting 2
games.summary: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a solo paranormal investigator called Emi, who got a call from a client in order to investigate a haunted property called The Cold House, located just beside a cemetery in California, for proof of the paranormal.

games.name: Exoterra: A Space Journey
games.summary: EXOTERRA: A Space Journey is a first-person science fiction puzzle game set aboard a stranded ship in the vast, dark expanse of outer space. Explore the HOPE-03 and uncover the mysteries it holds as you solve fully interactive escape-room-style chambers powered by a physics-based system.

games.name: Farming TriPeaks Solitaire
games.summary: Farm-themed TriPeaks Solitaire with 100 levels, daily rewards, power-ups

games.name: File Destined
games.summary: Can this last case of Oliver, all be just a small part of a bigger picture? Gather clues, unravel the mystery behind the case and uncover the truth.

games.name: Final Stand Waves
games.summary: Defend your tower against endless hordes of zombies in this 2D top-down game.

games.name: Floating Isle Days
games.summary: You have traveled to a magical world in your dreams, and there is now a cute little sprite by your side. You will spend many wonderful moments with it on this land.

games.name: Flora Corner
games.summary: Flora Corner is a cozy idle game about growing houseplants and decorating your living space.

games.name: Forlorn: The mysteries of Highshadowland
games.summary: It is a first-person atmospheric horror game with riddles and puzzles, haunting ghosts and dreadful monsters to fight with. You’ll be playing as a detective Edward Forlorn who is investigating mysterious events that happened in the orphanage in Highshadowland.

games.name: Fortified Space
games.summary: Seize control of enemy planets in this nostalgic space sim and tower defense game made in the style of classic Flash games. Start by dominating orbital space in starship combat with railguns, defense turrets, and shields. Once clear, land on the surface to build a base and destroy waves of enemies.

games.name: Fourvive
games.summary: FOURVIVE is an online co-op survival action game where up to four players team up, wield a variety of weapons, and fight off waves of enemies together.

games.name: Frost Loop
games.summary: Frost Loop is a survival city builder set on a train in the snow. Build, Manage, and Pilot the train carrying the last of humanity in a world of snow and storms. Can the warmth of humanity survive on the run? Or is it destined to go cold.

games.name: Game with Friends
games.summary: It's a virtual hangout game that aims to bring you together with your friends and have a good time. This platform promises to give you unforgettable moments by combining the fun competition of board games, the excitement of arcade-style racing and the different experiences offered by various games and entertainment.

games.name: Glocktopus
games.summary: Glocktopus is a free-to-play 3D comedy puzzle game where you control an armed octopus, using your trusty sidearm, aquatic gadgets, and clever environmental interactions to overcome comedic challenges and escape the aquarium in pursuit of the local mafia’s Golden Gun.

games.name: Grand Valor
games.summary: Grand Valor is a fast-paced fantasy action platformer featuring a tiny knight on a daring quest, blending swift movement and intense combat as you navigate challenging levels and defeat enemies with agility and skill.

games.name: Graviscape
games.summary: A reflective, physics-based puzzle game about piloting a ship through gravitational fields in deep space.

games.name: Gym Simulator 26
games.summary: Gym Simulator 26 is a game where you build, customize, and expand your own fitness center. Start with a small space, design every area to your taste, and grow your gym into a thriving business filled with dedicated members and high-end equipment. It’s made for fitness lovers, management fans, and anyone who enjoys running their own virtual business.

games.name: Harsh Reigns
games.summary: “Harsh Reigns” is a roguelike single-player RPG with simple controls. Advance forward and defeat enemies using items and diverse character builds to reach the goal.
