games.name: Horror Park
games.summary: Some places should stay forgotten...

games.name: Hotel Simulator 2026
games.summary: Hotel Simulator 2026: Clean up the Past, Build Your Future.

games.name: Hypnaborea
games.summary: You woke up on a mysterious island today...

games.name: Idle Demon Summoner
games.summary: A dark yet vibrant idle game featuring creature collecting, tower-defense, and bullet-heaven elements. Unlock new demons and weapons to conquer distant worlds.

games.name: Impact to the Head
games.summary: Story-driven, first-person melee combat game. After being discharged from the military, a man turns to the occupation of a hired killer.

games.name: Industrial Legion
games.summary: Fight against and with thousands of individually simulated troops as a cohesive team blending first person shooter combat with squad management or with real time strategy

games.name: Infinite Cards
games.summary: Discover infinite cards in this roguelike deckbuilder. Every card is unique, every run a new experience. Craft, combine, and build your deck completely freely to defeat enemies and bosses, or take on cleverly designed puzzle challenges!

games.name: Island Market Simulator
games.summary: Team up with your friends and build a thriving trade empire in this CO-OP strategy and economy simulation set on a lively island. Begin with a small market, share tasks, manage production chains, raise livestock, and dominate the economy together through changing seasons and dynamic festivals!

games.name: Island of Hearts
games.summary: After a rough breakup, you do what any reasonable person would: run away to a remote tropical island full of beautiful strangers. There, you’ll meet six captivating women, each with her own charm, secrets, and questionable taste in men. Your choices decide who you love, lose, or accidentally ghost.

games.name: John Fart: Text-iverse of Crazyness
games.summary: Play as John Fart and travel through time to stop the mutated bees.

games.name: Just Deserts
games.summary:
Just Deserts is a sci-fi action dating sim where you play as a soldier who must protect a city from mysterious alien attack, while at the same time you will also be seeking to capture the heart of your dream girl(s)!

Theme song by Vesuvia [Ecky], vocal track by iMochi

games.name: Maid Mech
games.summary: In 2060, nanoweapons leaked from an Antarctic ancient ruin transformed Earth lifeforms into deadly bioweapons. As human forces retreat, you—a top frontline commander—are tasked with leading experimental 3rd-gen mech units to defend the most critical zone until civilians evacuate to near-Earth orbit.

games.name: Make Moku Proud
games.summary: Uncover the truth behind a broken ritual in Make Moku Proud... a psychological visual novel where guilt and obedience, and what it means to make Moku proud, shape the fate of a witness watching his companions disappear.

games.name: Marsh Into the New Dimension
games.summary: Delve into a new adventure... and some new dimensions. Marsh Into the New Dimension is a thrilling 3D boss-rush platformer adventure game travelling through brand new worlds and meeting new friends to help you save the universe from unwanted destruction.

games.name: Mini Car Coin Collector
games.summary: A fast-paced top-down 2D arcade racing game with endless single-player action and competitive 1v1 multiplayer. Collect coins, upgrade 10 unique cars, chase high scores, and outdrive your opponent in quick skill-based races.

games.name: Missing Texture
games.summary: Missing Texture is a psychological horror experience told in chapters. Download the free Launcher and access all main chapters at no cost. The full story expands through additional games.

games.name: Moving Day: Make It Home
games.summary: Turn empty houses into cozy homes at your own pace. Complete gentle client requests, unlock items for Sandbox Mode, and capture your finished designs in Camera Mode.

games.name: My Egg Girls: A Gentle Story
games.summary: A 100-day cohabitation romance you’ll wish would never end. Your choices sway emotions, shaping reactions and the ending in this emotional growth ADV.

games.name: MyRobot
games.summary:
Adventure Character Simulator with optional AI features featuring your own robot that you can build and explore with.

Developed by sgthale, StillKill, and algernonvanpeel

games.name: Myth Monkey Card
games.summary: A unique blend of Texas Hold'em poker mechanics and Roguelike strategy. Forge your destiny across four distinct cultivation paths and challenge the gods of the Celestial Court. Will you master Artefacts for precise combos, or rely on the Self for a desperate comeback? In this mythic battle where the world is your card table, victory is yours to define.

games.name: Neotag League
games.summary: Team up and beat your opponents in Neotag League, the sport from the future, where sci-fi parkour robots chase each other to score points! Jump, roll, wall run, grapple, dodge and attack in this team-based multiplayer game of Chase Tag.

games.name: Noneday
games.summary: Grab your notebook and get ready to explore every nook and cranny of the surreal, esoteric adventure game Noneday! Search dreams for clues, solve puzzles, and unlock the secrets hiding within Bow’s own mind.

games.name: Pal Pachinko
games.summary: Your job is boring. Pal Pachinko isn't. Park this idle game in the corner of your screen and watch your balls drop along with your productivity. It's the most efficient way to waste your time. Why focus on one thing when you can fail at two? It's small enough that your boss won't notice (probably).

games.name: Paradise Loop
games.summary:
Paradise Loop is a visual novel set within a killing game structure. Twelve strangers wake up in a mysterious hotel called Pandora’s Box with no memory of how they got there, or even who they fully are. Their only instruction comes from a mysterious entity known as the Benefactor: “explore.” However, for two amongst their number, a different purpose is in store.

The player selects one of four characters to play as, with each offering a unique perspective on the same series of events. Depending on the character you choose, you may find yourself as the one doing the killing. For this reason, while the story centers on the 'whodunit' mystery, the actual gameplay focuses on the character drama as you build relationships and keep secrets from the other guests. Each of the four paths is about five hours long, with the choices you make creating a slightly different story each time.

games.name: Parking Problem
games.summary: Welcome to Parking Problem—a slick, satisfying puzzler about untangling jammed car parks. Slide vehicles in the right order, open up tight lanes, and guide every last car to the exit. It’s quick to learn, deeply strategic, and perfect for that “one more puzzle” rhythm.

games.name: Parking Tycoon 2: Business Simulator
games.summary: Return to the world of parking business! In Parking Tycoon 2: Business Simulator, you're not only building your empire - you're defending it. With a new combat system, skill upgrades, and security guards, your parking lot becomes a fortress!

games.name: Peeping
games.summary: Peeping​ is a psychological survival game where you, a detained "supernatural suspect," must balance pretense and madness during a 31-day prison observation.

games.name: Pinball Garden
games.summary: Set in the charming world of “Garden,” where tiny creatures and playful spirits gather, this pinball game features two modes: CLASSIC, a single-player challenge for high scores, and VERSUS, a multiplayer race to fill the honey gauge first.

games.name: Pixel Pile
games.summary: Stack, Assemble, and battle— Puzzle precision decides the battle! "Shape" your path to victory! Customize your "Shape" too! A falling-block puzzle where you create "Shape" based on challenges. Solo play, local, and online battles available.

games.name: Poké Everworld Online
games.summary: A Pokemon MMO fan game that aims to have all the regions, Anime locations, Manga events and Tough boss battles.

games.name: Princess of Worlds End
games.summary: A dark fantasy visual novel about a girl named Princess who, through a strange series of events, unlocks a new power that changes her life forever. Guide Princess to help her get her life together, manage her relationships, her addiction and, most importantly, prevent the end of the world!

games.name: Project Chameleon
games.summary: Project Chameleon is a stealth game where you must shape-shift into objects to go unnoticed by your enemies. Play as Siren, an elite spy executing missions around the globe. Manipulate your surroundings, set traps, and use powerful gadgets in each mission.

games.name: Rabbit Samurai
games.summary: In Rabbit Samurai, you’ll join a colorful 2D deck-building adventure. Each fight is tougher and funnier than the last.

games.name: Retro Drive
games.summary: Follow the journey of a college kid, who always seems to get left behind. He recently got held back after class, but his friends are already out party'n! This is no way for you to spend your best years, and you drive with the sheer determination to catch up with them.

games.name: Retro Drive: Revamped
games.summary: Get your '80s vibes in full throttle with Retro Drive! Immerse yourself in the retro aesthetic, gripping narrative, and an unforgettable synthwave soundtrack.

games.name: Retro Motel Simulator
games.summary: Retro Motel Simulator invites you to step back in time and run your very own roadside motel in the golden age of travel. Manage rooms, greet guests, and keep your business running smoothly — all with the charm and style of a bygone era.

games.name: Riftborne
games.summary: Riftborne is a classic terminal based, real time, grand strategy game. Construct space ships. Take part in factional warfare. Hire galactic hit-men on your rivals. Raid neighbors for rare resources. Train spies to infiltrate enemy bases for key intel. Grow your empire to dominate the galaxy.

games.name: Riruka ha Ikue ni Yoru wo Irodoru
games.summary:
"I have other personalities," the girl said on the night they first met.

Her gaze was serious as she looked at Shiraishi Naoya - the self-proclaimed detective - who responded by lighting a cigarette with a skeptical expression. At first, he didn't believe her. How could multiple personalities truly exist within a single body?

There was the overly familiar and cheeky Nanase, with a penchant for overt physical intimacy.
The prudish but naive Senri, who gets easily flustered.
The calm and collected Kanna, who always keeps her composure.
And the one who Naoya met first - the pure and honest Riruka, who has a streak of shyness.

They met on a rainy night, and by a twist of fate, Naoya found himself bringing the "girls" home.

She is a girl who carries multiple souls within her, and each personality holds a wish of her own - desires so powerful that they gave birth to new selves.

When all of their wishes are finally fulfilled... what awaits at the end?

games.name: Rod of Asclepius
games.summary: Rod of Asclepius is a historical RPG in 4th-century Pannonia. Play a Roman medicus: investigate symptoms, gather herbs, and perform turn-based treatments. Explore researched sites and make ethical choices that shape your reputation as the empire falters.

games.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic
games.summary:
RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic is a new RCT experience, combining the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon and RollerCoaster Tycoon 2.

Create and run amazing parks complete with the most outrageous rides imaginable. RCT Classic includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon PC Games, now enhanced for handheld devices.

Packed with content, players can enjoy designing and building roller coasters and rides, landscaping parks and managing the staff and finances to keep their guests happy and the money flowing in. Can you become the next RollerCoaster Tycoon?

games.name: Romance Protocol
games.summary:
You're the only human in a school full of monsters.

But you're not a threat… at least not in the way they think. Armed with a peculiar device, you fire compliments, flowers, and gifts instead of bullets.

The monsters, unable to handle so much affection, flee at the sight of you. If you manage to affect them enough, their hearts collapse… and they leave their essence behind for you to collect.

However, it's not all that easy. The Headmaster, an imposing creature immune to your charms, will relentlessly pursue you to banish you from his world.

Face rejection, spread love by force, and survive this chaotic and adorable school hell.

games.name: Roof Leak Hero
games.summary: Keep things from flooding as long as possible and get the highest score! Throw your containers and make trick shots to land them directly where you need them to be. Dump excess water into the drain and advance to the next point level to get point multipliers and reach even crazier scores!

games.name: Samuel Prince Attorney at Law: Chapter 4
games.summary: The fourth of seven chapters of a courtroom battle style visual novel, in which the story follows brand new lawyer Samuel Prince as he solves a strange variety of different crimes. Investigate the crime scene for evidence, then use it in court to find the real truth behind the case.

games.name: Sexorcism: Lust Confession
games.summary: An explicit card battler where you fight corrupted nuns, strip them in combat, build your deck, strengthen your character, and unlock the hottest scenes as you progress.

games.name: Shadow Girls
games.summary: Follow the vengeance-driven Diana as she infiltrates her school’s most infamous clique: the Four Lashes. In order to prove her loyalty to the group, Diana must participate in a series of mentally taxing activities orchestrated by the group’s leader, Sabrina.

games.name: Shell Increment
games.summary: An active incremental were You Command your Skeleton Pirate crew. Destroy and Loot ships of their precious shells, Buy and Upgrade cannons. Unlock new abilities and Face Powerful Admirals and become the Richest Pirate there is.

games.name: Shop & Stuff: Supermarket Simulator
games.summary:
Step into the chaos of Shop & Stuff, the quirky VR supermarket simulator where running a store is anything but ordinary.

Start small in this roadside mini-market and hustle your way up by stocking shelves, satisfying bizarre customers, and surviving the wild world of retail. Chase off shoplifters, fix glitchy self-checkouts and clean up unexpected messes to make it through each day!

games.name: Shuwa Shuwa Guin!
games.summary: Shuwa Shuwa Guin is a time management game set in a charming world of penguins, where you must wash, dry, and iron clothes to keep your grandfather's laundry business open! Use the money you earn to buy items that will make your job easier!

games.name: Side Hustle
games.summary: Welcome to the Side Hustle program! You have 5 days to dispose of defective androids and earn the prestigious City of Light citizenship! Your freedom HAS a price, and it’s a great deal!

games.name: Sky Drill
games.summary: Jump, boost, and strategize your way through increasingly difficult levels in this 2D roguelite platformer. Use equipment combos to tear through the stratosphere in ridiculous bursts of speed. Drill deep into the earth, mining mountains of gold, precious gemstones, and more.

games.name: Slime Must Grow
games.summary: Slime Must Grow is a single-screen incremental game about one thing: make the slime grow.

games.name: Snake Party Extreme
games.summary: The best Snake game ever made. A chaotic, unforgettable, laugh-out-loud 4-player couch battle. An intense test of your arcade gaming skills. Snake Party Extreme is all of these...and so, so much more!

games.name: Souper Bloody
games.summary: Slaughter the vegetables that accidentally summoned your demonic self in this devilishly tasty action-packed roguelite hack-and-slash! Upgrade your attacks and gain new spicy powers every run while exploring the depths of the Underlasagne.

games.name: Spells & Shells
games.summary: Dodge and blast through waves of enemies using powerful spells and magical weaponry in this fast-paced fantasy top-down twin-stick arena shooter. Acquire permanent enhancements, unlock new weapons and relics and create unique builds to dominate the battlefield.

games.name: Sukima: The Creeping Gap
games.summary: A gap somewhere in your room begins to open on its own, little by little. If you can’t find it and close it before it opens completely. A first-person escape game centered around the fear of gaps.

games.name: Tache Noire
games.summary: An exploration survival horror game set in the idyllic town of Lucenille. Explore every single crevice and find what happened to your friends. Bring them back. Make them understand.

games.name: Task Force Ranger: Lead the way!
games.summary: Strike back against global terror and lead the fight in modern combat zones.

games.name: Tasogare no Shape Shifter
games.summary:
“I’ll become your ideal girlfriend. So please, just give me one more chance.”

The one who appeared before Hiroto Takenouchi saying that was Chise Koumoto, his clingy ex-girlfriend whom he should have broken up with yesterday… or rather, something else wearing her form.
Calling herself Eiko, her true nature is that of a shapeshifter: a shadowy aberration that devours other beings and blends into human society by mimicking them.
Though she has taken Chise into herself, Eiko claims she hasn’t absorbed her completely, instead keeping her inside. She makes a demand:
“I don’t care if it’s only for a limited time. I want to live as your girlfriend. If you do that, I’ll safely release Chise.”

And so begins a temporary, make-believe romantic relationship born from that promise. Yet once they actually start dating, Eiko turns out to be even more in sync with him than Chise ever was.
Through his interactions with Eiko, Hiroto’s exhausted heart is soothed, and he begins to remember what it feels like to like someone, to feel fulfilled by it.

But precisely because of that, there will come a day when he must face it.
The truth that the girl before him is an inhuman being, living by principles different from those of humans.
And the fresh yet bitter memories that have shaped Hiroto into who he is…

games.name: Tears of the Maker
games.summary: Tears of the Maker is a roguelike deck builder in which tears flow to the chambers to determine who attacks. Use your cards to manipulate the game and change your fate. Collect cards and build your stats in story mode or go for a more hardcore endless mode where you risk it all to go farther.

games.name: Technotopia
games.summary: Technotopia is a city-builder roguelike card game. Take on the role of an AI designed to build a perfect city. Build districts, meet the needs of diverse communities and maintain the delicate balance between factions vying for control over you!

games.name: Teryndor: Caelorn’s Quest
games.summary: An Action game with Tower Defense elements where you defend the Protective Crystals of Teryndor! As Prince Caelorn, fight against hordes of creatures to save your kingdom from destruction.

games.name: The Cubes
games.summary: The Cubes is a colorful puzzle adventure where you control four unique cubes to solve spatial challenges. Switch between the cubes, activate buttons, overcome spikes, collect coins and solve puzzles in a relaxing yet brain-teasing experience.

games.name: The Host: Cataclysm
games.summary: After a Post-Armageddon event the world has gone back to its roots living in simpler times, back to swords, kings, and war. After the hero has chosen evil the world is left in ruins as everyone struggles to survive in this new found world.

games.name: The Kingdom of the Golden Thread and the MadClocks
games.summary: Two worlds, one brilliant bond.

games.name: The Red Pearls of Borneo
games.summary:
The Red Pearls of Borneo is a detective mystery deduction game inspired by Type Help, Return of the Obra Dinn and The Case of the Golden Idol.

You are a clairvoyant investigator in 1948 London, exploring the psychic echoes of a tragedy that occurred eight years prior on a remote plantation in Borneo.

games.name: The Saint
games.summary: The Saint" is a first-person psychological horror set in eerie liminal spaces with VHS body cam visuals. Explore a decaying dreamworld, solve symbolic puzzles, and escape a nightmare inspired by the dread and mystery of Silent Hill.

games.name: The Vampire's Bride: A Bride Who Gets Married to Vampdoll
games.summary: A visual novel game featuring a pure love girls' love story bound by blood, with the concept of "Vampires x Military Uniforms x girls' love (yuri) ."

games.name: The Wide Open Sky Is Running Out of Catfish
games.summary: A story-driven photography game... on the back of a giant, flying catfish. Transform clouds into sea creatures and bring abundance back to an empty sky.

games.name: Theralite
games.summary: A turn based Sci-fi Roguelike where players explore the deep mines on a distant planet, find/trade equipment, battle monsters and try to survive.

games.name: To Heaven
games.summary: "I promise, I will get you to Heaven!" Earn your afterlife ticket with angel Ariel! Manage schedules and master 3 mini-games: Dog Walking (Action), Playtime (Survivor-like), and Cleaning (Tower Defense). A heartwarming multi-ending visual novel featuring a Monk, Nun, and Pastor helper trio.

games.name: Too Well Hidden
games.summary: A found footage horror game about two sisters who often play hide and seek in their family home, recording everything with their mother's VHS camera. What begins innocently, soon turns disturbing, when it becomes clear that something is terribly wrong.

games.name: Transfer Point
games.summary: Transfer Point is a point-and-click adventure game about regret, forgiveness, and email. Click on items in the scene, select commands from menus, or type short phrases in the text window to determine your actions. You’ll need to explore unusual places, solve peculiar puzzles, and find a decent Wi-Fi connection to continue on your journey.

games.name: Truck License Trainer
games.summary: Drive a simulated truck to gain knowledge and intuition of a real thing while having fun. Challenge yourself with real-life scenarios or almost impossible maps.

games.name: Tune to Win
games.summary: One car. One track. Infinite setups. You’ll be faster next run. Promise.

games.name: Unmourned
games.summary: Unmourned is a first person psychological horror game where you play as Jason, a man who moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal activities. As the disturbances grow more intense, Jason discovers that the house's previous owners mysteriously vanished. Driven by terror and desperation, Jason must uncover the truth behind the family’s disappearance and find a way to break the curse that now haunts him. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

games.name: Velvet Hammer
games.summary: Velvet Hammer is an atmospheric tile game that fuses narrative curiosity with meaningful choices: Easy to learn, hard to forget. Over 12 days, you endure , and you navigate inter-day word-matching evaluations that measure (and manipulate) your identity.

games.name: Venus in Transit
games.summary: The mother vessel is adrift in space, out of fuel and doomed. Your mission is the colony’s only hope for survival. Will you be able to navigate the claustrophobic canyons when your ship begins to fail?

games.name: Virtual Cottage 2
games.summary: Virtual Cottage 2 motivates and supports you in tackling your daily tasks. Use its built-in productivity tool to accomplish your goals faster. Create your ultimate cozy space with a wide range of different furniture.

games.name: Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces
games.summary: Be a pioneer of aerial warfare in Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces. Fight above the battlefields of World War I and become the ultimate Sky Ace!

games.name: Werehouse
games.summary: Werehouse is a co-op haunted night shift where you and up to 3 other overworked elves package presents for Santa. If stocking the sleigh trucks an hour before Christmas wasn’t stressful enough, you’ll be fighting for your life against holiday monsters while you’re at it.

games.name: Who Are You!?
games.summary: Who Are You!? is a sci-fi psychological horror experience based on real UFO research. The story centers on Ray Roswell and his internal fight to understand the disappearance of his wife, which may involve an alien abduction.

games.name: Who am I: Remedy
games.summary: Horror-detective game created on Unreal Engine 5. Solve puzzles, read notes, enjoy original soundtrack, don't forget to pick up the phone and finally, answer the question "Who am I?".

games.name: Wood'N'Destroy
games.summary:
Wood’N’Destroy is an explosive real-time strategy game where you must build your base, manage your resources, and annihilate your enemies in intense tactical battles.

Chop wood, grow your economy, train your army, and prepare to destroy enemy bases before they destroy yours.

Every match is a fight for dominance: strategy, adaptation, and timing will make the difference between victory and destruction.

games.name: Worshippers of Cthulhu
games.summary: LEAD the CULT OF CTHULHU. Decide the fate of your followers, perform eldritch rituals, and master the art of city-building in a world where the line between sanity and madness blurs. Can you endure the horrors you unleash?

games.name: 2025: Mosaic Retrospective
games.summary: 2025: Mosaic Retrospective is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by global news stories from throughout the year.

games.name: Billy Boots' Treasure
games.summary: A tiny spark of hope can light up even the stillest world.

games.name: Bun Buns
games.summary: Don’t let your buns hop out the basket! Drop, merge, and stack your pastries to bake the biggest, most delicious treat!

games.name: Buried Spirits
games.summary: A minesweeper game where you can use your magical abilities to deal with pesky odds. Save your concentration resource to speed up the process or get rid of tiebreakers. Mine your way through without disturbing the spirits.

games.name: Clownfield 6
games.summary: It's 2028. After years of foreign conflicts, economic strain, and prolonged emergency measures, public trust in the U.S. government collapses. What begins as nationwide protests quickly escalates into armed resistance.

games.name: Deep Diver
games.summary: The player controls a treasure-hunting diver exploring the randomly generated depths of the ocean. Their goal is to collect treasures, artifacts, and marine life, upgrade their equipment, and discover new, increasingly dangerous and mysterious locations.

games.name: Delivery Driver Massacre: Definitive Edition
games.summary: A late-night delivery turns into a PSX nightmare. Trapped in a house with a killer, you must solve puzzles and hide to survive. Multiple endings and authentic VHS visuals. Can you escape the rot?

games.name: Detective Bloodphobia
games.summary: Detective Bloodphobia is a black-and-white noir visual novel with point-and-click investigations and deduction gameplay.

games.name: Dreams Far Away
games.summary: This game offers a first-person platforming experience for up to 8 players. After a mutated rabies virus began to threaten life on Earth, humanity found refuge in safe cities built in the sky. Overcome obstacles to reach the safe city — and be the first to get there.

games.name: Eternal Dreams: Poker RPG
games.summary: A Rogue AI and alien virus have trapped humanity in a dream-sim. - Craft Poker combos in this Roguelite JRPG; build and BREAK your deck to shatter the illusion. In this Deckbuilder, every hand doesn’t just change fate, it rewrites reality.

games.name: Fat Fleet
games.summary: Grow in strength and sexy, adorable blubber as you destroy alien cakes in this fixed shooter arcade throwback!

games.name: Garden Work Simulator 2026
games.summary: From a single seed to a thriving garden - grow your legacy.

games.name: Gift Drop Machine: Life Simulator
games.summary: Survive with surprise gifts dropping from the machine! Sell or use them. Maintain the balance between hunger and energy, manage your bank, grow with your credit card, and buy homes and cars. Every choice changes your fate. Survive the roguelike challenge by combining luck and strategy.

games.name: Heaven Invaders
games.summary: Move, think, and attack quickly to expel the angels and demons from this world.

games.name: Hentai Age Classic
games.summary: Relax with a peaceful puzzle game that reveals beautiful girl portraits. No timers or pressure—just smooth, calming gameplay with soothing visuals you can enjoy anytime.

games.name: Jackie’s Forest: Outsourced
games.summary: Jackie's Forest: Outsourced is a FNaF inspired game where you will go through 5 different rooms with task-based challenges to get to the end. Just don't let the performers get to you!

games.name: Juler's Mod
games.summary: A recreation of Garry's Mod, only difference is that it's made in Unity and it's completely free

games.name: Learn Hiragana!!
games.summary: Learn Hiragana!! is an educational game that helps you memorize the basic Japanese syllabary, Hiragana. Choose the correct spelling of each character from the 4 options and score points. But to add a little challenge, you only have 3 lives that decrease with each incorrect answer.

games.name: Lost Flame
games.summary: Lost Flame is a modern roguelike game featuring unique and challenging turn-based combat. Explore the ruined kingdom of Hiraeth, discover its history or ignore it and focus on the gameplay itself.

games.name: Pachincro
games.summary: An action-packed pachinko–plinko incremental game with a massive skill tree and tons of upgrades. Drop balls, stack multipliers, unlock new abilities, watch the chaos scale into pure satisfaction, all while trying to defeat the boss and staying alive

games.name: Parkour Paws
games.summary: An action-packed parkour game

games.name: Restore
games.summary: In this RPG, take on the role of Shouichi, who is summoned to another world alongside Azuha and Emily. With your abilities sealed, you'll need to rely on your wits and teamwork to survive. Will you be able to protect your friends and get them back home safely?

games.name: Rickdle
games.summary: An interactive daily Twitch game where you match chatters with messages they've sent that stream.

games.name: Self Deleted
games.summary: In a cyberpunk city, debts are paid with memories. You have 30 minutes to choose what to erase — love, friendship, or yourself. An interactive story with 7 endings about identity, survival, and the price of memory.

games.name: Storage Hunter: Bid War Simulator
games.summary: Win auctions, uncover secrets, and become an auction legend.

games.name: Territorial Conquest
games.summary: Lead your nation in Territorial Conquest through the Middle Ages, WWII, and Modern Era. Expand borders, build armies, trade, sabotage enemies, make political decisions, and conquer the world in immersive real-time strategy.

games.name: The Scourge
games.summary: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

games.name: Undead Tide: Light's Defense
games.summary: Relaxed strategic bullet hell survival, defending against endless undead legions! A roguelite bullet hell shooter that blends hero development, talent builds, and weapon combinations, supporting multiple playstyles and strategies!

games.name: Valehona Tap!
games.summary: Tap your way through Valehona Tap! A 2D pixel tap and idle game, Impress your friends with high Prestige Levels and Goons Slain. Can you reach the boss?

games.name: Banana Drama
games.summary: Banana Drama is an independent early access RTS game offering a single player and multiplayer experience. Your monkey king is held captive by evil dinosaurs - he needs help!

games.name: Beyond Solar
games.summary: Beyond Solar is a bullet hell / SHMUP pixel art game. You play the protagonist “Gravity” a space ship pilot who grew up in the space colony “ARD”, humanity last hope and shelter as planet Earth was on the brink of extinction.

games.name: Burning, Crackling
games.summary: Nero is burning his drawings and sketchbooks after he received the news that he failed to enter his dream university. Fortunately, his best friend, Jin, comes just in time to stop his dumbass friend.

games.name: CloserTo
games.summary: The real-time multiplayer estimation game. Guess numbers, pin locations on the world map, and choose the closest answer. Live against your friends. A pure skill duel, free to play in your browser. No download or installation required.

games.name: Elf World Adventure 12: Winter Episode!
games.summary: Elf World Adventure 12: Winter Episode is a winter-themed episode of the popular H-game in the anime and puzzle genre, transporting you to a snowy and cozy world of elf girls.

games.name: Fright Animatronics
games.summary: Fright Animatronics is a first-person psychological horror game. Welcome to your new job as a night shift guard and technician in our pizzeria. Your task is to repair animatronics, to monitor them and the pizzeria building using video surveillance

games.name: Gunlocked 2
games.summary: Movement is your weapon. A sci-fi action roguelike and shmup combined, in Gunlocked 2 you'll pilot and upgrade a state-of-the-art warship against endless waves of deadly aliens. Deep customization, branching paths, and tons of unlockables offer endless replayability!

games.name: GwenBlade Witcheresque
games.summary: Hack and slash your way through depression in lightning-paced Soulslike to find a way to finally move on from loss in real life

games.name: Holy Crap Bears!
games.summary: Go through a forest full of dangerous bears.

games.name: Immunica
games.summary: Fight, upgrade, and survive against the pathogens invading your body.

games.name: Jamhouse
games.summary: Jamhouse is a fast paced falling block/platformer hybrid. Run, jump, and haul tasty tiles to clear waves of jams falling all around you!

games.name: Mukke
games.summary: Mukke City is about to take its musical turn! Help the new music scene by getting your self-created music on the radio, rocking the local music venues and hanging out with your newfound friends! MUKKE lets you make your own way between laid-back everyday life and gripping intrigue!

games.name: Overwork Empire
games.summary: This is a business simulation + tower defense + card game. Players will play the role of the boss, use cards to build facilities, allocate talents, and force overtime to make profits. Players will jump out of the perspective of workers and experience the overtime culture as operators.

games.name: Pegote
games.summary:
Pegote is inspired by Guerra (war), a simple card game many of us grew up playing with a Spanish deck.

It’s a game of chance and comparison. Flip a card, higher wins. Easy to learn, easy to play anywhere. We wanted to build on that familiar foundation, adding layers, decisions, and a bit of chaos :)

games.name: Richy's Nightmares
games.summary: Plunge into the little boy's world of fantasy, with overactive imagination and wild fear. The game contains plenty of puzzles and obstacles. Richy need your help to overcome all difficulties and fears on his way.

games.name: Shiny Recollection: First Step
games.summary: A doujin dating-sim set in the Idolmaster Shiny Colors universe, which will let you romance Meguru, Kogane, Juri, Rinze and Chiyuki.

games.name: Tale of Excalibun
games.summary: Wield the Excalibun and found a kingdom for the rabbit kind by rescuing bunnies of different specializations from different environments and worlds.

games.name: The Mystical Traveler
games.summary: Play as a mysterious green cube and rise from the depths of a ruined world. Master your jumps, survive traps, and purify a dying ecosystem in this 2D platformer.

games.name: Traitor's Kitchen
games.summary: Work together to cook and manage the kitchen—unless you’re the traitor, whose mission is to ruin everything! Fast-paced, hilarious, and full of sabotage.

games.name: Unreal Hospital 8
games.summary: Nix, the handyman investigating disappearances at an abandoned hospital. This game is inspired by Exit 8 and is an Exit 8-like (Exit 8-esque) game. If you notice anything unusual, shoot and destroy it. If nothing seems amiss, proceed straight to the exit.

games.name: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense
games.summary: A short relaxing incremental game disguised as a tower defense, but enemies can’t reach your walls. Thanks to lava.

games.name: A Byte War
games.summary: A Byte War is a real time strategy game where you lead a race of block-based machines against a machine threat from another dimension. Construct buildings from blocks arranged in various patterns and leverage your machines to convert the world around you.

games.name: A House Inside Me
games.summary: A psychological horror experience told through environmental storytelling. Explore a house inhabited by trauma, denial, and fractured memories. Three endings. Multiple interpretations. This is the house that lives inside me.

games.name: Adventure Jampilation
games.summary: An ever-growing compilation of all the short adventure games made by Gugames during various game jams

games.name: Ancestral Players
games.summary: Hurl fiery axes into rivals' faces, fire arrows with surgical precision, or blast your buddies with explosive coconuts. Paint the arena with the blood of your enemies in this chaotic, skill-based PvP shooter where death is your greatest power-up.

games.name: Angel's Dreams
games.summary: Angel's Dreams - a roguelike game with horror elements, where your nightmare awaits you at home! Wake up, Explore, Survive, Escape!

games.name: Animalkind
games.summary: Animalkind is an inviting open-world town-building game where you play as an intelligent, aww-dorable animal who discovers an ancient mech. Use your powerful mech to establish your ideal town and recruit a variety of characters to join you. It's the paw-fect game to play with up to 3 friends!

games.name: Batomon Showdown
games.summary: Batomon Showdown is a monster taming asynchronous pvp autobattler. Discover and battle with hundreds of Batomon! Assemble the ultimate team to take down other players! Play at your own pace while you discover new deadly team combos and synergies! Break the game by training your Batomon to overpowered levels.

games.name: Blockade Runner
games.summary: An arcade-style tactics/strategy mini-game set in space. Players pilot a spaceship or a fleet of spaceships and navigate them past a blockade of guard ships so they can arrive safely at their home planet. Players can complete the game's 19 levels in about 1 hour.

games.name: Bloodletter
games.summary: A grim medieval deckbuilder where you use your dubious healing methods to protect bizarre villagers from the corrupting influence of ancient evils.

games.name: Buckle Up
games.summary: Buckle Up! is a chaotic 2–6 player party shooter where every round is a new mess. Battle friends across fast-paced gamemodes, upgrade weapons, fight to grab the most points, and show off your style with fun character customization.

games.name: Cinderia
games.summary: "Cinderia" is a 2.5D action roguelite game that focuses on the possibilities of combat combinations. Combine their active and passive skills and relics to challenge formidable enemies ranging from the Black Knight to the Evil Mage.

games.name: Clay Puzzle
games.summary: "Clay Puzzle" is a falling-block puzzle game where you target and break apart falling blocks! As the blocks fall, aim and shoot away the unwanted parts to shape them into a better form! Get ready for a falling block puzzle game that puts your aim and judgment to the test!

games.name: Collapse Zone
games.summary: Survive the unstable Collapse Zones and crush your enemies! Loot, upgrade your character and abilities, and unleash your own unique brand of violent chaos! Find and enter the mutated Magic Zones—giant claw machines, colossal pinball tables, and more—to reap even greater rewards!

games.name: Colours of Courage
games.summary: The Colours of Courage is a story-driven adventure where players help Sky navigate challenges, support others, and grow emotional strengths. Through choices, fun mini games, and exploration, the game turns resilience, empathy, and mindset into an interactive journey.

games.name: Courier Bay
games.summary: Courier Bay is a cozy low-poly delivery sim where you play as Leo, a new driver at Bay Express, completing daily deliveries across a vibrant city.

games.name: Crystal Project
games.summary: Crystal Project is a non-linear JRPG where you are the maker of your own adventure. Explore the world while you find Crystals, unlock classes, learn abilities, and create a strategy capable of taking down the world's toughest bosses. Or just stick to exploring; it's up to you.

games.name: Cubin II
games.summary: Cubin II is a first-person puzzle-platformer game that re-immerses you in the LGA experience. Complete the story by solving these 50 new experiments to finally escape from this terrible place.

games.name: Cursed Deal
games.summary: Cursed Deal is a Co-Op horror game like nothing you've ever experienced before. The game focuses on a dark vampire cult and features a villain who becomes cursed by betraying his cult on the night of the ritual and turns into a dark creature. The player who made a deal with the devil to get rid of the curse, must hunt down cult members and curse them into his side. Meanwhile, the cultists must complete the ritual and gain vampire powers on this challenging night. But beware! When humans turn into vampires, the roles will change and the creature hunt will begin. You never know who will win in this game where teams and roles will change, where the hunter can be the prey and the prey can be the hunter. Hide in the dark, use your special powers, and survive. Most importantly, don't trust anyone. If your friend is cursed, he will turn into a creature and come after you.

games.name: DeadNot
games.summary: DeadNot is a first-person psychological horror game where you the terminals to navigate, scan points of interest, manage camera feeds, and piece together what went wrong at this site. But you are not alone. A hostile entity stalks you. Don't look at it for too long.

games.name: Dicey Hacker 1999
games.summary: Dicey Hacker 1999 is a cyberpunk roguelite driven by dice-based strategy. As a hacker in a post-1999 parallel world, gather resources, hack programs, manipulate probabilities via bizarre devices. Each dice rewrites reality's code, every roll destabilizes the digital abyss.

games.name: Distributrains
games.summary: A railroad simulation game with roguelike elements. Use resources wisely to expand your infrastructure and satisfy industries, contracts, citizens, and engines. Respond quickly to ever-changing circumstances, and don't get kicked out of your office.

games.name: Divide TCG
games.summary: Gather your party and build the ultimate deck in Divide TCG, a retro pixel-art card game inspired by classic tabletop RPGs. Draft powerful artifacts, craft winning strategies, and forge your legend starting with the Genesis set.

games.name: Do Not Disturb
games.summary: A short horror walking simulator where you traverse through the endless hallways of a strange hotel, searching for a way out.

games.name: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival
games.summary: Don't Freeze is a winter card survival game set in a winter wasteland. Explore, gather resources, craft, hunt, die, repeat. Something sinister lurks in the cold darkness. Will you make it out in time?

games.name: Endalor
games.summary: An immersive medieval dark fantasy survival game with RPG elements for 1-4 players. Set in a hand crafted open world. Explore, survive, build, craft, fight and conquer your way through the dark, brutal and mysterious lands.

games.name: Fate Architect
games.summary: Fate Architect is a roguelike deckbuilder where you build and modify symbols on a slot machine to earn points and shape your strategy. Each run offers new combinations, synergies, and challenges as you design the ultimate slot machine of fate.

games.name: Fishbowl
games.summary: Fishbowl is a slice of life, coming of age story told over a month. Video call loved ones, work from home, sort through puzzles to rediscover childhood memories, do care tasks and get to know yourself better, one day at a time.

games.name: Free Solo
games.summary: A physics based climbing game about attempting to climb a very tall mountain while managing the pump in your arms. Climb through handcrafted routes while learning the mechanics and picking yourself up after you fall.

games.name: Home Invader
games.summary: A first-person psychological stealth thriller set inside a private villa. Infiltrate, gather critical intel, steal what you can, and escape unnoticed where silence is your only protection & every sound you make could be your last.

games.name: Hozy
games.summary: Transform abandoned spaces into cozy havens in Hozy!

games.name: Inkling Cats: Beneath the dreams
games.summary: Inkling Cats is a colorful roguelike adventure where every game is a journey different from the previous one. Choose between 3 characters with very different playstyles and weapon crafting mechanics, and paint every enemy away until the end of the story!

games.name: Invisible Room
games.summary: Invisible Room is an audio-based puzzle game where players rely on sound and clues to uncover hidden truths. Without visuals, the game challenges your auditory perception and logical reasoning, using both audio cues and physical props to solve puzzles.

games.name: K.C. Climber
games.summary: K.C. wants to reach the summit and youve got to help her. Remember to climb safely and mind your stamina!

games.name: Keep on Mining!: Worlds
games.summary: Keep on Mining! - Worlds is an incremental mining game where you mine rocks, collect resources, and travel through many unique worlds, finding artifacts, crafting pickaxes, and purchasing many permanent upgrades!

games.name: Kinguin: Become a Streaming Legend
games.summary: Kinguin is a relaxing idle simulator about a penguin streamer. Leave the game in the corner of your screen while you work, upgrade your setup to turn views into valuable followers and subs, and climb the Global Rank. Dominate the algorithm and become the internet's greatest polar legend!

games.name: Komadori Inn
games.summary: Your boring life changed, when you started to work at the Komadori Inn. A picturesque forest by the sea and beautiful co-workers make the perfect place for relaxing.

games.name: Lakehopper
games.summary: Take flight in a seaplane flight simulator through a rugged world where you are responsible for the care and maintenance of your plane. Deliver cargo between far-flung communities in a flooded landscape that challenges your piloting skills! Fix your plane and keep flying!

games.name: Laserade: Sugar Rush
games.summary: Evade lasers and other hazards in this first-person action platformer while chugging as many Suga soft energy drinks as you can, boosting your speed while feeding your insatiable sugar addiction.

games.name: Late Ming Dynasty
games.summary: "Late Ming Dynasty" is a single-player horror exploration game. Traverse eerie backroom levels while searching for an exit to attempt escape.

games.name: Lihiman
games.summary: Lihiman is an anime-style story game about spending time with your family in the comfort of home. It is not about danger or fear but about the joy of simple moments that make life feel warm and safe. That is, until...

games.name: Lilac
games.summary: A fantasy visual novel adaptation of the stage play by Project Ricoro, about an interspecies academy story between mages and humans that depicts the “ordinary” within the “extraordinary.”

games.name: Lucent VR
games.summary: Relaxing meditation game with beautiful interactive environments. Collect items to unlock scenes.

games.name: Night Light
games.summary: A merge-game with pool-like physics with satisfying effects and cute creatures. Just click and drag to shoot the ball and try to line up multiple merges at once!

games.name: Nine Nights to Exposure
games.summary: Nine Nights to Exposure is a single-location horror game set in a remote lakeside cabin, focused on photography and anomaly reporting. Capture and report anomalies, uncover a family tragedy buried in the past… and try to survive all nine nights.

games.name: Operator Unknown
games.summary: IReCorp gave you access to memory. But whose memory is it — and where is the exit from someone else's dream?

games.name: PC Store Simulator
games.summary: Run your own PC Store! Repair broken computers, buy computer parts, sell products and upgrade your store!

games.name: Paragnosia: Museum
games.summary: Watch over the Duskheath Museum with a rail-mounted camera. Closed following a series of disturbing disappearances, your mission is to photograph the anomalies and exorcise the spirits that have taken possession of the premises. Can you survive the 8 rounds through these mysterious exhibition halls?

games.name: Project Lunky
games.summary: The player is unwillingly teleported into a lab where everything wants to kill you. Get coins, buy upgrades and find the key to escape. Warfstash is there, Lunky is everywhere, there's a vague reference to Damien somewhere.

games.name: Pump It Up Rise
games.summary: Pump It Up Rise brings the Pump It Up arcade experience at home. This is the first Pump It Up PC release since The PREX 3 in 2003.

games.name: Putt Down
games.summary: Putt down is a first person mini-golf horror game, where you use a shotgun as a putter. Keep your shotgun in good condition and your stress levels in check while battling both randomized golf courses and horrific monsters. Will you survive or will you be putt down.

games.name: Puzzle Spy International
games.summary: Pursue a ring of diamond thieves and their trail of cryptic puzzles in this ‘60s spy adventure. As Agent Epsilon you’ll choose your path as you chat with (or chat up!) suspicious contacts. Decode cryptograms, decipher clues and deduce answers as you solve wordplay & logic puzzles across the globe!

games.name: Quintillion Quest
games.summary: A fantasy-themed run-based active incremental game

games.name: RebreatheR
games.summary: Underwater, you're alone. Or almost alone. You're a diver doing routine work: cleaning the seabed, collecting waste, fixing pipes. But deep down there's always something wrong. Explore, repair, survive — and try not to lose your mind.

games.name: Ritual Static
games.summary: "Do you think a house can dream?" Ritual Static is a surreal first-person photography horror game following a young man in his childhood home the day before a big move. Surf the television, sink into static, and rot in the dark.

games.name: Rumbly
games.summary: Rumbly is a fast-paced turn-based roguelike battle game that focuses on speed and accuracy!!

games.name: Sacrificio
games.summary: An intense and fast-paced survival horror shooter in a dark fantasy world. Face overwhelming odds in a brutal struggle against evil.

games.name: Shit Slam II
games.summary: ShitSlam2 is a sandbox shooter. You can have epic battles with your friends, create funny skits, or just hang out and chill.

games.name: Sohee
games.summary: Please help Sohee find her happiness.

games.name: Solitaire Time Warp
games.summary: Play solitaire card games, time travel and explore 100's of challenging levels!

games.name: SpellCarved
games.summary: A casual wave-survival action game where you fight through enemies, loot chests, and build your loadout with upgrades and power-ups between rounds. With randomly generated maps and 20 power-ups to discover, every run plays out differently.

games.name: Stellar Tactics
games.summary:
A classic Sci-Fi RPG set in the harsh environment of deep space. Gather your team, equip your ship and explore the far reaches of deep space.

Bringing back the nostalgia, excitement and wonder of classic RPG's, Stellar Tactics will thrill you with a compelling narrative, deep strategic turn based ground combat system and rewarding open world space exploration. Build your team, equip your ship, explore the universe!

With 10,000 sectors, over 200,000 solar systems and millions of planets to discover, you can spend countless hours exploring, fighting, trading and building a party of seasoned veterans that can dominate the challenges of deep space.

To survive, you will need to build your team's skills through practice and equip your party and ships with the best weapons, armor and equipment you can find. Ward off raiders, pirates, mutants and opposing factions, among others, to defend your wealth and reputation.

games.name: The Darkest Files
games.summary: The Darkest Files is a historical investigation and courtroom game based on true crimes of the Nazi era. Investigate cold cases, search for clues, interrogate witnesses, immerse the crimes and defend your case in court to bring the perpetrators to justice.

games.name: The Deep Library
games.summary: A first-person exploration horror roguelite. Explore the depths of a seemingly endless library in search of rare books, but beware of the terrifying entities that protect it!

games.name: The End of the End of Evangelion
games.summary: A short experimental walking-sim with low participatory agency and obscure cinematic sequences that hint at the deterministic ending of The End of Evangelion.

games.name: The Fullness of the Air
games.summary: revisit your 500-year-old past

games.name: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths
games.summary: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths challenges you to transport huge variety of goods using your excellent driving skills, on South American wilderness. Contracts are getting more profitable as you get more reputation, each allowing you to improve your cash balance, upgrade or customize your truck. Take care, though, and watch the road, as accidents and involuntary pit stops cause more problems than simply making your clients mad. If you have no choice, just leave the cabin and make some temporary repairs, refuel frequently whenever possible.

games.name: Un Paseo Por Villa Tronco
games.summary: "Un Paseo Por Villa Tronco" is an spanish-only narrative experimental game in which you can hang out while listening A Tribe Called Quest and also to what the people living in the trunk have to say to you.

games.name: World Boss
games.summary: A new FPS from Fresh and LazarBeam. Take on 13 other players in fast-paced arena combat. Level up to unlock upgradeable weapons and perks. Customise your Gladiator with unique builds for every playstyle. Delete your enemies. Climb the leaderboard. Take on the world.

games.name: À La Mine
games.summary: À la Mine is a strategy game where dwarves compete to become owners... or end up exploited! Dominate territories by winning auctions or using dynamite to eliminate your rivals in this ruthless struggle.

games.name: 101 Cats in Rio de Janeiro
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Rio de Janeiro landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: 6-7 Nights At Vicente's
games.summary: 6-7 Nights at Vicente’s is a horror and strategy game in the style of Five Nights at Freddy’s. On Morcilla Island, Detective Rubevids investigates Vicente’s house, where he must keep watch, manage resources, and survive threats to uncover the truth before it’s too late.

games.name: A Recipe for Survival
games.summary: Use two decks of cards to serve food to your customers during the day! Then fight them off when they turn to monsters at night in this fun and unique deckbuilding roguelike!

games.name: A Ruthless World
games.summary: Embark on an adventure through a ruthless, 80s-inspired platformer world.

games.name: A Wild Heist
games.summary: A Wild Heist is a game where you and up to 3 friends rob banks as raccoons to pay off a gambling debt to the mob. The game includes fully destructible environments, online multiplayer, procedurally generated maps and more...

games.name: ABYA: Paint Ball
games.summary: ABYA: Paint Ball is a challenging 2D platform action-shooter game. The robot ABYA awakens from a dormant pod, following the guidance of AI, wielding a specialized water gun to explore the complex and hazardous underworld for resources, enhance equipment, and open the central elevator.

games.name: AFK Chess
games.summary: A PvP chess auto battler! Strategically build your army, use tactics to position your pieces and then watch them fight against your opponents! Can you assemble the strongest force?

games.name: Abashed
games.summary: Abashed is a 2.5D narrative-driven side-scrolling game that lets you explore the life of Issac, a man living with psychosis. One day waking up all alone, he sets out to find the truth behind his missing partner. On the way he finds himself needing to confront his deepest fears and the darkest secrets. Join Issac in this story of love, loss, fear, and acceptance. Reality is not what it seems.

games.name: Abyssal Trench
games.summary: Abyssal Trench is a first-person underwater horror game where you play as a lone explorer waking from cryo-sleep after a failed mission. With your pod out of fuel and your crew gone, a mysterious AI voice guides you to collect data from three abandoned drilling sites deep beneath the ocean.

games.name: Adventurers Guild Inc.
games.summary: Adventurers Guild Inc. is a turn-based management game where you run the business behind the heroics! Hire staff, post quests, and fulfill adventurers' needs (while taking a cut). Manage your budget, grow your reputation, watch adventurers scramble and build the greatest guild of all!

games.name: Aether & Iron
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.

games.name: Alliance Tales: Battle for the Frontier
games.summary: Alliance Tales is a linear, story-driven space combat sim inspired by 90s classics like Wing Commander and Tie Fighter. Take part in fast-paced space battles in a campaign takes you on the search for a missing friend while foiling a plot to take over the Frontier Colonies.

games.name: Ally Me or Vore
games.summary: You are the giant. Every choice matters. Devour, slay, or show mercy — but choose wisely. One wrong move could cost you everything. A survival simulation with moral consequences.

games.name: Alpha Ceti TD
games.summary: Classic Tower Defense meets space exploration. Build turrets on mining platforms, harvest enemies to build more defenses, and mine Dark Energy to travel the stars. As a sentient AI, you must upgrade your tech, scan planets, and find a new home for humanity before Earth fades away.

games.name: Amanita
games.summary: Amanita is an introspective journey into your mind where the path seems to be only one, and it does not seem to be easy. Let yourself be guided by surreal characters in your thoughts, clash with your memories with sword blows, wander in your memory, play cards with your fears.

games.name: Ammossum
games.summary: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, save your family, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

games.name: AnimalFruitTart
games.summary:
Simple controls—just jump! Play with one button in this physics-based, intuitive action game!
Bounce and roll through a candy world in the grand adventure of the “Animal Fruits”!

games.name: Apocalypse Factory
games.summary: Apocalypse Factory is an automation game with tower defense mechanics. You get production orders to fulfill while defending your production lines against zombies and gangs.

games.name: Arrow Bingo
games.summary: "Touch the arrow to slide the balls together, leading to One Away, then Bingo!" Touch the arrow to slide an entire line in its direction. You guide the balls to the matching color and pattern sheets and make them reach the goal, line them up to get Bingo, and sink them.

games.name: Asterogue
games.summary: A sci-fi roguelike where you descend 17 procedurally generated levels into a hollow asteroid. Battle aliens, collect futuristic weapons and nanotech, manage hunger and permadeath. Fast, minimal, turn-based combat inspired by the original Rogue.

games.name: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
games.summary: You’re no hero—you’re a subcontractor. Drop the bomb, dodge the blast, and hope the paperwork clears. 4-player physics chaos in a space platformer with no safety net.

games.name: Astro Combat
games.summary: This is an "Arcade-style Beat 'em Up" with "Real-time Tactics" and "Action RPG" elements. Choose to engage in a rampage or opt for stealth. After the main story, explore regions, collect items, battle foes, and develop your team.

games.name: Auto Chess Souls
games.summary: Auto Chess Souls is a casual strategy adventure game that combines auto-chess and roguelike elements. Through consecutive choices, your team grows increasingly stronger. Explore the unknown tower, collect powerful equipment, create unique powerful combinations. Embark on this exciting adventure now!

games.name: BB Adventure
games.summary: “BB Adventure” is an immersive action game where you ride a real balance ball and clear athletic stages. Using a controller with an accelerometer, your balance ball’s movements control the in-game character, making you feel as if you’re inside the game.

games.name: Back to Stables
games.summary:
Back to Stables is a cozy puzzle adventure where you guide the escaped horse, George, through a maze of obstacles. You lure George with apples, help him avoid scary forest creatures, and guide him safely to the trailer using as few apples as possible.

The game has a cozy, relaxed atmosphere, with stylized visuals. Throughout the levels, you can unlock customization options for George, from new skins to accessories like hats and bows.

games.name: Backframes: Escape Together
games.summary: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

games.name: Basement 66
games.summary: The dice roguelike. You’ve been locked in Basement 66 with the Demon. Roll the death dice. Destroy cursed cards. Remember, only one of you can leave this hell alive. Will you survive? Good luck…

games.name: Bayaya
games.summary: A relaxing fairy-tale life sim and story-rich adventure in a colorful wooden-toy world.

games.name: Beast Gang
games.summary: Place cards on a 5×5 board to complete hands in rows, columns, and diagonals in this fresh, casual puzzle game! Simple controls, deep strategy, and addictive combos await. Use items to turn the tide and push your score to the limit in endless mode!

games.name: Before the Silence
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

games.name: Bharat Police
games.summary: Lead a police force in noir India. Manage officers, respond to emergencies, and upgrade your team. Navigate crime, corruption, and deep-rooted social tensions. Every decision has consequences.

games.name: Birdoo
games.summary: Birdoo is an indie action game were you take control of a bird on his quest for revenge against the humans that mistreated him. For too long have you been called a flying rat and shooed away. It's time to take revenge!

games.name: Black Paradox Reloaded
games.summary: Experience chaos in this remastered, hyper-stylized roguelite. As bounty hunter Black Paradox, travel through space to defeat the Hellraisers – now with enhanced pixel art, rebalanced gameplay, new synthwave tracks, and an intense boss rush mode.

games.name: Blast Bebop
games.summary: Blast Bebop is an easy-to-pick-up action-incremental game, combining dodging, shooting, collecting, and upgrades, set to retro pixel visuals and psychedelic music for a short, relaxing combat experience.

games.name: Blaze of Empires
games.summary: Besiege colossal creatures and invoke the favor of the gods in this unique fusion of RTS and roguelike. Build your base, gather resources, and evolve your empire through a dynamic tech tree. Survive epic waves solo or in co-op.

games.name: Bleu Bayou
games.summary: A lonesome crawdad sets out to destroy the bayou’s vicious syndicate of loan sharks and robber barons—and erase his debts once and for all.

games.name: Blitloop
games.summary: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.

games.name: Blocklords
games.summary: Blocklords is a player-driven grand strategy game by MetaKing Studios. Rule, conquer, and grow with your medieval Hero.

games.name: Blood Facsimile
games.summary: An immersive FPS adventure set in a dark and surreal scifi world

games.name: Bloody Shrine
games.summary: Complete the ritual and defend the shrine in this top-down arena shooter roguelite. Unlock new demons, discover new weapons and choose the right spells and items. Create hell-breaking synergies that will unleash pain and suffering on all ghoulies, elites and bosses.

games.name: Bloom
games.summary:
Bloom is a new free casual puzzle about chain reactions and a puppy with a bizarre love for berries. Follow Arya and her dog Bo in an adventure set in vibrant locations and a cute story with witty characters across hundreds of mind-bending logic puzzles.
Done saving the world?

Enjoy an endless catalog of free levels created by players like you, or try the ultra-simple level maker to create your own level and share it with your friends! Show off your creativity and become the best creator in the world!

games.name: Bluegrass
games.summary:
A spatial audio ASMR-narrative rhythm life-sim. Laid off, Linda is seeking peace on the Appalachian Trail. Guide her pulse as she unveils her Granny’s old hand-drawn illustrations and makes new memories in this relaxing spatial audio journey to Mt. Katahdin.

Bluegrass is an experiential episodic interactive audio narrative through the soundscape of Appalachia. In a linear adventure to Mt. Katahdin, tune your ears into the relaxing audio cues. Allow yourself to be guided by Linda's inner Conscience as you keep the heart pace steady by regulating her breathwork. Influence Linda's behavior via feedback at critical moments in this interactive theatrical.

games.name: Bonemarrow
games.summary: Bonemarrow is a short action survival horror in which you play a mutant creature created in a lab, destined to be used as a test subject. When the facility you were created in falls into disarray, you finally have your opportunity to escape. You may just make it out alive.

games.name: Bosslife Office Manager
games.summary: Set up your own office. Expand your office as you wish. Transform from a small office to a large company.Don't forget to make your employees happy too.

games.name: Bouncemasters 2: Pengu Throw
games.summary: Bouncemasters 2: Pengu Throw is a sequel to the 300-million-downloads fun arcade hit and a successor of the legendary Yetisports! Grab your bat, line up the perfect swing and bounce your way around Levels Map. Chase glory while branching biomes packed with hazards, boosters and memes!

games.name: Breadskate
games.summary: BRDSKT (BREADSKATE) is a freeroam skating game but you play as bread and ducks with guns have invaded your world. Simply give your newly baken bread loafs some wheels and watch them go skating and exploring the world. Truly the miracle of life of bread!

games.name: Bubble Bobble: Sugar Dungeons
games.summary: Adventure again and again! Get stronger! The first step-up Bubble Bobble in the series! Go on an adventure through strange dungeons that change every time you step inside!

games.name: Bulgasari: Consume·Evolve·Survive
games.summary: Amidst the ruins of a crashed starship, you inject the mysterious ampoule BGS-01 and awaken an insatiable hunger for steel. Devour steel to evolve, and trade with the Space Stagecoach to secure vital supplies. Slaughter the swarms of alien monsters hunting you down and survive!

games.name: Bushcraft Survival
games.summary: Bushcraft Survival is an open-world, procedural survival game where you are pitted against the brutalities of nature. It features rogue-lite elements, with permanent skill tree progression. Use your tools and your knowledge to survive in Canada's unforgiving northern wilderness!

games.name: Bushi
games.summary: Wield your bow and sword against fierce opponents as you navigate obstacles with dynamic parkour in the samurai-themed arena brawler, Bushi! Inspired by the cult classic GunZ The Duel and The Legend of Son-Goku.

games.name: But Why Penguin?
games.summary: Nothing matters. You left your monotonous colony behind. Complete tasks, chase your dreams, walk across the ice while humans watch you, and uncover the secret that will be revealed in 2027. But why?

games.name: Cameraman: The Pilot Episode
games.summary: Cameraman: The Pilot Episode is a psychological horror game. Manipulate time and gravity to solve puzzles in ever-changing, twisted spaces. With only a VHS camcorder, uncover dark secrets, face unseen anomalies, and navigate an uncharted dimension where reality unravels.

games.name: Capsulitas
games.summary: A physics-based gacha meets inventory management roguelike. Insert a coin, organize your backpack, and sell for profit! Multiply items with hammers, upgrade your machine, and survive the inflation.

games.name: Casino Tycoon: Sin & Win
games.summary: Rise from a broke gambler to a casino kingpin in this high-stakes sim blending management, gambling, and adult content. Win big, indulge in luxury, go bankrupt, or start a gang war—every choice writes your destiny. In this city, you either rule the tables… or end up in a ditch.

games.name: Champions of Sparta
games.summary: Champions of Sparta is a brutal action RPG where elite Spartan warriors face deadly arena trials across ancient empires. Master melee, ranged, and magic combat to prove your worth and secure Sparta’s path to domination.

games.name: Chance
games.summary: The property-trading deckbuilder. Chance is strange, dusty board game where you steal land from the bourgeoisie, bankrupt the proletariat, break the rules with unfair chance cards, and discover strategies worthy of an antitrust lawsuit.

games.name: Chicks in Trouble
games.summary: A peaceful farm is thrown into chaos when a mother hen's chicks mysteriously vanish! Team up with the brave father rooster and embark on a quirky, obstacle-filled adventure to bring them home. Grab your mouse or gamepad—it's time to save the flock!

games.name: Choose Your Own Alternative
games.summary: A text-based adventure about exorcising your friend’s Inner Demon. Analyze objects filled with memories, uncover the reason for her possession, talk with her and figure out which object should be chosen for the sacrifice. Save your friend no matter the cost.

games.name: Clan Fantasy Adventures
games.summary: Clan fantasy adventures is a turn-based 2D RPG. Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman, through various adventures that will plunge him into the heart of a major conflict.

games.name: Cloudside Lane
games.summary: Cloudside Lane is a small casual building game. Immerse yourself in a tranquil and comfortable environment, build houses and create your own cozy streetscape. There are no scores or rules here, just follow your heart to create and feel.

games.name: Cloudspan
games.summary: In this bite-sized city builder, your goal is to stack and stretch your town as far as physics will allow. Tiny Island. Big mess.

games.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
games.summary: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens is a cozy, Suika-inspired, puzzle game where adorable, dessert-shaped cats fall from the clouds. Unlock power-ups, set up satisfying chains and combos, brave obstacles and cheeky weather twists. Play to relax or compete to leave your pawprint on our leaderboards.

games.name: Combotronica
games.summary: Discover hidden patterns. Build spectacular chains packed with combos. Collect powerful Amulets. Watch scores skyrocket in this brilliantly satisfying roguelike deck-builder where you balance logic and luck your way!

games.name: Concerto on White
games.summary: Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION! Concerto on White is a musician simulation game featuring classical music. Unlike any typical rhythm games, players are required to actually play the main melody. In the main story, you will experience adventurous campus life in the academy.

games.name: Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together
games.summary: Cooking Simulator is back – bigger, better, and with optional multiplayer! Create your own recipes and take advantage of new and improved controls to become the best restaurant cook in the city! Or just have fun and enjoy cooking at your own pace. You’re the chef here!

games.name: Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror
games.summary: Run a cozy little soup shop haunted by unsettling stories. In Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror, uncover hidden mysteries and unlock every secret recipe. Serve the right soup from the Super Soup 2000.

games.name: Corner Clash
games.summary: Idle auto‑battle game running quietly in your screen’s corner. Upgrade, unlock weapons, and face endless waves of stronger enemies.

games.name: Cosmic Galaxy Wars
games.summary: Enter the abyss of RPGs. There's nothing else like it—anywhere. That's a promise. At first you'll wonder, “What is this?” Keep going. You might recall a few familiar titles. And then it hits you: this is unlike any RPG you've ever played. The abyss of RPGs awaits.

games.name: Croakspire
games.summary: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

games.name: Crown of Greed
games.summary: Forget about direct orders you know from other games of the genre. Master an unusual, indirect management system in which you must skillfully bend your subjects and heroes to your will. Claim the throne of Rodovia, build cities, recruit troops, expand your kingdom and exploit the power of a coin.

games.name: Crusaders Quest: Hero Town
games.summary: Welcome to Crusader Quest: Hero Town! A little town inside your PC! Gather heroes and rebuild the town in Crusader Quest: Hero Town, a desktop idle RPG that can be enjoyed even during work hours.

games.name: Cry Pic.
games.summary: This is a 2D action shooting game that focuses on fighting large enemies (bosses).

games.name: Cubic Blitz
games.summary: Cubic Blitz is an isometric puzzle game where you control a cube and solve loads of hand-crafted levels. With the power of paint, sponges, and much more, your task is simple: PAINT THE WORLD.

games.name: Cucina Stellata: Starred Cuisine
games.summary:
Gastronomy meets horror in an unsettling narrative experience set in 19th-century Romagna, Italy.

Step into the shoes of a solitary writer and gourmet, inspired by the historical figure of Pellegrino Artusi, as a midnight snack spirals into the unexpected.

Cucina Stellata ✦ Starred Cuisine isn't your typical horror game: no frantic chases or cheap jump scares, but rather a thick atmosphere of tension, disturbing themes, and chilling twists that will linger in your mind long after the credits roll.

games.name: Cuzuco
games.summary: Challenge yourself and demonstrate your precise high-speed hand control to help our little armadillo get back home as fast as possible in this fair but unforgiving platformer game.

games.name: Cyber Siege
games.summary: Cyber Siege is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter with pure gameplay. Play solo or in local co-op up to 4 players. Upgrade your character and weapons as you fight 100+ enemy types across 20 levels in 4 distinct worlds.

games.name: D.A.D.S.
games.summary: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

games.name: Data Center
games.summary: Build, cable, and automate. Assemble racks, servers, and switches, connect enough capacity for each app, earn money from processed data, and unlock gear and bigger customers with XP and reputation. Follow colored data packets as your center comes to life.

games.name: DeGen Rivals
games.summary: The ultimate Kart-based Battle Royale. Smash your Rivals in free-to-play, 8-player online chaos across a variety of wild levels and arcade game modes.

games.name: Deadwood Drive
games.summary: Deadwood Drive - a low-poly adventure game with a dark twist. In the beautiful and secluded town of Deadwood, you will discover the tale of Thomas Sterling, the Luminex Factory, and the land's hidden powers. Are you just running a logging business, or is the town's destiny tied to you?

games.name: Dealmaster
games.summary: DealMaster is a board game where every property is won through auctions. Time your action cards, invest smartly in stocks, build or destroy houses, and strike trades. Master it all across 6 unique roles to outwit your rivals.

games.name: Death Flags
games.summary: Death Flags: The Beginning of the End is a rail shooter in VR packed with action and an epic story. Survive relentless waves of cursed pirates, upgrade your weapons with special ammo, and uncover the hidden secrets within this incredible shooter.

games.name: Decision Point
games.summary: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

games.name: Deckanism: Singularity Island
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder meets auto-battler where every fight is a puzzle. Build mechanisms, counter enemies and unleash your perfect combo!

games.name: Deco Online Origins
games.summary: Deco Online Origins is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG that put players deep into the fantastic story of two warring nations, "Millena" and "Rain".
