As a legendary swordsman, a fierce archer, or a master of wizardry, players were constantly challenged by the opposing nation and by monsters that lurked around every corner. Notable features included a combo system with hundreds of potential skills, and guardian pets that buffed entire guilds.

games.name: Deeper You Go
games.summary: You control a camera that goes down into a deep hole. More horrors you'll face, the deeper you go.

games.name: Defense Collapse
games.summary: Defense Collapse is a strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer the unexplored dark forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the massive hordes of enemies. How long can you survive?

games.name: Deflectorium
games.summary: Deflectorium: 2D sci-fi rogue-lite singleplayer. Deflect deadly shots back at your enemies to become unstoppable. With unique deflection system, you'll dominate battles while upgrading your skills and stats. Prepare for adrenaline experience where defense isn't just a tactic but an art.

games.name: Deliverance Protocol: Ironrot
games.summary: Atmospheric first-person retro horror. You are a courier — a disposable tool of the System. Sort, deliver, collect archives. Obey… or uncover what lies inside.

games.name: Derealization
games.summary: A visual novel about a girl who escaped from a psychiatric hospital. She is pursued by a strange being from another world — and it seems she’s not the only one who can see visitors from beyond.

games.name: Desserted
games.summary: Hello, Friend, welcome to Desserted. Together we'll answer the Universe's most important question: "What's for dinner?" 6-player co-op survival adventure; Eat, stealth, fight, sacrifice; Explore lost planets within time limits; Survive. Get stronger. Explore worlds

games.name: Dice Roller Incremental
games.summary: Roll your dice, upgrade them, buy more dice! Dice Roller Incremental is a game where each dice roll earns you money, which you then spend on improving your dice rolls.

games.name: Dino Tales
games.summary:
Dino Tales is a colourful adventure game where players explore a world of dinosaurs and interactive stories.

Create your own story from your adventures, discover prehistoric creatures, and unlock new tales as you explore exciting environments filled with puzzles, characters, and surprises.

Perfect for younger players and families, Dino Tales combines exploration, storytelling, and playful discovery in a friendly prehistoric world.

games.name: Divine Sin
games.summary: A deck-building roguelike with innovative card mechanics, blending strategy with unpredictability. In a decaying dark fantasy world, you are a resurrected Apostle—sworn to hunt the gods.

games.name: Dofbox
games.summary: 5 byte-sized games for a cheap price! Kill Frogs, fish the fish, take care of your virtual pet, invest, and fall to your death! All this in dofhouse's dofbox Collection!

games.name: Doomclock
games.summary: Doomclock is a roguelite, top-down arena shooter with deckbuilding elements. Bathe in blood of the damned, unlock new cards, and craft your deck of heavenly and hellish powers to survive the apocalypse. Be quick or be dead — there’s no time to rest.

games.name: Dragon Gate: Tournament
games.summary: Compete in short, deadly sprints full of power-ups, dangers and fierce rivalries where only speed and skill mean survival. Are you ready to take the crown?

games.name: Dragon Survival
games.summary: Stranded on a mysterious island with a baby dragon, survive and grow stronger. Gather resources, build your base, and overcome trials left behind by ancient explorers. An open-world survival RPG blending exploration, crafting, combat, and dragon growth.

games.name: Dreadcore: Locked Unit
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and environmental storytelling. Discover the tragic story of Unit 199, where a fragmented consciousness still haunts the place.

games.name: Dreaminal
games.summary: Dreaminal is a 1-4 players surreal backrooms experience. Traverse through immersive and unique backrooms levels, experience anomalies, interact and solve puzzles while hiding from unknown entities in order to escape from the mysterious world of The Backrooms .

games.name: Dress the Duel
games.summary: "Dress the Duel," is a roguelike deckbuilding game where your cards are your wardrobe and your outfit is your arsenal!Build a versatile wardrobe, disrobe strategically, layer outfits for powerful effects, and Dress the Duel!

games.name: Dungeon Directive
games.summary: You’ve taken over the guild hall in the center of town near a mysterious dungeon portal. With a small roster of heroes and limited resources, it’s your job to rebuild the guild, send parties into the depths, and shape a legacy that lasts for generations. What future will your choices create?

games.name: Dungeon Forge
games.summary: You are a blacksmith, not a hero. Create weapons with countless unique combinations, exploit monsters’ weaknesses, and supply heroes with what will determine their fate.

games.name: Dungeon Sucker
games.summary: Dungeon Sucker is a 2D roguelite shooter. For the upcoming dungeon inspection, the Demon left for her summer vacation and entrusted the cleaning to an agency. Armed with the “Mighty Vacuum,” you can absorb anything that stands in your way. Clean up the chaotic dungeon—if you can!

games.name: Dwarf Legacy
games.summary: A challenging bullet-hell precision platformer. Climb up vertical dungeons of The Mountainhome, battling relentless swarms of enemies and navigating perilous traps. Uncover the secret of your lost legacy hidden atop the highest peak and secure the future of your village.

games.name: Eagle Knight Paradox
games.summary: Eagle knight paradox takes you (the player) into a doble experience, one of them is the role of a powerful mecha trying to protect a space city from space fanatics. On the other hand, the game sets you as the role of Ian (the pilot) building relationships around the city or whats left of it.

games.name: Eagle Legacy: Zero
games.summary: Explore a cursed realm locked in mist and blood. Solve ancient puzzles, cast forbidden spells, and survive the Witch’s trial in this dark third-person adventure set at the edge of myth and memory.

games.name: Echoes of the Hive
games.summary: Team up with friends in this 2D fantasy sandbox adventure! Explore mysterious worlds, craft powerful gear, battle monsters, and delve deep underground to uncover secrets and challenge epic bosses.

games.name: Edge Of Dread
games.summary: A simple job at the mayor’s mansion turns deadly. Plan an escape attempt through shifting puzzles and locked corridors. Collect tools, create distractions and hide from the relentless monster. Uncover the truth and find one of multiple exits before a mistake foils your plan.

games.name: EpiDexa Racing
games.summary: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

games.name: Epsylon
games.summary: A private eye mystery game where you decide how to solve the case. Use your detective skills to solve the case or rely on the abilities of your little dragon partner to see things from a new angle.

games.name: Escape From Ruin: Greymart Simulator
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic loot-fight-extract survival game with escape-style raids by day and black-market shop management by night. Fans of Tarkov-like gameplay — and players who love running management sims — will feel right at home.

games.name: Everbrew
games.summary: Farm, cook, and design your very own woodland café in Everbrew, a cozy pixel-art management game. Harvest ingredients, craft delicious meals, and welcome woodland creatures as they gather to relax, eat, and feel at home.

games.name: Exone Rift
games.summary: Take direct control of your hero on a hostile planet. Build your base, gather resources, expand your territory your way, and survive against the planet’s deadly wildlife.

games.name: Experiment 404
games.summary: Room 404 repeats. Identify anomalies, file reports, and stay alive—some anomalies might hurt you. Nurture the plants, listen to the overlord, end the loop, and unlock multiple unique endings.

games.name: Eye of the Erime
games.summary: Eye of the Erime is a first-person puzzle game where you use a camera to take photos of flowers to manipulate objects temporally and spatially. Traverse a unique underground settlement, solve puzzles, find a way to save your mother, and escape the caves.

games.name: Falling Thingies
games.summary: Gameplay you simply won't be able to put down! The thingies keep fallin' and the thangies keep callin'. Uncover limitless difficulty scaling and tons of variety!

games.name: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes
games.summary: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes is a turn-based tactical strategy game. You lead a team of mercenaries from different races, each with unique skills. Explore a randomly generated fantasy world, recruit defeated enemies, capture pets, challenge demon lords, or conquer the world step by step.

games.name: Farmch Revolution
games.summary: A piglet kidnapped by a vile butcher. Dive into a gory field of vengeance, rescue the piglet, and bring it home!

games.name: Faust Duel
games.summary: FAUST DUEL is a Blackjack-driven roguelike deck-builder. Play as Dr. Faust, who lost his wager and now joins Hell’s games. Within a limited number of rounds, earn enough chips to buy back your soul from its master.

games.name: Fearmates
games.summary: Fearmates is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror game. As a group of friends, you explore locations with paranormal activity and uncover the truth behind the events using your own equipment.

games.name: Feed the Demon Incremental
games.summary: Unleash carnage in this dark incremental clicker. Sacrifice humans to fuel your demonic evolution and explode your wealth.

games.name: Festered
games.summary: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

games.name: Feudal Craft
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an exciting medieval settlement simulator where you will have to fight for your place in the feudal hierarchy. Use a smart strategy to develop your settlement. After all, it is the skills and equipment of each peasant that can make the difference.

games.name: Firewheels Shop Simulator
games.summary: Firewheels Shop Simulator lets you manage a diecast model store. Organize shelves, assist customers, and expand your shop in a detailed, realistic world. Hunt for rare and chase cars, trade with customers, and grow your diecast empire

games.name: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
games.summary: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring 26 fishing spots and over 200 fish species. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

games.name: Five Heads
games.summary: Five prisoners each have a visible-to-others card on their forehead. Across three rounds, they logically deduce and rank their cards from lowest to highest. On the final round, each guesses their exact card, using every prior guess as a clue. A single mistake can doom them—can you solve it?

games.name: Flesh Everest
games.summary: Explore a randomized facility built within a massive living mountain of flesh. Flesh Everest mixes a rogue-like survival experience with shooting mechanics inspired by Silent Hill and Resident Evil. Death is permanent and ammo is limited.

games.name: Floatineer
games.summary: The game is set in a world where lands have vanished beneath the waves. Players experience life as floating engineers, using modular architectural blocks to rebuild shelters that can withstand various disasters and fulfill villagers' aesthetic requirements within a given time limit.

games.name: Flowereverie
games.summary: Flowereverie is a peaceful flower-laden puzzle game where, to perform any action you must first spell it, by arranging letters like flowers in a vase. Cast spells, spell spells, become the land's most prolific flower arranger, and you might be able to discover the dark secrets of the town proper.

games.name: Food Industry
games.summary: A city building game, focus on construction, management and strategy economic of the agri-food industry. Build, develop and manage the different sectors of this industry.

games.name: Forage & Brew
games.summary: Forage & Brew is a game where you play as a Cat witch in her potion workshop. Explore the forest, gather ingredients and brew magical potions in order to help the many clients that will come for your aid. How will you decide to live it out each passing day?

games.name: Forgotten: Whispers From Ashes
games.summary: A curse lurks in the fog in this psychological and investigative horror game. Use a strange lantern to uncover the truth and solve the mystery of Centreville and its ghostly inhabitants. Will you break the curse… before it drives you insane?

games.name: Forsaker: ​Innocent Paws
games.summary: To find the noble's cat, you've come to the calamity-filled Witch's Forest—eerie and trap-ridden. As Divine Knight Feyz, evade dangers, befriend companions, and interact with the forest's "little cats" to solve mysteries and complete your mission!

games.name: Fortune Wheel
games.summary: Fortune Wheel is a stylish rogue-lite "Wheel-Builder" game. You'll spin the wheel, add cards, and trigger chain synergies to pay the ever-increasing rent. Your fate is spinning... Can you pay the rent?

games.name: Fractals
games.summary: Fractals is a two-player co-op puzzle platformer where players complete puzzles and challenges using innovative mechanics. Work together to solve physics-based puzzles and go through platforming challenges.

games.name: Fractured Mind
games.summary: This is a PT inspired psychological horror game, with a bodycam style.

games.name: FreedomBot
games.summary: Turn-based roguelike where you play as a rogue bot surviving in procedurally generated cities. Features sophisticated character development and in depth combat using a detailed anatomical damage system .

games.name: From the Age of Dinosaurs to the Edo Period: Tokio no Meiro - By Gentaro Kagawa
Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare
games.summary: A tactical survival and outpost management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

games.name: Fruit Box Idle
games.summary: Fruit in a box. Incremental fun. Setup your pegs and unlock new fruit on your way to maximum points.

games.name: Fuel Me Up
games.summary: Fuel Me Up is a shoot ’em up roguelike game. Your ship’s fuel tank is leaking, and you must eliminate the aliens that have invaded planet Vorthex. Earn money by defeating enemy ships, buy upgrades and add-ons, unlock new ships and pilots, and try to get farther each run.

games.name: Galactic Space Guard
games.summary: Galactic Space Guard is a turn-based tactics game. Lead your squad of elite soldiers against feral alien beasts and defend humanity’s space stations. Upgrade your squad, prepare for battle, and restore peace to the galaxy!

games.name: Game
games.summary: A journey through the life of a champion player of a cryptic and bizarre sport. The dialogue choices you make will determine the path your life takes, and the ultimate conclusion to your story.

games.name: GameShop Simulator
games.summary: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

games.name: Gazar
games.summary: GAZAR is an intense vertical arcade space shooter where you fight against an alien fleet destroying the galaxy. Battle through Story Mode or test your skills in Infinity Mode with 5 difficulty levels and leaderboards. GAZAR delivers non-stop action, stunning visual effects, and dynamic combat.

games.name: Gemmy's Adventure
games.summary: Simple but not easy! Gemmy's Adventure is a casual action game. All you need to do is move a mouse to reach the finish line without touching any traps, objects and walls. Levels get harder, requiring strategy to pass.

games.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.summary: Expect blasts of green zombie goo painting the screen in this top-down shooter packed with crazy guns that blow the heads off some… freaky zombies. Your mission is simple: graffiti the whole city before these mutants dog-pile you.

games.name: Ghouls & Guardians
games.summary: Ghouls & Guardians is a tower defense and strategy game with roguelite elements. Build and manage your defenses, gather resources, and fend off relentless night creatures. Each playthrough encourages creative tactics and offers a fresh, challenging experience.

games.name: Give Me Back!
games.summary: 《Give Me Back!》 is a barrage avoidance adventure game. It will take you into a fantasy world. During the adventure, you only need to avoid snowflakes, cross the waves, and overcome many difficulties to survive until the end. Here, reaction speed and calm judgment are the only rules of survival!

games.name: Go Home Annie: An SCP Game
games.summary: A twisted first person horror adventure. As an employee of the SCP Replication Division you are tasked with testing artificially developed paranormal events. Solve puzzles, converse with anomalous entities and explore multiple paths to untangle the secrets behind the Replication Division.

games.name: Go-Kart Simulator
games.summary: Build Your Go-Kart Empire! Start with a small business, expand your fleet, upgrade your track, and secure big sponsorship deals to boost your profits. Host tournaments, grow your brand, and become a racing legend. Take the wheel and push your limits on the track!

games.name: Gobocore: Goblin Rescue Squad
games.summary: Party Building Turn Based Auto-Battler about little goblins rescuing their kidnapped tribe members. Smash. Evolve. Survive.

games.name: Good Things Vol 1
games.summary: Good Things Vol 1 is a collection of 15 wildly imaginative, weird little games ranging from evolving platformers to genre-bending adventure... but the Blue Elephant ate all the games, and if you do not help him he will DIE :(

games.name: Gravebound
games.summary: Gravebound is a post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in a world where crumbling cities and ancient magic collide. Fight, loot, and survive against deadly creatures and rival players as you explore the Shatterlands.

games.name: Gravity Cab
games.summary: Gravity Cab is a multi-platform 3D action-adventure-puzzler in which players take on the role of a flying taxi driver, transporting passengers and navigating challenging environments influenced by physics.

games.name: Grex
games.summary: Play as a Swarm in GREX, a fast-paced incremental auto-shooter. Our body is our weapon. We die to evolve. We evolve to become The Monolith. WE ARE ONE. WE INVADE. THEY DIE.

games.name: Grid Tycoon
games.summary: Build your racing empire from the ground up. Influenced by Andatura, the first game developed by Red Shade Games, Grid Tycoon lets you manage teams, develop cutting-edge vehicles, hire talented drivers, and compete in championships around the world.

games.name: Grime II
games.summary: Become the stealer of forms in GRIME II, a surreal action-adventure metroidvania. launch tendrils made of hands to absorb foes and summon molds in their shape, as you explore a bizarre lived-in-world obsessed with art.

games.name: Grow a Girlfriend
games.summary: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or… don't ;)

games.name: Gun of Fate: The Silver Gun of Ylia
games.summary: A shooting adventure RPG game, where you play as a gunslinger in Westland. The main combat system of the game is gun shooting. You can complete quest and side missions, unlock items and equipment, and also play fishing and horse racing mini games.

games.name: Handgun Football
games.summary: Handgun Football shatters physics: FPS meets soccer brawl. Revolvers, shotguns blast the ball into rival goals. Solo vs AI, slide from chill to hell; .LAN or global 2,3,4-teams,up to 12 players. Classic gravity or zero-g space variants. One shot flips the match.

games.name: Hangar 51: Classified Investigation
games.summary: A first-person investigation and detective game. Explore a sealed 1980s bunker, solve puzzles, collect evidence, take photos, and piece together what really happened. Your final report determines the outcome. Follow the protocol. Question everything.

games.name: Hello Space
games.summary: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

games.name: Hero Link
games.summary: Recruit heroes and build your formation! Harness the unique "Master-Follower Link" system to craft action sequences and coordinate targets, unleashing synergies where 1 + 1 >> 2. Every link is a tactical choice, every formation has its own unique growth path!

games.name: Heroes and Forsaken: The Official Wheel of Time Digital Card Game
games.summary: Heroes and Forsaken is the official Wheel of Time digital card game. Build decks under Leader identities, choose Light or Shadow, and face rivals in fast, tactical matches across the world of The Wheel of Time. Command legendary characters and spells, outplay your opponent, and shape the fate of the Age.

games.name: Hextalia
games.summary: Hextalia is a strategic tower defense where you craft powerful items and attach them to your towers. Shape enemy paths with walls, craft the desired items, defend corrupted crystals, and unlock new powers as you grow your collection. Build, defend, and adapt.

games.name: High Elo Girls
games.summary: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

games.name: Highreach
games.summary: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.

games.name: Highway Noir
games.summary: You are an underground driver for hire, fired from the Major Crimes Agency. Rush through a busy city at night as you take on high speed getaways, dangerous street races, white knuckle pursuits and more. Don't stop until you reveal the truth about who wanted you gone

games.name: Hilarious Delivery
games.summary: Take orders, fire up the stoves! Hilarious Delivery is a single-player and co-op restaurant sim where you run a frantic takeout shop against the clock. Cook dishes, then pull off the perfect handoff to your delivery rider.

games.name: Homura: The Crimson Warriors
games.summary: A port of the original PS Vita game, in English for the first time.

games.name: Hookah Simulator
games.summary: Start with a small cozy hookah lounge and turn it into the most popular spot in the city! Your goal is to craft perfect hookahs, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

games.name: Hoshiomio
games.summary: Watch the starry sky and ward off looming threats in this fast-paced base defense game. Genre-defying destruction.

games.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels
games.summary: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

games.name: How Many Secrets Under Ceiling
games.summary: The first light novel-style immersive detective game's here! A dentist dead in a double-locked room seems like a suicide, but unexplained contradictions connect different truths. Each investigation and puzzles are up to you. But wait, what's wrong with this suspicious "assistant" following?!

games.name: Hunt the Night
games.summary: Plunge into a retro-style action-adventure game that combines a fast, skilled gameplay with dark fantasy and lore. Play as Vesper, a virtuous member of 'The Stalkers,' and explore the vast world of Medhram, filled with ruins and horrors.

games.name: Hyperquiz
games.summary: Fast-paced, high quality, challenging trivia. Play your friends or compete against the world.

games.name: Hyphae
games.summary: A rogue like tower defense. How far will you stretch your network? And can you fend of ancient powers? Defend your core on this alien planet, and uncover all ancient artifacts!

games.name: I Want to Wear Your Wool
games.summary: As spring arrives, Fable the wolf wants to turn over a new leaf and make friends with the other animals in the glade. Along the way, they meet a sheep who is a little too eager to be eaten.

games.name: Iconic
games.summary: Battle an army of merciless monster icons in this lane-based horde survival roguelite frenzy and put an end to their evil endeavors. By clicking.

games.name: Impact Trial: Hyperchaos
games.summary: Face endless waves and survive the chaos! Impact Trial: Hyperchaos is a casual spaceship bullet hell with adaptive difficulty, where your reflexes and decisions make the difference against hundreds of relentless enemies. Push your limits and climb the global leaderboards.

games.name: Indian Mechanic Simulator
games.summary: Fix punctures, repair engines, wash, paint, and restore scooters, cars, and more in Indian Mechanic Simulator. Experience authentic street-side repairs and become the most trusted mechanic in town!

games.name: Inferno Pathways
games.summary: Descend into the abandoned metro in Inferno Pathways, a first-person psychological horror game. Navigate dark tunnels, solve puzzles, and uncover sinister secrets. Confront your deepest fears and piece together the haunting story of Mike Collins. Can you escape the darkness?

games.name: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
games.summary: Infinitum is a horror open-world survival co-op story game that can be played with up to 4 players. Adventure through the endless procedurally generated levels and discover the multiple endings of the game, every playthrough being different than the last.

games.name: Intergalactic Juice Bar
games.summary: Slice fruits with a physics-based knife on a rope. Upgrade your factory to slice fruit into smaller pieces. Buy advanced slicing technology. Maximize profits and quench thirst across the universe!

games.name: Intervoid
games.summary: INTERVOID is a tense co-op horror game with resource management elements. Delve into the dark depths of an abandoned subway, avoid dangerous anomalies, out-of-control trains, and manage your oxygen supply. Reach the heart of this oppressive place.

games.name: Interwoven
games.summary: Welcome to Interwoven - a compact, but dynamic adventure inspired by traditional turn-based JRPGs! Follow an unlikely trio on their journey up to defeat the Obsidian Drake atop Anvite Mountain. Use the unique Augment Battle System to create all sorts of interesting strategies.

games.name: Iron Convoy
games.summary: Iron Convoy is a turn-based tactical survival game set in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. Manage your convoy, battle enemies, gather resources, and make tough decisions to survive. In this unforgiving world, only the strongest endure!

games.name: Iron Dice
games.summary: The empire has fallen. Will you reunite its factions or forge your own path? Iron Dice is an open-ended grand strategy game set in a fictional, early medieval world. Outmaneuver and outwit your neighboring kingdoms as you develop your economy, research new technologies, and conquer territory.

games.name: Iterum
games.summary:
Engage in tile-based tactical real-time combat, where every maneuver and flanking action can turn the tide of battle. Position your units carefully to outsmart your opponents and secure victory on the field.

Oversee the survival and prosperity of your city through deep seasonal yield management. Store grain for the winter, adapt to unpredictable hazards, and balance rations, taxes, and happiness to keep your people thriving. High taxes and generous rations can both shape your city's fate, just like in classic survival city-builders.

Build and fortify settlements at key locations, exploit and refine resources, and maintain vital supply lines to support your armies on campaign. Every decision matters as you expand your influence and defend your realm.

Unleash your creativity with a custom script-based map editor. Design your own scenarios, craft unique challenges, or relive historical campaigns from the age of the Roman Empire. Shape the world and the stories you want to play.

games.name: Jargon
games.summary: A word-puzzle roguelite where classic word games meet wild, rule-breaking builds.

games.name: Jumpers' Mountain
games.summary: Join our little friends on this adventure, jumping between platforms to uncover the paths of 'Jumper's Mountain'. However, beware, as there are many secrets to reach the top, and a miscalculated jump can be quite costly.

games.name: Jungle Jinx
games.summary: Set up camp deep in the jungle and begin your adventure! Explore lost ruins, collect artifacts, upgrade your gear, and grow your expedition. In Jungle Jinx, choose your path: dodge deadly traps, fight enemies, or race through the jungle on wild karts!

games.name: Just a Simple Turn-based RPG
games.summary: A short and straightforward turn-based RPG where every action matters. Explore, cast spells through quirky enchantments, help the townsfolk, and hunt for treasure, without endless grinding or overcomplicated stories.

games.name: Kintsugi
games.summary: Accompany Kyō, a young apothecary, on his journey to repair a world shattered by mankind and uncover the origin of his newfound golden powers.

games.name: Kkokko Industry
games.summary: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

games.name: KnockedDown
games.summary: Race as a cop, take down criminals in this thrilling low-poly game. Fast action, challenging obstacles. Join the chase!

games.name: Kosmosis
games.summary: Two xenobiologists find themselves stranded on a mysterious planet that appears intent on their anihilation.

games.name: Last Gasp
games.summary:
Whatever you do, do not give up.

Create a party on the fly and engage in Turn-Based JRPG Combat. Awakening in the world of Limbo, the Wanderer must take hold of their inspirations to escape. Limbo constantly changes and ideas will flow. You will have to work with what you're given and improvise your strategy.

games.name: Last Man Sitting
games.summary: A bunch of dudes sit in an office, all of them wearing black suits and white collared shirts. Everyone sits in the same lime green swivel chairs. For a video game, Last Man Sitting sounds really boring. Add shotguns and ragdoll physics, though, and you have a recipe for the only battle royale game left to make.

games.name: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons
games.summary:
Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons is an action-adventure game inspired by the true story of the 1900-1902 polar expedition. It tells the story of brave explorers who decide to prove the legend of the phantom island in the Arctic Ocean.

Switch between characters, use your grappling hook to explore a phantom island, home to mammoths. Face threats from hunters and choose to play stealthily or confront the dangers head-on. Inspired by real events.

games.name: Lavender Station
games.summary: Care for Lavender Station, a small rural train platform in this cozy train station sim. Welcome passengers, meet their needs, and shape the station’s atmosphere. Decorate and customize your platform, improve its reputation, and create a calm, charming stop for every traveler.

games.name: Lecture Me Later
games.summary: Just having a pleasant chat with one of the most popular guys in the University. Nothing weird about that, right? So why is he kinda... different than you've imagined?

games.name: Legacy of Kain: Ascendance
games.summary: Enter the dark world of Nosgoth – Ascendance is a fast paced, 2D action platformer built around fluid combat, vertical movement, vampiric powers, and skill-driven play.

games.name: Legend of Asha
games.summary: Enter the Kingdom of Ngoma in the Legend of Asha, a Top-Down adventure set in a unique and vibrant Afro-Fantasy setting. Explore unique and beautiful landscapes, use and upgrade powerful elemental abilities, fight off enemies and defeat Thonarka the Ravager to restore balance to the land.

games.name: Legends of the Round Table
games.summary: Lead the Knights of the Round Table through King Arthur's legend in a unique RPG, full of honor, magic and romance. Plunge into a colorful world inspired by medieval art, tales and music. Undertake perilous quests and fiercely defend your kingdom to make the flower of chivalry blossom again.

games.name: Life of Crime
games.summary: Immersive crime sim. Go from nothing to kingpin of the city — from small crimes to big heists. Complete jobs and distribute drugs throughout the city for your gang. Progress and earn respect through missions and crimes.

games.name: Life of Delivery
games.summary: Open-world delivery simulator where you bring orders to customers, upgrade vehicles, and encounter slice-of-life events. Meet people, help them, and enjoy unexpected conversations and opportunities on your journey.

games.name: Lift Up
games.summary:
Lift Up is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to regulate the speed of the platform with the main character and to make sure that the main character avoids the walls on the sides. Hold a button to go up faster. The main character is constantly moving to one of the sides and can turn by collecting arrows indicating the direction on the way. All the arrows always point in one direction and they flip every time the main character picks up an arrow. The main character can also collect coins to score points.

The game is over when the main character hits a wall.

games.name: Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland
games.summary: Explore a dream world as Little Nemo, armed with toys, candy, and stuffed animals in this colorful platforming metroidvania adventure.

games.name: Lone City
games.summary: Lone City is a first-person open-world survival shooter. The world is gone—only you, a dog, and a sleek car remain. No missions, no hope. Just ruins, silence, and a flicker of life refusing to die.

games.name: Lootale Slash
games.summary: Lootale Slash is a browser-based roguelite game with hack and slash elements (and ARPG elements coming soon), featuring pixel art graphics. In the game, the player faces hordes of monsters while collecting chests with powerful rewards to build the best possible item combination (build) and eliminate as many enemies as possible.

games.name: Lord of Ogre
games.summary: Lord of Ogre is a turn-based strategy game with action combat, where players manage their own attacks and defenses. It also features RPG, board game, and strategy elements for a unique victory quest.

games.name: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Autumn
games.summary: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Autumn is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Autumn-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a beautiful world.

games.name: Ludaro
games.summary:
Ludaro is a Roguelike Deck-building dice game with a unique twist on Ludo!

Plan your moves, manipulate dice rolls, and unleash powerful Spirit Cards to beat the score. Upgrade tiles, collect quirky pets and stack wild combos as you battle in epic boss fights with game-changing modifiers.

games.name: Luminescence
games.summary: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

games.name: Lustra: Lachea’s Tale
games.summary:
LUSTRA: Lachea’s Tale is a story-rich RPG that combines real-time spellcasting, exploration, and settlement building, set in a fractured floating island realm where ancient magic and mystery intertwine.

Play as Lachea, a young mage shaped by the world around her, learning to lead, grow, and take control of her path in a land suspended between ruin and renewal.

Lustra invites players to see the world through multiple perspectives, to reflect on morality, empathy, and responsibility, and to shape not just the outcome of a magical world, but the kind of person Lachea becomes along the way.

games.name: Lux Leonarii: A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
games.summary: A puzzle game revolving around guiding beams of light throughout an ancient structure using a multitude of mirrors and devices, ranging from simple A to B connection to multiple colours and complex interactions.

games.name: Mage Blast
games.summary: Forge arcane might in this semi-idle deckbuilder! Craft spells layer by layer—turn a simple fireball into a barrage of flaming meteors. Build a deck of modifiers to trigger explosive combos, explore ancient realms for rare resources, and stitch together magic unlike anything the world has seen.

games.name: Magician Impossible
games.summary: A first-person, spell-casting, adventure about a second rate, self taught magician who's on an impossible mission. Draw shapes with your wand to cast spells, solve puzzles, swing over chasms, and steal anything that isn't nailed down!

games.name: Mailbound
games.summary: The dead linger in the CRT glow, their wails rippling through the screen like disembodied echoes. And now… you’re drifting with them...

games.name: MechShell
games.summary: Defend the Overgrown Realms as S.H.E.L.L., a weaponized snail! Customize your shell, unlock wild abilities, and team up with friends in chaotic multiplayer mayhem across lush, trap-filled biomes. Every battle is a fast-paced, action-packed adventure!

games.name: Mega Drill: World Domination
games.summary: Run your mining empire to success and become the richest person in the world! Mega Drill is an action, management, upgrade game with a digging theme. Procedurally generated islands make every run different!

games.name: Memento Dawn
games.summary: A colorful puzzle game that follows a lost child on a journey to search for her memories and helps her through the darkness by controlling light and shadow.

games.name: Mini Shopkeeper
games.summary: Run your cozy little shop from the bottom of your screen, decorate to attract unique customers, hire assistants, and send adventurers for rare treasures - all in a lively, charming management sim!

games.name: Money Simulator
games.summary: Become a mogul in this thrilling simulation game! Buy, sell, and customize cars, trade in cryptocurrencies, and expand your empire with your very own shop. Take risks, make deals, and watch your business flourish in this dynamic world.

games.name: Montaro 2
games.summary: Montaro, master of stealth, sneakily infiltrating a convenience store with nobody being none the wiser. A stealth puzzle game where you manipulate objects and NPCs to complete objectives, "stealing pantsu".

games.name: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
games.summary: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

games.name: Mutiny
games.summary: Build your deck and reclaim your captain's throne in this short roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: My Little Coffee Shop
games.summary: Open the doors of your own coffee shop and immerse yourself in the world of fragrant coffee! In My Little Coffee Shop, you will have to: prepare different types of coffee and desserts; serve customers and fulfill their orders; decorate and improve the interior of your coffee shop; expand your business and discover new opportunities. Create the most cozy place in the city where everyone will find their favorite drink.

games.name: Mysplaced
games.summary: Mysplaced is an enchanting action-adventure game where exploration, puzzles, and combat come together in a beautifully crafted 3D world. Dive into a realm filled with secrets, challenges, and a compelling story waiting to be uncovered.

games.name: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG
games.summary: Travel through over 10 different biomes, catching over 90 different kinds of fish. Collect different rods, level up, and try to fill your Fish Encyclopedia. Experience a story-rich narrative filled with a fun and unique cast while exploring a Lovecraftian-ridden sea.

games.name: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
games.summary:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

games.name: NecroTactics
games.summary: An auto-battler roguelite with tower defense and horde survival elements. Draft and position your army, develop your graveyard, equip units with powerful items, cast spells, and place turrets to annihilate your opponent's army in seconds!

games.name: Neon Marble Rust
games.summary: Play as one of 3 Houses: Neon, Marble, or Rust! Each faction is completely unique: buildings, units, even resources are unique to each House. A two-state rollback system ensures smooth online gameplay, while a mix of challenging mechanics and automation allow you to play (and win) how you want!

games.name: Net Raiders
games.summary: Net Raiders is a single-player game that combines RPG, deck-building, and roguelike elements. In order to survive the dangers of the ruined virtual world, you must synthesize the cards in your hand to find the best move and defeat the enemies you encounter!

games.name: NeuroCorp
games.summary: A 6 player horror co-op game set in the dystopian future of Grimm City. Do shady work for Neurocorp while evading the terrifying dwellers of this strange city. Or fight them if you dare! All so you can rest and customize your home. Please, sign on the dotted line to begin.

games.name: Never Secure
games.summary: In a collapsing world, safety is a memory. Guide a small group of survivors through the daily struggle of a bleak reality. Manage your shelter, craft essentials, and make soul-crushing choices. In Never Secure, winning isn't the goal—lasting one more day is.

games.name: Nezori
games.summary: Embark on a cute action RPG adventure as a fox girl searching for the legendary hot springs in a land of fox and wolf girls!

games.name: Nights of Nil
games.summary: Control your villagers one by one in this action-RTS survival game. Build, defend, and survive night after night across procedural islands. Assign tasks, fight off waves, and settle each island to win the run.

games.name: No More Grudges
games.summary: Step into a shattered world where every bullet tells a story. No More Grudges is a visceral 3D top-down shooter that marries razor-sharp gunplay with a gripping, shadow-soaked narrative.

games.name: No Pain No Gain
games.summary:
A fun physics sandbox game
Place traps, saws, spikes, and all sorts of weird obstacles.
Every hit gives you coins, which you can use to unlock even more stuff. You can build whatever you want: from simple jump pads to complete obstacle courses full of chaos.
You can just mess around or try to break your own record, it's all about experimenting and having fun.

games.name: Noir Total: Deadly Party
games.summary: Noir Total is a 2D local multiplayer PvP shooter set in darkened arenas. Sneak through total darkness using your controller's vibrations, track down your enemies, collect bonuses and set traps to stay one step ahead of your opponents in fast-paced, competitive matches for up to 4 players.

games.name: Noodle Hustle
games.summary: You will play as a side road street food seller, cook noodle and serve customer, and of course earn money. At the end of the day will you manage to pay the bills for your hospitalized grandma, and save her?

games.name: Odds at Oddity
games.summary: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!

games.name: Oh Puck!
games.summary: Compete in the first ever curling party game! Slide, punch, and sabotage your friends in chaotic matches filled with special items. Outplay, outsmart, and out-slide your rivals in the ultimate frozen showdown!

games.name: One Card One Shot: Mafia
games.summary: Enter the world of the mafia, with an agile and dynamic Card Game that will challenge you in your free moments or addict you for hours! Choose a mission and hit the target in seconds! What awaits you with each card turned over? Will you become the legend feared by all or will you fall into oblivion?

games.name: One Nation Under the Old Gods
games.summary: A Rogue-lite Deckbuilder set in early 1800s United States. Play as members of a secret organization that investigates occult activity in an effort to stop various cults from summoning Eldritch Gods. Acquire cards to create combos and synergies to defeat your enemies in turn-based combat!

games.name: Oni Hunters
games.summary: Journey through Gironia's lands, where monsters roam and secrets await. Battle, fuse creatures, and decide your fate in the grand Monster Jubilee. Ready for the adventure?

games.name: Ooga
games.summary: Help Ooga to retrieve his stolen food stockpile in this fast-paced, spear-based parkour platformer. Play the first world and a half in the free demo, secrets included!

games.name: Operatives: Revolve
games.summary: A cinematic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are physically activated "Machines". Enemies can strike, pierce, or bomb them to pieces. Install multiple components to modify your cards, and set off cascading chain reactions to destroy your enemies.

games.name: Out on the Water
games.summary: Out On The Water is a short, meditative journey through memory and grief that tells the story of an inattentive father and his last chance to connect with his children. Set adrift in quiet waters that represent each child, catch strange memory fish to uncover the past and face regrets.

games.name: Outpacked
games.summary:
A scientist needs your help to pack for a conference trip, but be sure not to pack any hot items next to any meltable items, nor any liquid containers next to any electronics!

A family needs your help to pack their rucksacks for a camping trip, but the childrens' plushies are very picky about who and what they're packed near!

A rock musician needs your :-- well, you get the idea.

Outpacked is a logic puzzle game about efficiently packing items into grid-based inventories while satisfying their various constraints. Think "Tetris meets Sudoku".

games.name: Over the Moon
games.summary: The final game in The Rose Garden Trilogy. Can you convince Moon to come home, or will her anger towards you be ever resolute?

games.name: Packed Lair
games.summary: Villainous base-builder mixed with inventory management auto-battler roguelike! Draft buildings, pack them carefully into your cramped lair to create powerful synergies and send your army of minions to deal with the endless hero problem. Why won’t they just leave you alone?

games.name: Pals
games.summary:
PALS is an online role-playing action game that can be played by up to 16 players, offering a constantly varied gameplay experience with its different game modes.

Take on the roles of killer, innocent, or detective. Develop your strategy in detective modes, battle other players in fast-paced action modes, or work together to survive.

games.name: Panic Protocol
games.summary: A 1-4 player co-op horror game, where you guide your friends through a dangerous research facility. Use the CCTV system to observe enemies, set traps and interact with the environment. Extract with the research materials before time runs out.

games.name: Parkour Bot
games.summary: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

games.name: Path to Tamer Town
games.summary: Travel from city to city collecting badges in these procedurally generated roguelite adventures. Catch and evolve your team of Mokitons, make tough choices, and fight using a unique real-time meets turn-based battle system – all leading up to the ultimate Stadium Showdown!

games.name: PayGame
games.summary: 《PayGame》is a black-and-white hand-drawn dungeon exploration game.You must race against time through randomly generated rooms, combining items and bills to pay massive amounts of money in order to stay alive.Each run offers a brand-new challenge and a completely different experience

games.name: Pecado: SD Card
games.summary: Pecado is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

games.name: Pharmacy 24
games.summary: Pharmacy 24 is a horror simulator game where you take on the role of a pharmacist, serving customers and taking care of the Pharmacy... Who knows, maybe one day it will accept you.

games.name: Pigmarines
games.summary: Pigmarines is a co-op social deduction game where pig sailor buddies choose between sabotage, cooperation, or betrayal while trying not to sink the ship

games.name: Pizza Agent
games.summary: Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

games.name: Pizza Syndicate
games.summary: Run your pizza empire in this quirky retro tycoon! Manage restaurants, hire staff, craft menus, and outsmart rivals. Dive into the underground syndicate—rob banks, hire hitmen, sabotage competitors, and use any scheme to dominate the city with humor and strategy! WISHLIST NOW!

games.name: Playover
games.summary: PLAYOVER is a first-person psychological horror game set in an underground drilling facility. You are sent to investigate missing workers and continue the operation

games.name: Point Zero: Victoria
games.summary: A multi-perspective narrative game where near-death flashbacks unravel the truth. Return to 1990s Hong Kong and uncover four competing versions of the truth through combat and investigation. Spine-tingling twists! A bloodstained mystery spanning thirty years, waiting to be uncovered…

games.name: Possessions
games.summary: In Possessions, perspective changes everything. Solve mesmerizing puzzles by shifting your view and bending reality to your will. Explore a minimalist 3D world filled with illusionary surprises, and uncover a quiet story of connection and family as you progress.

games.name: Pretty Girls Don’t Want You to Die
games.summary: "Pretty Girls Don't Want You to Die" is a game that combines strategy tower defense, survivor-like elements, and auto-battler mechanics. you, an lone hero who, in a desperate situation, unexpectedly receives a blessing from pretty girls, narrowly escaping death.

games.name: Pripyat 0
games.summary: Chernobyl has broken down. As radiation rains down upon you, the world starts rapidly mutating. You've gotten stuck in a nightmarish loop. Can you correctly spot the anomalies on time and get to safety? Or will you become one with the zone?

games.name: Prize Denied
games.summary: Prize Denied! Manage a claw machine arcade in this cozy management sim. Build challenging claw machines and play surprising cards to stop players from getting a prize! Earn money to unlock new arcades, collect cards, upgrade machines, and become the best arcade in the...UNIVERSE!

games.name: Profit Sea Incremental
games.summary: A short incremental game about fishing, earning gold, and unlocking powerful upgrades to dominate the waters.

games.name: PsychexFuse
games.summary: A lovingly hand-drawn adventure into esoteric worlds filled with threats, puzzles and horror. Help, save and clash with past versions of yourself, and unravel the mystery behind two and a half gods at war.

games.name: Purrfect Ascent
games.summary: A brutal ascent to the top to rescue your frightened kitty. Missed jumps might be punished severely. Do you have what it takes to overcome the challenge? Meow.

games.name: Puss in Box
games.summary: Puss In Box is a cozy cat search simulator with puzzle and pet care elements.

games.name: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
games.summary: A co-op horror about scavenging a post-apocalyptic earth and eating your friends.

games.name: RTFM
games.summary: Solve puzzles and stay one step ahead of [redacted] in this co-op tech support simulator. One player, the Troubleshooter, uses the User Manual to troubleshoot for the Terminal Operator, who must convey what’s on the screen. Players must work together — or not — in this atmospheric game of trust and communication.

games.name: Raccoin: Coin Pusher Roguelike
games.summary: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

games.name: Radioactivity
games.summary: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

games.name: Raider Kid and the Ruby Chest
games.summary: Sneak away from your boring family vacation and delve into ANCIENT RUINS! Borrow equipment from dead explorers and uncover the secrets of a lost civilization as you leave your parents worried sick. WARNING: The Ruby Chest may contain traces of an ancient curse (and gluten).

games.name: Ramen Shop Simulator
games.summary: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique restaurant. The aroma of success is just a bowl away!

games.name: Ravenridge
games.summary: You are being watched. Tested. In RAVENRIDGE, uncover the truth behind a forgotten prison as detective Ethan Ward. What begins as an investigation soon leads deep into your own mind. Are you in control, or just another subject?

games.name: Rearranged
games.summary: A phenomenon called The Rearranging shuffles the rooms in your house and traps you inside with a monster. You have to explore the shifting layout, gather the right items, and solve one big puzzle to survive. Use the map from your tablet to avoid the monster and survive.

games.name: Recall News
games.summary: Explore haunted zones with friends in this co-op horror! Grab cursed decor, sell it fast, and escape before the house eats someone (again).

games.name: Recoup
games.summary: Bring back mankind. Bring down factions. Explore the new world by solving light grid puzzles. Interact with lots of unique citizens such as a cashier and a shopkeeper. Recruit and bargain through combat-like dialogues. Modify your abilities as you experience the story through comic cutscenes.

games.name: Referee Life Simulator 2026
games.summary: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

games.name: Remembrance
games.summary: Step into the fractured mind of a dying scientist in Remembrance, a mind-bending VR puzzle adventure. Piece together broken memories, uncover devastating truths, and decide the fate of a world teetering on the edge of collapse. Will you save humanity?

games.name: Remnant Frontier: Survival
games.summary: The Remnants of humanity send an augmented human to a seemingly uninhabited alien frontier. From sticks and stones, build the tools required to complete the Quantum Gate Terminus and save the world. A relaxed yet deep and engaging Rogue-lite Card Based Adventure; Combine, Explore, Learn & Build.

games.name: Renascor
games.summary: The spine of time has shattered. With your team of 1–4 experts, investigate divine anomalies, gather evidence, and seal reality itself. Following the lost teams, infiltrate history as Renascor’s final hope.

games.name: Restless Rites
games.summary: Tend to a cursed chapel at the edge of town, or be swallowed by what sleeps beneath it. Clean, survive, and unravel a rotting mystery in this surreal horror game of routine, decay, and sacrifice.

games.name: Retired
games.summary: RETRO HYPER TIRE RACING! Cruise down hills through 5 different developer created worlds competing for the best track time, or race through a nearly infinite supply of User created levels through the steam workshop!

games.name: Retro Game Store Simulator
games.summary: Build your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming has a future!

games.name: Revolve
games.summary: Revolve is a fast paced 1v1 movement shooter where every duel is a test of skill and reflexes. Players fight using only a revolver. With every defeat offers a card that changes how the game plays and enhances your weapon, keeping each match unpredictable.

games.name: Rhythm Animal Café
games.summary: Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame—all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Simple controls, joyful groove. Feel music fuse with daily life’s warmth!

games.name: Rift Survivors
games.summary: Rift Survivors is a 2D survivor-like game where you grow stronger by arranging your inventory. Equip items to unlock hidden powers and create your own unique build. Cross the rifts and survive against endless waves of enemies!

games.name: Rimal Game
games.summary: Dive into Rimal Game, an online multiplayer with stunning graphics and innovative gameplay. Choose diverse characters, unleash groundbreaking skills, and compete in thrilling eSports. Every moment is a chance to redefine your gaming adventure!

games.name: Rise of the Robots X
games.summary: Rise of the Robots X (RoRx) is an online futuristic card-based strategy game played on a hexagonal grid battleground. Played on a hexagonal grid battleground, each game is an opportunity to refine your army and get better Robots, Buildings or Masteries!

games.name: Rosepine Hotel
games.summary: I thought that hand was pulling me out of a nightmare and back into reality. Soon, I’ll realize—it only dragged me into another nightmare: “Rosepine Hotel”

games.name: Ruins of the Forgotten: A Wild Survival
games.summary: "Ruins of the Forgotten" is more than survival; it's a story where choices shape your destiny. Conquer the jungle, reveal secrets, and leave a legacy in mysterious ruins.

games.name: Rune Defender
games.summary: Rune Defender is a grid based tower defense game. You build towers during the day and defend against the undead during the night.

games.name: Rustmire
games.summary: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

games.name: SOS: Save Our Ship
games.summary: SOS is a 4-player online co-op horror-action game. Operate your ship, explore dangerous islands, loot valuable treasures, and escape deadly enemies to repay your soul’s debt. Strategy and teamwork are key to survival!

games.name: SUMBR
games.summary:
A 2-8 Player Arena Shooter filled with chaos.

Ascend into a 300 year intergalactic war between the 7 factions of humanity. Fight against all fronts and reunite the First Kingdom, as a Bellator of The King's Guard. Discover high tech weaponry, bionic augments and artifacts of a Pinnacle Era in the sci-fi Co-op, PvP, PvE world of SUMBR.

Venture into war-torn faction territories of the solar system, clear Heroic missions, and battle against other players in a variety of PvP modes, either solo or with friends.

games.name: Sabotrix
games.summary: Sabotrix – A New Kind of Trolling Game! Use cunning strategy, precise control, and a variety of skill combinations to sabotage your enemies' operations and bring down those who seek to corrupt the Matrix World!

games.name: Saddle Up and Drive
games.summary: Saddle Up and Drive is an isometric driving game where you smuggle, haul goods, or help the community. Join official races, illegal street events, or demolition derbies. Your choice, just make money. But watch out: the cops are always lurking!

games.name: Salvus: Aries
games.summary: A mature slice of death and adventure fantasy otome visual novel that begins at the bad ending.

games.name: Satan's Ball
games.summary: Summon the sinful to Satan’s…no, to your Ball in Hell. In a social simulation where society gravitates towards chaos, you will manage, promote, and punish, all to discover the knowledge the Satan’s Bible holds. How many will you sacrifice before the chaos erupts?

games.name: Scale2fit
games.summary: A simple puzzle game about scaling blocks to fit them together.

games.name: Scavland
games.summary: Scavland is a hardcore, top-down pixel art survival game set in a Post-Apocalyptic Soviet Era. Explore a world ravaged by war and the deadly Mist, scavenging for resources, taking risky jobs, and seeking refuge in harsh settlements. The wasteland is relentless—everything is out to kill you.

games.name: Scramble: Battle of Britain
games.summary:
Scramble: Battle of Britain is a simultaneous turn-based dogfighting game. Set in a 3D airspace, the game features fast-paced, tactical combat with dynamic flight physics.
Luftwaffe and RAF fighter squadrons go head to head over The English Channel. Competing players simultaneously issue control inputs for multiple aircraft while time is paused.
The planned orders are then played out simultaneously: shots are fired, loops are looped, colliding planes collide.

games.name: Scrapborne
games.summary: A Helldivers-inspired desktop overlay RPG where your actions shape the universe. Gear up in your bunker and join the galactic struggle from the corner of your screen. Impact the global economy, faction wars, and story. Adapt to World Events in a living, community-driven world.

games.name: Scribble Wolf
games.summary: A Werewolf game (or social deduction game), in which you can control the character that you have drawn. Up to 10 players can play online. Perhaps the key to victory is to "draw tracing" of an opposing team's character and "disguise yourself" as it...?

games.name: Scrubbin' Trubble
games.summary: Scrubbin' Trubble is a cooperative roguelike where you go solo or team up with up to four players in local or online multiplayer to slash, smash, and scrub your way through dangerously dirty stages. Use strategy and teamwork to clean up Nasties, and take down the Four Filths of the Apocalypse.

games.name: Sea of Souls
games.summary: Discover the secrets of the cycle of reincarnation in Sea of Souls! A Turn-Based RPG with various Metroidvania elements to help you explore the world.

games.name: Seek & Sail
games.summary: Seek & Sail is a pirate-themed deck-building roguelike. Your deck is made up of sailors, each bringing their own actions into combat. Upgrade your crew, uncover unique relics, and face intense naval battles where timing is everything.

games.name: Severed Love
games.summary: You have lost both your legs and arms and you can’t remember anything... The Limb-Severing Devil's Confinement and Devotion. Your only way to survive...

games.name: Shadows of Despair
games.summary: Shadows Of Despair is a co-op horror game for up to four players, immersing you in eerie Case Files with a mix of terrifying and humorous enemies.

games.name: Shadows of War 2
games.summary: Command one of four armies in Shadows of War II, a side-scrolling RTS with destructible terrain, procedural maps, and four tug-of-war modes. Build armies, call in strikes, and outwit foes in tense 1v1 multiplayer battles.

games.name: Sherlock Holmes: Night Stalker
games.summary: “When you have eliminated all which is impossible, then whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.” — Sherlock Holmes. This work is an immersive mystery and deduction game, powered by the latest large-scale AI model technology and offering a brand-new interactive experience.

games.name: Shock
games.summary: In SHOCK, you play as a disabled war veteran, hunted by a cybernetic creature. With only a wheelchair for mobility, use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape. Survive the horror and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

games.name: Silent Spirits
games.summary: Operate a secret speakeasy in 1920s America during Prohibition. Craft illicit alcohol, serve demanding customers, avoid police raids, smuggle shipments to the mob, and expand your empire across 15 years of escalating danger, pressure, and underground opportunity.

games.name: Slipgate
games.summary: Explore a gloomy rooms of damned sci-fi base as a doomed marine, only survivor of the portal experiment. Save humanity like in 90's with your trusty shotgun, paving a way through ominous corridors inhabited by the shadows of sinners and evil spirits.

games.name: Smipat and the Lost Bones
games.summary: In Smipat and the Lost Bones you follow the life of Smipat, a necromancer's pet with a will of it's own. Smipat has lost some of it's bones and is going on an adventure to find them. Each bone has it's own unique ability that makes it possible to overcome the challenges ahead.

games.name: Sniper Elite 5
games.summary:
The latest instalment in the award-winning series, Sniper Elite 5 offers unparalleled sniping, tactical third-person combat and an enhanced kill cam. Fight your way across the most immersive maps yet, with many real-world locations captured in stunning detail, and an improved traversal system that lets you explore more of them than ever before.

France, 1944 – As part of a covert US Rangers operation to weaken the Atlantikwall fortifications along the coast of Brittany, elite marksman Karl Fairburne makes contact with the French Resistance. Soon they uncover a secret Nazi project that threatens to end the war before the Allies can even invade Europe: Operation Kraken.

games.name: Snow Steam Trail
games.summary: Drive a steam-powered truck across frozen wastelands to uncover the truth behind the Great Freeze. Gather resources, refuel, repair, and upgrade your vehicle. Cultivate and cook plants. What secrets await in this slumbering frostland?

games.name: Sokoku
games.summary: A block-pushing game where you not only push blocks, you are one. Plan your movements so that the right number ends up on top, while you interact with other cubes and mechanics. Can you roll your way to the solution?

games.name: Solaro
games.summary: Solaro is a handcrafted open-world game set in the remote outskirts of an ancient galaxy. Follow a lone traveller on an interstellar journey, solving puzzles, probing planets, and recovering lost fragments of the past.

games.name: Sorry, Wrong Door
games.summary: Sorry, Wrong Door is an online co-op game for 1-4 players. Trapped in a haunted castle with a powerful demon hunting you. Explore the ever-changing castle, slay monsters, fight boss battles, uncover clues, avoid traps, and use powerful weapons to escape.

games.name: Soul Essence
games.summary: A frantic, race-against-time survival horror game with Roguelite and Metroidvania elements. Traverse a decrepit, cultist-infested estate and collect awakened souls to conquer an ancient god looking to feast on your essence. Before midnight strikes—can you defeat the god or prevent its return?

games.name: South of Midnight
games.summary: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Explore the mythos and confront mysterious creatures of the Deep South in this modern folktale while learning to weave an ancient power to surmount obstacles and face the pain haunting your hometown.

games.name: Spa World
games.summary: Spa World is a cosy isometric management game where you design and run your own wellness centre — from a bare concrete shell to a five-star sanctuary. Drag out rooms, lay stone paths, hire staff, and keep your guests relaxed. Every decision matters: a dirty sauna loses reputation, an understaffed changing room creates a queue, and a VIP who leaves untreated can torpedo your rating overnight.

games.name: Space Revolver
games.summary: Space Revolver is a strategic puzzle game set in a space station. Use limited moves—such as map rotation, gravity control, and horizontal movement—to find the optimal path. Enjoy clever and deep puzzles with retro-style pixel art and a classic sci-fi atmosphere!

games.name: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
games.summary: Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

games.name: Spaceship Idle: Design, Build, Explore & Battle
games.summary: Spaceship Idle is an idle/incremental game that allows you to build your own modular spaceship and battle with other commanders. Explore the vast tech tree, unlock unique weapons, design your own spaceship layout, trade with global players, and win epic space (auto)battles!

games.name: Sprint City
games.summary: Sprint City is a shared-world competitive 2D platformer from the original creators of SpeedRunners, where tight controls, explosive speed, and hidden shortcuts fuel high-intensity racing.

games.name: Stabjack
games.summary: A combination of Roguelike Deckbuilder and comic noir tragedy. Stabjack plunges you into a dark, gritty, demon-infested world, with gameplay that builds on the familiar concepts of Blackjack. Can a talking knife help you solve your wife’s murder, or is this just the beginning of your descent into madness?

games.name: Star Apoligce: Survivors
games.summary: Deep in the vast galaxy, you are the last survivor. Waves of enemies keep coming, and the universe is filled with unknown dangers. Your only mission is to survive within the limited time. Pilot your spaceship to fight, gather resources, and upgrade your weapons and abilities.

games.name: Star Trek: Infection
games.summary:
A VR full-body narrative survival experience set in the Star Trek universe.

You’re a Vulcan Starfleet officer, sent on a special mission aboard the U.S.S. Lumen, but something has gone horribly wrong.

There’s no crew in sight, and an unknown entity has infested the ship. Now it’s inside your body, physically mutating you, unlocking dangerous new abilities at the cost of your sanity.

games.name: StarAbyss Heroes
games.summary: Torn by an ancient cataclysm, the world lies in ruins. In this ARPG, play a hero exploring relics, looting treasures, forging weapons, and mastering skills on a decaying yet fantastical journey.

games.name: Starbump
games.summary: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !

games.name: Starship Crafter
games.summary: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and repay the immense debt your father left behind. Upgrade your workshop, craft components, build starships, complete contracts, follow unfolding events through the in-game newspaper, and most importantly, repay the debt before the deadline

games.name: Starship Dice
games.summary: Starship Dice​​ is a strategy game with dice at its core, inspired by Mahjong. Players use dice to command fleets in battle. Different point values and dice combinations form scoring hands. But don't worry, you can still battle even without forming a complete hand.

games.name: Static Condition
games.summary: Static Condition is a psychological horror walking simulator inspired by liminal spaces and the "spot-the-difference" genre. Every run is a test of your focus and your ability to remain calm as the environment twists around you.

games.name: Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void
games.summary: Take command of a freight ship traveling through deep space. Every jump brings danger, every decision matters. Manage your crew, upgrade your ship, trade, fight, and survive in a hostile galaxy where resources are scarce and every day could be your last.

games.name: Sticky Date
games.summary: An anti-dating simulator that subverts the genre and provides catharsis through relatable, raw and satirical dates. You play as an underpaid dumpling cook who, in order to make ends meet, gets recruited by a sketchy dating app agent. Now you need to crash dates in order to earn a living wage!

games.name: Stock the Shelves
games.summary: A Frantic Store Management Sim. Create the best shop you can imagine, then make it better! Manage, Upgrade, Keep Customers Happy, but most importantly STOCK THOSE SHELVES!

games.name: Subliminal
games.summary: Subliminal is a psychological horror game inspired by the urban legend of The Backrooms. Bleeding-edge lighting and rendering, handcrafted open-ended levels, light and perspective-based puzzles, nostalgic spaces, unfamiliar faces, and a rotting feeling that something is not quite right.

games.name: Sunberry Care Center
games.summary: An analog horror adventure where you work as a staff member at the uncanny facility named Sunberry Care Center, which is dedicated to the treatment of a mysterious disease called Sunberry Syndrome.

games.name: Sunsave
games.summary: Sunsave is a relaxing incremental game with a vaporwave and minimalist vibe. Destroy meteors, collect resources, and evolve the Sun with upgrades that unlock new mechanics!

games.name: Super Cyber Wave
games.summary: Super Cyber Wave is a fast-paced 3D bullet hell where you pilot unlockable characters with unique attack patterns, dodge bullet waves, collect ring-shaped keys, grab power-ups, and survive boss fights across four lethal biomes. Ride the rhythm of an immersive soundtrack.

games.name: Super Meat Boy 3D
games.summary: Super Meat Boy 3D is a tough as nails platformer where you play as an animated cube of meat who's trying to save his girlfriend (who happens to be made of bandages) from an evil fetus in a jar wearing a tux – IN 3D!

games.name: Survival of Runt
games.summary: The truth belongs only to those who survive." 50 players bet their actual lifespan (Time) to enter the DEADZONE, or write a grand epic in CONQUEST. In a world where order has collapsed, what will define you? Death is not the end. Rise as a Zombie to hunt survivors and reclaim your lost time.

games.name: Survivesmith
games.summary: Reverse bullet-hell game with a crafting twist. Shoot hails of bullets, missiles, nails, lasers and whatever is at your disposal at your enemies and make tactical choices to overcome all obstacles. You are here to find and extract the 'Life Essence', and you're not leaving without it!

games.name: Swarm Hunter
games.summary:
1985. An Alternate Universe. A Forgotten World Calls for Help.

The International Space Agency (ISA) has just intercepted a desperate, system-wide distress signal from the long-isolated inhabitants of Pluto. In a race against time, the nearby vessel Empress of Discovery is dispatched to respond…but moments after making orbit, the ship’s final transmission crackles through the void: a garbled, static-soaked mayday… then silence.

Now, all eyes turn to you.

Assume the role of Master Commander Lance Johnson, captain of the legendary Gilded Seeker.

Your mission: investigate the Plutonian distress call, uncover the fate of the Empress and its crew, and confront whatever terror has awakened on the planet’s surface. Can you stop the unknown menace before it spreads beyond Pluto’s orbit?

games.name: Synapse
games.summary: 「Synapse」is a game based on cooperative play with horror and thrills. Players must cooperate in a dark space to avoid robots, hack into facilities, and escape. The only thing players are given is a sense of helplessness and fear of death.

games.name: System Clues
games.summary: Play as a secret agent of a mysterious organization and complete complex plot investigation tasks through network infiltration, social engineering, and digital investigation. Is it justice or sin?

games.name: Take You Home
games.summary: In a strange, monochrome world, swap colors and flip gravity to chase a mysterious black cat.

games.name: Tanks: Total Destruction
games.summary: TANKS Total Destruction is a tribute to a cult classic, reimagined for modern action gaming. A top-down view, movement limited to four directions, and intense, tactical gameplay come together with modern visuals, spectacular explosion effects, and smooth animations powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Teacher Seduction
games.summary: Math is such a boring thing... Unless you have a hot teacher! In this case, even her angry boyfriend might not be a big problem.

games.name: Terrafactory: Idle Planet
games.summary: A planet building idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop while you do other things.

games.name: That's My Tofu
games.summary: A chaotic VR cooking game where you use chopsticks to cook, serve, and defend your hotpot feast against your mischievous cousin.

games.name: The Bestest Alchemist
games.summary: Solve puzzles and brew potions in The Bestest Alchemist, a strategic match-3 roguelike! Freely arrange ingredients to create magical combinations, discover 100+ new recipes, and upgrade your collection to build powerful synergies. Your journey to becoming a master alchemist starts now!

games.name: The Bold Club
games.summary: A totally chaotic card game for up to 6 players where you must cheat to win. Match shapes and colors, use special cards, cheat to secretly get rid of your cards and report other players before they do the same.

games.name: The Chronos Event
games.summary: The Chronos Event is a fast-paced third-person shooter that emphasizes the tactics of time travel and fast, aggressive play. Players rewind time, battling alongside their younger selves against overwhelming opposition.

games.name: The Corner Cafe
games.summary: The Corner Cafe is a cozy(ish) cafe simulator set in a retro futuristic mythical Ireland in the year 2160. Play as Dan, the new owner of The Corner Cafe, the last independent cafe in Galway City. It is up to you to create an oasis of community in this dystopia...

games.name: The Day of Salvation
games.summary: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

games.name: The Doodle Palette
