games.summary: A cozy sandbox for building and painting miniature worlds. Place, paint, and decorate while tiny people and birds bring your dioramas to life.

games.name: The Hilarious Three Kingdoms 2
games.summary: This is a traditional turn-based strategy game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms.Control different feudal lords, step onto the historical battlefield, experience the funny plot, strategize and unite the world!

games.name: The Hopeless Few
games.summary: Third-person survival roguelite shooter, where you've got 20 minutes before the infection takes over. Use that time to salvage valuable loot & secure the survival of others.

games.name: The King in the Shades
games.summary: A classic survival-horror experience set in a fictional universe where the invisible hand of unspeakable horrors is turning humanity into a fleeting memory. Enter the world of The King in the Shades and rid this decaying world of the curse of Gods.

games.name: The Last Ball
games.summary: A simple, relaxing puzzle game with an incremental feel.

games.name: The Last Hand
games.summary: The Last Hand is a gothic blackjack roguelike where players draft powerful modifiers, build custom decks, create synergistic combos, and face twisted dealers and bosses inside The House.

games.name: The Last Tape: Before the Mine
games.summary: In this first chapter of the saga, relive an old tape recorded over 35 years ago, revealing one of Lurmont Corporation’s darkest secrets. Explore the Alhambra mines, uncover the truth behind the events, and survive the constant threat of B-96. What was once recorded now hunts you.

games.name: The Lists VR
games.summary: Mount your horse, lower your lance, and experience the thrill of medieval jousting in full virtual reality. The Lists VR puts you directly on the tournament field in 15th-century Europe. Compete in a focused, skill-based jousting experience where your body becomes the controller.

games.name: The Maker Way
games.summary: Build creative machines, rovers, drones or robots. Use them to gather resources, discover new machine parts, source energy, construct bases and battle enemy factions in a physics-based open world.

games.name: The Night Job: Hotel
games.summary: The Night Job: Hotel is a first-person horror game about surviving five terrifying nights in an old hotel. Complete your tasks, avoid the entities that haunt the halls, and keep the place running after dark. Stay alert. Stay moving. Stay alive.

games.name: The Pet Squad
games.summary:
The Pet Squad is a 2D strategy and puzzle game with pixel art aesthetics, mainly inspired by Lemmings, that puts you in the role of a support operator.

The game is set in the not-too-distant future, where humans have managed to artificially evolve animals. The pet squad S.L.U. is an organization responsible for maintaining order between humans and the evolved animals, known as Animanos.

As an operator, you will have to support your squad at all times, guide them along the correct path, and protect them from enemies or themselves. To achieve this, you will have access to the most advanced technology, allowing you to teleport objects and even slow down time.

games.name: The Posthumous Investigation
games.summary: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

games.name: The Reflex Lab
games.summary: You've been kidnapped by an evil (and extremely rude) alien. To escape, you’ll have to complete a series of reflex, skill and patience based trials in his poorly constructed laboratory. Will you survive the alien’s twisted tests and escape? Or will you end up like his last batch of “lab rats”?

games.name: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just for the Two of Us
games.summary: Take on the role of Derek — the police chief in a small town. Make decisions that will change the course of the story. Unravel the mystery behind the peculiar behavior of Derek's boyfriend, Chris, and his younger sister. The graphic style is inspired by bara-manga and colorful line art.

games.name: The Sage's Spirit: Shining Flame
games.summary: A Japanese-inspired Western fantasy visual novel with a female-centric narrative, set in a unique world. Play commoner mage Nolan: follow your mentor to Sabelien, forge bonds, face power struggles. Choose to avoid chaos or carve your path—your choices will shape Aorleton and the Mage Guild’s fate.

games.name: The Stickman
games.summary: The Stickman is a movement-based FPS where you're a stick figure! Explore a plethora of customization options and have a whacky time with friends in PvE or PvP! Solo-Developed by a modder with way too much time on their hands

games.name: The Swordfish: Knight of the Deep
games.summary: Embark on an epic adventure as a sword-wielding fish and restore order to the kingdom's depths. Explore an ocean world full of adorable characters, menacing foes, and hidden wonders.

games.name: The Wolf Is Dead
games.summary: Detective work is never easy. When the body of Alexander Wolff is found face down in the pool at a party for the film about his life, there's only one man (well, Fox) for the job. Interrogate suspects, investigate the scene of the crime and reach back in time with your partner, Maxwell Mirror.

games.name: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard
games.summary: A romantic fairy tale set in a fantasy medieval Rus'. Play as Ivan, a young bard with a gusli in hand, on a quest to win the love of the elusive Novgorod princess. Learn tunes, make choices!

games.name: Tiny Hell
games.summary: A 2D pixel roguelike where a tiny hero tries to escape from a hotel. Choose a class, explore rooms, collect items, craft powerful weapons, and defeat enemies in turn-based battles. Each run is unique and full of surprises.

games.name: To Crown or to Destroy
games.summary: Fight horrible creatures. Devour other fairytales' hearts. Set the Princess free from her cage...and rewrite her fate! To Crown or to Destroy is a narrative RPG inspired by dark fairy tales, and tragic love stories.

games.name: Tom Clancy's The Division: Resurgence
games.summary: The Division Resurgence is a free-to-play third-person shooter RPG that features a whole new and independent campaign from Tom Clancy’s The Division and Tom Clancy’s The Division 2, offering a new perspective on key story events. It takes place in a contemporary post-crisis America where a virus outbreak has created chaos and the collapse of the government. As an agent of the "Strategic Homeland Division” your mission is to restore peace, to protect civilians against hostile factions, and to help them build a better future.​

games.name: Tombwater
games.summary: Explore the accursed Wild West town of Tombwater and lay bare the eldritch horrors that lie beneath. Survive blood-spilling combat in this gruesome 2D action-RPG that might just drive you to madness.

games.name: Torch of Shadows
games.summary: Torch of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where Light and Dark clash endlessly. Defend the temple, counter enemies with opposing powers, and preserve the fragile balance before the void consumes all.

games.name: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods
games.summary: 「TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods」 is a Touhou fangame.This is a "reverse-construction" action rogue-lite.Koishi vs. Kokoro! But as the playable character, Koishi uses various enhancement cards to continuously strengthen Kokoro. Can she ultimately defeat the Kokoro she has built up herself?

games.name: TouHou: Legend of Fairy Souls
games.summary: “TouHou: Legend of Fairy Souls” is a TouHou fan game.In the game, because of someone's conspiracy, Reimu turned into Kedama and caused her power to weaken.Reimu then had to embark on an adventure to recover herself and finally uncover who was behind the scenes.

games.name: Trailer Park Life
games.summary: Build and manage your own trailer park to either become a peaceful haven or a pit of unruly partiers. Expand on services and amenities to keep tenants happy. Manage staff to keep your park safe and clean or let chaos run amuck and risk it all for higher gains.

games.name: TypeCaster
games.summary: A once-shameless thief, cursed with a slow, agonizing death, must now embark on a perilous journey to the top of the legendary Tower of Trials. This 2.5D action RPG challenges you to master lightning-fast reflexes and precise typing to battle hordes of fearsome monsters guarding each floor. Harness powerful spells, uncover treasures, and push yourself to the limits in your battle against the unknowns. Will you rise to the challenge and break the curse, or will you become another victim?

games.name: Tyrone vs. Cops 2
games.summary: Awaken the latent power of your melanin and kill cops in this thought-provoking game on police brutality in America.

games.name: U-Boot: The Board Game - Digital Edition
games.summary: A digital version of the iconic U-BOOT The Board Game. Manage the crew of a powerful warship during World War II. Explore enemy territory, win battles using the strength of a steel giant and reliable tactics, and most importantly - overcome the blue abyss.

games.name: Ukrainian Warfare: Gostomel Heroes
games.summary:
Real Time Tactics single player game about events in Kyiv region in february-march 2022.

Highly realistic tactical battles and deep management of your forces on strategic layer.

games.name: Ultimate Control Machine
games.summary: A platformer like no other… play with 30 unique controllers! Every stage changes the controls. Master your mouse, your keyboard, and your reflexes in the ultimate test to become the world’s greatest robot pilot!

games.name: VacBot Simulator
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

games.name: Vangaro Tactics
games.summary: Command colorful troops into tactical turn-based battles in Vangaro Tactics! Infiltrate enemy outposts on the Stealth Missions: mine, recruit, move wisely, and you'll stand a chance. Know your commanders and exclusive units to make the most of each faction.

games.name: Vexcell
games.summary: Vexcell is an elegant, minimalist puzzle game. Embrace the satisfaction of everything falling into place.

games.name: Virtuoso GP Race: On
games.summary: An homage to early 3D racers: true ’90s handling with bespoke physics, checkpoints with EXTEND TIME, instant restarts, ghosts, and global leaderboards. Demo: Sakura Coast & Dunas de Giza.

games.name: Voice of Belldona
games.summary: Voice of Belldona weaves a story of swords, magic, and sci-fi! The game features roguelike decks, turn-based combat, JRPG elements, and customizable builds. Choose a character and combat style, explore randomly generated maps, power up your team, crush your enemies and... interact with a cute loli?

games.name: Voodoo Fishin'
games.summary: Voodoo Fishin is an online co-op horror game featuring fishing, proximity voice, and scary monsters. You and up to 3 friends can venture into the swamp to find the best fishing spots holding the rarest fish. BEWARE: Die along the way, and you will lose your catch!

games.name: Vytal Tactics
games.summary: A real-time top down tactics game that rewards spacing, clever item use and team building. Vytal needs help, so form a strong team, level up your heroes and choose powerful artifacts to take out rounds of enemies.

games.name: Ware's Laboratory
games.summary: Anti-piracy measures are now active. Your game has turned into a nightmare. Crawl through corrupted levels, read notes from a malicious developer, and face the nature of evil itself.

games.name: Wasteland Shop Simulator
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic shop management game where you build, customize, and expand your store. Hire staff, explore the wasteland for loot, deal with messy customers and thieves, and grow your retail empire in a chaotic world gone mad.

games.name: Whispers of The Shadow
games.summary: Detective Grace Lawson sets out immediately upon receiving a tip about her missing stepsister Amy, and when she gets there, she suddenly finds herself trapped inside the house. Now, Grace has only one goal: to find her missing sister and escape this nightmare.

games.name: Whispers of the Luminaries
games.summary:
Whispers of the Luminaries is an idol-themed murder mystery visual novel where you balance social life with detective work.

Investigate, obtain clues and deduce the killer.

games.name: Wikipedia Gacha
games.summary: Open packs to get 5 random Wikipedia articles as cards. Higher quality articles become higher rarity cards. You can also do daily tasks and battles.

games.name: Wildlife Rescue Simulator
games.summary: Get to the chopper and fly to isolated places to rescue terrified animals from man made disasters. Take photos of your adventures and share it with your loyal supporters to get donations. Upgrade your equipment in order to rescue even more animals.

games.name: Winemaker Simulator
games.summary: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a vintner. From tending your vineyard to harvesting, winemaking, and trading, every decision shapes your craft. Will you create the most exquisite and valuable wine?

games.name: Witches Tavern
games.summary: Witch Tavern is a simulated business game that integrates tavern management, cosplay, love development and other elements. As the new boss of the witch tavern, you will meet all kinds of friends in this magical city of Venesia and start a full and extraordinary life.

games.name: Witchling Grove
games.summary: Witchling Grove is an action-rpg, arena-shooting roguelike.

games.name: Wizard Hand
games.summary: A magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. Uncover dazzling combos and accumulate points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

games.name: Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream
games.summary: NOT your typical simulator! Is it your dream job or are you just working in your dream? Work fast, or face the consequences. Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream is a surreal and dark descent into human psyche, burnout and the horror of the working culture.

games.name: Wriggle Apple 4
games.summary: Embark on a cosmic adventure with the worm! Solve space puzzles, avoid asteroid traps, and grow with each apple. Can you navigate the galaxy’s challenges and reach your goal?

games.name: Wrong Answer
games.summary: A deadly quiz show where knowledge decides who gets shot. Answer correctly — you pull the trigger. Answer wrong — the gun is aimed at you.

games.name: Xvirus
games.summary: Trapped inside your own computer—are you living a dream or a nightmare?

games.name: Yāoliàn Xīyóu
games.summary: You, an ordinary college student, are unexpectedly reincarnated into another world, becoming the new "Golden Body" chosen by Jin Chanzi. Characters from "Journey to the West" suddenly reappear before you in the guise of women. To return to your original world, you must complete the mission entrusted to you by "Tathagata Buddha." Renew your bonds with various demons, undo the mistakes of the previous Golden Body, "Tang Sanzang," and retrace your journey westward, reshaping order and causality...

games.name: Zodiac Legion
games.summary: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical Role-Playing-Game featuring lethal combat, squad management and strategic elements. Lead your heroes through daring raids and forgotten ruins, defend your land in a time of conquest and betrayal, and master the secrets of volatile ancient magic to restore a realm beset by the armies of undying fiendish sorcerers.

games.name: Zoo Orbs
games.summary: A Fusion Full of Cuteness

games.name: Zoo Wars
games.summary: Battle with cute animals and fruits! Build a deck of 6 cards and battle in this simple yet deep, real-time online PvP tower defense for two players!

games.name: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
games.summary: This is an action game where you explore ruins buried in the forest with Ethnic BGM. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), goes on a journey around the ISEKIZIMA (Ruins Island of dreams and romance : as it was written in the tourist brochure).
